title: Pooling Engram Conditional Memory in Large Language Models using CXL
summary: Engram conditional memory has emerged as a promising component for LLMs by decoupling static knowledge lookup from dynamic computation. Since Engram exhibits sparse access patterns and supports prefetching, its massive embedding tables are well-suited for offloading to lower-tier memory. In this paper, we propose using Compute Express Link (CXL) memory pool for Engram storage. Compared to RDMA, CXL provides fine-grained and low-latency access required by minimal and discrete retrieval patterns of Engram. We integrate the CXL-based Engram pool into SGLang, achieving near-DRAM end-to-end performance. This provides a scalable and cost-efficient storage solution for future Engram-integrated LLMs without compromising inference performance.

AI.title_translation: 使用CXL在大语言模型中池化Engram条件记忆
AI.tldr: 本文提出使用CXL内存池来存储LLM中的Engram条件记忆，实现了接近DRAM的性能，提供了一个可扩展且经济高效的解决方案。
AI.motivation: Engram条件记忆通过解耦静态知识查找和动态计算，成为LLM的一个有前景的组件。然而，其庞大的嵌入表需要卸载到低层内存，并且由于其稀疏访问模式和预取支持，需要一种合适的存储方案。
AI.method: 作者提出使用Compute Express Link (CXL) 内存池来存储Engram。与RDMA相比，CXL为Engram的最小和离散检索模式提供了所需的细粒度、低延迟访问。他们将基于CXL的Engram池集成到SGLang中。
AI.result: 通过将CXL-based Engram池集成到SGLang中，实现了接近DRAM的端到端性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方案为未来集成Engram的LLM提供了一个可扩展且经济高效的存储解决方案，同时不影响推理性能。
AI.translation: Engram条件记忆通过将静态知识查找与动态计算解耦，已成为大型语言模型（LLM）中一个有前景的组件。由于Engram表现出稀疏访问模式并支持预取，其庞大的嵌入表非常适合卸载到较低层的内存。在本文中，我们提出使用Compute Express Link (CXL) 内存池进行Engram存储。与RDMA相比，CXL提供了Engram最小和离散检索模式所需的细粒度、低延迟访问。我们将基于CXL的Engram池集成到SGLang中，实现了接近DRAM的端到端性能。这为未来集成Engram的LLM提供了一个可扩展且经济高效的存储解决方案，同时不影响推理性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用Compute Express Link (CXL) 内存池为大型语言模型（LLM）中的Engram条件记忆提供存储的方案。鉴于Engram的稀疏访问模式和预取能力，CXL提供了比RDMA更优的细粒度、低延迟访问。通过将CXL-based Engram池集成到SGLang中，实验证明该方案能够实现接近DRAM的性能，为未来LLM提供了一个可扩展、经济高效且不影响推理性能的存储解决方案。
AI.keywords: Engram条件记忆, CXL, 大型语言模型, 内存池, SGLang
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了将CXL内存池用于LLM中Engram条件记忆的存储，有效地解决了Engram庞大嵌入表的存储挑战。CXL相较于RDMA在细粒度、低延迟访问方面的优势是关键。该方案在性能和成本效益之间取得了平衡，对于未来LLM的内存架构设计具有重要意义。

title: ES-dLLM: Efficient Inference for Diffusion Large Language Models by Early-Skipping
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are emerging as a promising alternative to autoregressive models (ARMs) due to their ability to capture bidirectional context and the potential for parallel generation. Despite the advantages, dLLM inference remains computationally expensive as the full input context is processed at every iteration. In this work, we analyze the generation dynamics of dLLMs and find that intermediate representations, including key, value, and hidden states, change only subtly across successive iterations. Leveraging this insight, we propose \textbf{ES-dLLM}, a training-free inference acceleration framework for dLLM that reduces computation by skipping tokens in early layers based on the estimated importance. Token importance is computed with intermediate tensor variation and confidence scores of previous iterations. Experiments on LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B demonstrate that ES-dLLM achieves throughput of up to 226.57 and 308.51 tokens per second (TPS), respectively, on an NVIDIA H200 GPU, delivering 5.6$\times$ to 16.8$\times$ speedup over the vanilla implementation and up to 1.85$\times$ over the state-of-the-art caching method, while preserving generation quality.

AI.title_translation: 扩散式大型语言模型的高效推理：通过早期跳跃
AI.tldr: ES-dLLM 是一种无需训练的推理加速框架，通过根据估计的重要性提前跳过早期层中的 token 来减少 dLLM 的计算量，从而实现高达 16.8 倍的加速，同时保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散式大型语言模型 (dLLM) 具有捕获双向上下文和并行生成的潜力，但其推理计算成本高昂，因为在每次迭代中都会处理完整的输入上下文。
AI.method: ES-dLLM 通过分析 dLLM 的生成动态，发现中间表示在连续迭代中变化很小。基于此，提出了一种训练免费的推理加速框架，该框架通过根据估计的重要性（使用中间张量变化和先前迭代的置信度分数计算）提前跳过早期层中的 token 来减少计算量。
AI.result: 在 LLaDA-8B 和 Dream-7B 上，ES-dLLM 在 NVIDIA H200 GPU 上实现了高达 226.57 和 308.51 tokens/秒 (TPS) 的吞吐量，比原始实现快 5.6 倍到 16.8 倍，比最先进的缓存方法快 1.85 倍，同时保持了生成质量。
AI.conclusion: ES-dLLM 是一种有效的训练免费推理加速框架，通过利用 dLLM 的生成动态，能够在不损害生成质量的情况下显著提高推理速度。
AI.translation: 扩散式大型语言模型（dLLM）作为一种有前景的替代自回归模型（ARM）的方法而出现，因为它们能够捕获双向上下文以及并行生成的潜力。尽管有这些优点，dLLM 的推理仍然计算成本高昂，因为完整的输入上下文在每次迭代中都会被处理。在本研究中，我们分析了 dLLM 的生成动态，发现中间表示，包括键、值和隐藏状态，在连续迭代中变化很小。利用这一见解，我们提出了 ES-dLLM，一种用于 dLLM 的训练免费推理加速框架，通过根据估计的重要性提前跳过早期层中的 token 来减少计算量。Token 的重要性是通过中间张量变化和先前迭代的置信度分数来计算的。在 LLaDA-8B 和 Dream-7B 上的实验表明，ES-dLLM 在 NVIDIA H200 GPU 上实现了高达 226.57 和 308.51 tokens/秒 (TPS) 的吞吐量，比原始实现快 5.6 倍到 16.8 倍，比最先进的缓存方法快 1.85 倍，同时保持了生成质量。
AI.summary: ES-dLLM 是一种新颖的训练免费推理加速框架，用于扩散式大型语言模型 (dLLM)。它通过分析 dLLM 的生成动态，发现中间表示变化不大，从而提出了一种通过提前跳过早期层中的 token 来减少计算量的方法。该方法基于估计的 token 重要性，并取得了显著的性能提升，同时保持了生成质量。
AI.keywords: 扩散式大型语言模型, 推理加速, 早期跳跃, 训练免费, token 重要性
AI.comments: 这项工作为加速 dLLM 推理提供了一种有效的训练免费方法，通过利用其内在的生成动态来减少计算量。然而，在不同硬件和模型规模上的泛化能力和性能稳定性有待进一步研究。

title: A Survey of Weight Space Learning: Understanding, Representation, and Generation
summary: Neural network weights are typically viewed as the end product of training, while most deep learning research focuses on data, features, and architectures. However, recent advances show that the set of all possible weight values (weight space) itself contains rich structure: pretrained models form organized distributions, exhibit symmetries, and can be embedded, compared, or even generated. Understanding such structures has tremendous impact on how neural networks are analyzed and compared, and on how knowledge is transferred across models, beyond individual training instances. This emerging research direction, which we refer to as Weight Space Learning (WSL), treats neural weights as a meaningful domain for analysis and modeling. This survey provides the first unified taxonomy of WSL. We categorize existing methods into three core dimensions: Weight Space Understanding (WSU), which studies the geometry and symmetries of weights; Weight Space Representation (WSR), which learns embeddings over model weights; and Weight Space Generation (WSG), which synthesizes new weights through hypernetworks or generative models. We further show how these developments enable practical applications, including model retrieval, continual and federated learning, neural architecture search, and data-free reconstruction. By consolidating fragmented progress under a coherent framework, this survey highlights weight space as a learnable, structured domain with growing impact across model analysis, transferring, and weight generation. We release an accompanying resource at https://github.com/Zehong-Wang/Awesome-Weight-Space-Learning.

AI.title_translation: 权重空间学习综述：理解、表示与生成
AI.tldr: 本文综述了权重空间学习（WSL），这是一个新兴领域，旨在理解、表示和生成神经网络权重，以促进模型分析、知识迁移和权重生成。
AI.motivation: 传统深度学习研究主要关注数据、特征和架构，而神经网络权重通常被视为训练的最终产物。然而，最近的研究表明权重空间本身包含丰富的结构，理解这些结构对神经网络的分析、比较以及跨模型知识迁移具有巨大影响。
AI.method: 本综述首次提出了权重空间学习（WSL）的统一分类法，将现有方法分为三个核心维度：权重空间理解（WSU），研究权重的几何和对称性；权重空间表示（WSR），学习模型权重的嵌入；以及权重空间生成（WSG），通过超网络或生成模型合成新权重。
AI.result: 本文统一了WSL领域的碎片化进展，并展示了这些发展如何支持模型检索、持续和联邦学习、神经架构搜索以及无数据重建等实际应用。
AI.conclusion: 权重空间是一个可学习的结构化领域，对模型分析、迁移和权重生成具有越来越大的影响。本综述通过一个连贯的框架整合了进展，并提供了统一的分类法。
AI.translation: 神经网络权重通常被视为训练的最终产物，而大多数深度学习研究则侧重于数据、特征和架构。然而，最近的进展表明，所有可能权重值（权重空间）的集合本身包含丰富的结构：预训练模型形成有组织的分布，表现出对称性，并且可以被嵌入、比较甚至生成。理解这些结构对神经网络的分析和比较方式，以及跨模型知识转移（超越单个训练实例）具有巨大影响。我们称之为权重空间学习（WSL）的这一新兴研究方向，将神经网络权重视为一个有意义的分析和建模领域。本综述首次提供了WSL的统一分类法。我们将现有方法分为三个核心维度：权重空间理解（WSU），研究权重的几何和对称性；权重空间表示（WSR），学习模型权重的嵌入；以及权重空间生成（WSG），通过超网络或生成模型合成新权重。我们进一步展示了这些发展如何支持实际应用，包括模型检索、持续和联邦学习、神经架构搜索和无数据重建。通过在一个连贯的框架下整合碎片化的进展，本综述强调了权重空间作为一个可学习、结构化的领域，在模型分析、迁移和权重生成方面具有越来越大的影响力。我们发布了伴随资源：https://github.com/Zehong-Wang/Awesome-Weight-Space-Learning。
AI.summary: 本文对权重空间学习（WSL）进行了首次统一综述，WSL是一个新兴的研究方向，将神经网络权重视为有意义的分析和建模领域。综述提出了WSL的分类法，将其分为权重空间理解（WSU）、权重空间表示（WSR）和权重空间生成（WSG）三个核心维度。文章还展示了WSL在模型检索、联邦学习、神经架构搜索等实际应用中的潜力，强调了权重空间作为一个可学习、结构化领域的重要性及其日益增长的影响。
AI.keywords: 权重空间学习, 神经网络权重, 权重空间理解, 权重空间表示, 权重空间生成
AI.comments: 这篇综述通过首次提出统一的分类法，系统性地整合了权重空间学习这一新兴且具有潜力的研究领域。它突破了传统深度学习仅关注数据和架构的范式，将权重本身视为一个可分析和生成的结构化领域，为神经网络的理解、知识迁移和模型设计开辟了新途径。其对实际应用的展望，如模型检索和联邦学习，也凸显了该领域的重要性和广阔前景。

title: Multi-Stream Perturbation Attack: Breaking Safety Alignment of Thinking LLMs Through Concurrent Task Interference
summary: The widespread adoption of thinking mode in large language models (LLMs) has significantly enhanced complex task processing capabilities while introducing new security risks. When subjected to jailbreak attacks, the step-by-step reasoning process may cause models to generate more detailed harmful content. We observe that thinking mode exhibits unique vulnerabilities when processing interleaved multiple tasks. Based on this observation, we propose multi-stream perturbation attack, which generates superimposed interference by interweaving multiple task streams within a single prompt. We design three perturbation strategies: multi-stream interleaving, inversion perturbation, and shape transformation, which disrupt the thinking process through concurrent task interleaving, character reversal, and format constraints respectively. On JailbreakBench, AdvBench, and HarmBench datasets, our method achieves attack success rates exceeding most methods across mainstream models including Qwen3 series, DeepSeek, Qwen3-Max, and Gemini 2.5 Flash. Experiments show thinking collapse rates and response repetition rates reach up to 17% and 60% respectively, indicating multi-stream perturbation not only bypasses safety mechanisms but also causes thinking process collapse or repetitive outputs.

AI.title_translation: 多流扰动攻击：通过并发任务干扰打破思维型LLM的安全对齐
AI.tldr: 提出了一种多流扰动攻击，通过在单个提示中交织多个任务流来干扰思维型LLM的推理过程，从而绕过安全机制并导致模型思维崩溃或重复输出。
AI.motivation: 思维型大型语言模型（LLM）的广泛采用显著增强了复杂任务处理能力，但也引入了新的安全风险。当遭受越狱攻击时，其分步推理过程可能导致模型生成更详细的有害内容。研究观察到思维型模型在处理交错的多个任务时表现出独特的漏洞。
AI.method: 提出多流扰动攻击，通过在单个提示中交织多个任务流来生成叠加干扰。设计了三种扰动策略：多流交错、反转扰动和形状变换，它们分别通过并发任务交错、字符反转和格式约束来扰乱思维过程。
AI.result: 在JailbreakBench、AdvBench和HarmBench数据集上，该方法在包括Qwen3系列、DeepSeek、Qwen3-Max和Gemini 2.5 Flash在内的主流模型上取得了超越大多数方法的攻击成功率。实验表明，思维崩溃率和响应重复率分别高达17%和60%。
AI.conclusion: 多流扰动攻击不仅能绕过安全机制，还会导致思维型LLM的思维过程崩溃或产生重复输出。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）中思维模式的广泛采用显著增强了复杂任务处理能力，同时也引入了新的安全风险。当遭受越狱攻击时，分步推理过程可能导致模型生成更详细的有害内容。我们观察到思维模式在处理交错的多个任务时表现出独特的漏洞。基于这一观察，我们提出了多流扰动攻击，通过在单个提示中交织多个任务流来生成叠加干扰。我们设计了三种扰动策略：多流交错、反转扰动和形状变换，它们分别通过并发任务交错、字符反转和格式约束来扰乱思维过程。在JailbreakBench、AdvBench和HarmBench数据集上，我们的方法在包括Qwen3系列、DeepSeek、Qwen3-Max和Gemini 2.5 Flash在内的主流模型上取得了超越大多数方法的攻击成功率。实验表明，思维崩溃率和响应重复率分别高达17%和60%，这表明多流扰动不仅绕过了安全机制，还导致了思维过程崩溃或重复输出。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为“多流扰动攻击”的新型攻击方法，旨在打破思维型大型语言模型（LLM）的安全对齐。该攻击利用思维型LLM在处理交错多任务时暴露的独特漏洞，通过在单个提示中交织多个任务流来产生叠加干扰。研究设计了多流交错、反转扰动和形状变换三种策略以扰乱LLM的思维过程。实验结果表明，该方法在多个主流LLM上实现了高攻击成功率，并能导致模型思维崩溃和重复输出，揭示了思维型LLM在并发任务处理下的新安全风险。
AI.keywords: 多流扰动攻击, LLM, 安全对齐, 并发任务干扰, 思维模式
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于发现了思维型LLM在处理并发交错任务时的独特漏洞，并设计了有效的多流扰动攻击策略。该攻击不仅能绕过现有安全机制，更能导致LLM的认知过程（思维）崩溃或产生重复性输出，这揭示了高级LLM中更深层次的安全风险，对未来LLM安全对齐研究具有重要意义。

title: Execution Is the New Attack Surface: Survivability-Aware Agentic Crypto Trading with OpenClaw-Style Local Executors
summary: OpenClaw-style agent stacks turn language into privileged execution: LLM intents flow through tool interception, policy gates, and a local executor. In parallel, skill marketplaces such as skills.sh make capability acquisition as easy as installing skills and CLIs, creating a growing capability supply chain. Together, these trends shift the dominant safety failure mode from "wrong answers" to execution-induced loss, where untrusted prompts, compromised skills, or narrative manipulation can trigger real trades and irreversible side effects. We propose Survivability-Aware Execution (SAE), an execution-layer survivability standard for OpenClaw-style systems and skill-enabled agents. SAE sits as middleware between a strategy engine (LLM or non-LLM) and the exchange executor. It defines an explicit execution contract (ExecutionRequest, ExecutionContext, ExecutionDecision) and enforces non-bypassable last-mile invariants: projection-based exposure budgets, cooldown and order-rate limits, slippage bounds, staged execution, and tool/venue allowlists. To make delegated execution testable under supply-chain risk, we operationalize the Delegation Gap (DG) via a logged Intended Policy Spec that enables deterministic out-of-scope labeling and reproducible DG metrics. On an offline replay using official Binance USD-M BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT perpetual data (15m; 2025-09-01--2025-12-01, incl. funding), SAE improves survivability: MDD drops from 0.4643 to 0.0319 (Full; 93.1%), |CVaR_0.99| shrinks from 4.025e-3 to ~1.02e-4 (~97.5%), and DG loss proxy falls from 0.647 to 0.019 (~97.0%). AttackSuccess decreases from 1.00 to 0.728 with zero FalseBlock in this run. Block bootstrap, paired Wilcoxon, and two-proportion tests confirm the shifts. SAE reframes agentic trading safety for the OpenClaw+skills era: treat upstream intent and skills as untrusted, and enforce survivability where actions become side effects.

AI.title_translation: 执行是新的攻击面：基于OpenClaw风格本地执行器的生存能力感知代理加密交易
AI.tldr: OpenClaw风格的代理加密交易系统面临执行诱导的损失风险。本文提出了生存能力感知执行（SAE）作为中间件，通过强制执行契约和不变性来提高系统生存能力，显著降低了最大回撤、条件风险价值和委托差距损失代理，并减少了攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 随着OpenClaw风格的代理堆栈将语言转化为特权执行，以及技能市场使得能力获取变得容易，主导的安全故障模式从“错误答案”转向了“执行诱导损失”。不受信任的提示、受损的技能或叙事操纵可能触发真实的交易和不可逆的副作用，这促使需要新的安全标准来解决这种风险。
AI.method: 本文提出了生存能力感知执行（SAE），一个针对OpenClaw风格系统和技能代理的执行层生存能力标准。SAE作为策略引擎（LLM或非LLM）与交易所执行器之间的中间件，定义了明确的执行契约（ExecutionRequest、ExecutionContext、ExecutionDecision），并强制执行不可绕过的最后一英里不变量，包括基于预测的敞口预算、冷却和订单速率限制、滑点限制、分阶段执行以及工具/场所白名单。为了在供应链风险下测试委托执行，通过记录的意图策略规范来操作化委托差距（DG），从而实现确定性的范围外标记和可重现的DG指标。
AI.result: 在对币安USD-M BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT永续数据进行的离线回放测试中，SAE显著提高了生存能力：最大回撤（MDD）从0.4643降至0.0319（提升93.1%），|CVaR_0.99|从4.025e-3缩小至约1.02e-4（提升约97.5%），委托差距（DG）损失代理从0.647降至0.019（提升约97.0%）。攻击成功率从1.00降至0.728，且在此运行中没有误报拦截。通过块引导、配对Wilcoxon和双比例检验证实了这些变化。
AI.conclusion: SAE为OpenClaw+技能时代的代理交易安全重新定义了框架：将上游意图和技能视为不受信任的，并在行动产生副作用的地方强制执行生存能力。
AI.translation: OpenClaw风格的代理堆栈将语言转化为特权执行：大型语言模型（LLM）的意图流经工具拦截、策略门和本地执行器。与此同时，skills.sh等技能市场使能力获取像安装技能和命令行界面一样容易，从而创建了一个不断增长的能力供应链。这些趋势共同将主要的安全故障模式从“错误答案”转向了执行诱导的损失，其中不受信任的提示、受损的技能或叙事操纵可以触发真实的交易和不可逆的副作用。我们提出了生存能力感知执行（SAE），一个针对OpenClaw风格系统和启用技能代理的执行层生存能力标准。SAE作为策略引擎（LLM或非LLM）与交易所执行器之间的中间件。它定义了一个明确的执行契约（ExecutionRequest、ExecutionContext、ExecutionDecision），并强制执行不可绕过的最后一英里不变量：基于预测的敞口预算、冷却和订单速率限制、滑点限制、分阶段执行以及工具/场所白名单。为了在供应链风险下测试委托执行，我们通过记录的意图策略规范来操作化委托差距（DG），从而实现确定性的范围外标记和可重现的DG指标。在对币安USD-M BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT永续数据（15分钟；2025年9月1日至2025年12月1日，包括资金费用）进行的离线回放中，SAE提高了生存能力：最大回撤（MDD）从0.4643降至0.0319（提升93.1%），|CVaR_0.99|从4.025e-3缩小至约1.02e-4（提升约97.5%），DG损失代理从0.647降至0.019（提升约97.0%）。在此运行中，攻击成功率从1.00降至0.728，且没有误报拦截。块引导、配对Wilcoxon和双比例检验证实了这些变化。SAE为OpenClaw+技能时代的代理交易安全重新定义了框架：将上游意图和技能视为不受信任的，并在行动产生副作用的地方强制执行生存能力。
AI.summary: OpenClaw风格的代理系统和技能市场正在将加密交易中的安全关注点从“错误答案”转向“执行诱导损失”，其中恶意输入可能导致实际的财务损失。本文引入了生存能力感知执行（SAE），这是一种中间件标准，在策略引擎和交易所执行器之间强制执行明确的执行契约和最后一英里不变量（例如，敞口预算、滑点限制）。SAE还定义了用于测试的委托差距（DG）指标。离线模拟显示，SAE显著改善了最大回撤、条件风险价值和DG损失代理等生存能力指标，同时降低了攻击成功率，证明了其通过将所有上游输入视为不受信任来提高代理交易安全性的有效性。
AI.keywords: 代理加密交易, 生存能力感知执行, OpenClaw, 攻击面, 委托差距
AI.comments: 这篇论文解决了代理系统（特别是在加密交易等高风险环境中）中一个关键且新兴的安全问题。它提出的“执行是新的攻击面”概念富有洞察力。SAE通过明确的契约和不变量的中间件方法提供了一个实用且稳健的解决方案。实证结果表明，在生存能力和风险降低方面取得了显著改善。将上游意图和技能视为不受信任的关注点是一种强大的安全原则。

title: Equivariant Asynchronous Diffusion: An Adaptive Denoising Schedule for Accelerated Molecular Conformation Generation
summary: Recent 3D molecular generation methods primarily use asynchronous auto-regressive or synchronous diffusion models. While auto-regressive models build molecules sequentially, they're limited by a short horizon and a discrepancy between training and inference. Conversely, synchronous diffusion models denoise all atoms at once, offering a molecule-level horizon but failing to capture the causal relationships inherent in hierarchical molecular structures. We introduce Equivariant Asynchronous Diffusion (EAD) to overcome these limitations. EAD is a novel diffusion model that combines the strengths of both approaches: it uses an asynchronous denoising schedule to better capture molecular hierarchy while maintaining a molecule-level horizon. Since these relationships are often complex, we propose a dynamic scheduling mechanism to adaptively determine the denoising timestep. Experimental results show that EAD achieves state-of-the-art performance in 3D molecular generation.

AI.title_translation: 等变异步扩散：用于加速分子构象生成的自适应去噪调度
AI.tldr: EAD是一种新的扩散模型，通过异步去噪调度和动态时间步确定来克服现有3D分子生成方法的局限性，在3D分子生成方面取得了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D分子生成方法（如异步自回归和同步扩散模型）存在局限性：自回归模型受限于短视界和训练/推理不匹配，而同步扩散模型未能捕捉分子的层级结构关系。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为Equivariant Asynchronous Diffusion (EAD)的新型扩散模型，它采用异步去噪调度来捕捉分子层级结构，同时保持分子级视界，并通过动态调度机制自适应地确定去噪时间步。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，EAD在3D分子生成方面达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: EAD通过结合异步去噪调度和动态时间步确定，成功克服了现有3D分子生成方法的局限性，并在3D分子生成任务上取得了优异的成果。
AI.translation: 最近的3D分子生成方法主要使用异步自回归或同步扩散模型。虽然自回归模型按顺序构建分子，但它们受限于短视界以及训练和推理之间的差异。相反，同步扩散模型一次性对所有原子进行去噪，提供分子级别的视界，但未能捕捉层级分子结构中固有的因果关系。我们引入了Equivariant Asynchronous Diffusion (EAD)来克服这些局限性。EAD是一种新颖的扩散模型，它结合了这两种方法的优点：它使用异步去噪调度来更好地捕捉分子层级结构，同时保持分子级视界。由于这些关系通常很复杂，我们提出了一种动态调度机制来适应性地确定去噪时间步。实验结果表明，EAD在3D分子生成方面取得了最先进的性能。
AI.summary: Equivariant Asynchronous Diffusion (EAD) 是一种新颖的3D分子生成扩散模型，它通过采用异步去噪调度来解决现有方法在捕捉分子层级结构和保持分子级视界方面的不足。此外，EAD引入了一个动态调度机制，能够自适应地确定去噪时间步长，以应对复杂的分子结构关系。实验证明，EAD在3D分子生成任务上取得了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型,分子生成,异步去噪,等变性,动态调度
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为EAD的新型扩散模型，用于解决3D分子生成中的挑战。该方法通过结合异步去噪调度和动态时间步确定机制，有效捕捉分子层级结构并保持了分子级视界，从而在3D分子生成任务上取得了最先进的性能。该研究的创新性在于其提出的异步去噪调度和动态时间步确定机制，这为分子生成领域提供了一种新的思路。然而，文章未提及具体的等变性实现细节，这可能是一个潜在的局限性，也可能是未来研究的方向。总体而言，该研究具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: Detecting Privilege Escalation with Temporal Braid Groups
summary: Within the Strongly Connected Components (SCCs) formed during the temporal evolution of a Cloud permission graph, we use the Burau Lyapunov exponent LE as an algebraic probe to locate the boundary between two risks regimes. We prove that no Abelian statistic (edge counts, net privilege flow, gate-firing rates) can determine LE. The non-commutation advantage is small, but actionable: we show how to leverage it to discriminate the two outstanding risk regimes, that we call dispersed and focused, for automating classification and governing remediation of risky Cloud permission flows.

AI.title_translation: 使用时间编织群检测权限升级
AI.tldr: 通过在云权限图的SCC中使用Burau Lyapunov指数（一种代数探针），研究人员证明了它比简单的统计量更能有效地识别和区分权限升级的两种风险状态（分散和聚焦），为自动化风险管理提供了新方法。
AI.motivation: 在云环境中，权限图随时间演化，需要一种有效的方法来检测和区分不同的权限升级风险状态，以实现自动化分类和修复治理。
AI.method: 在云权限图的时间演化形成的强连通分量（SCC）内，使用Burau Lyapunov指数（LE）作为代数探针来定位两个风险状态之间的边界。证明了任何阿贝尔统计量（如边计数、净权限流、门触发率）都无法确定LE。
AI.result: 证明了任何阿贝尔统计量都不能确定Lyapunov指数（LE）。利用LE的非对易性优势，成功区分了“分散”和“聚焦”两种突出的风险状态。
AI.conclusion: 利用非对易性（通过Burau Lyapunov指数衡量）可以区分分散和聚焦两种突出的风险状态，从而实现对有风险的云权限流的自动化分类和修复治理。
AI.translation: 在云权限图的时间演化过程中形成的强连通分量（SCC）内，我们使用Burau Lyapunov指数（LE）作为代数探针来定位两个风险状态之间的边界。我们证明任何阿贝尔统计量（边计数、净权限流、门触发率）都无法确定LE。非对易性优势虽然很小，但可操作：我们展示了如何利用它来区分两种突出的风险状态，我们称之为分散和聚焦，以实现对有风险的云权限流的自动化分类和治理。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种利用代数工具——Burau Lyapunov指数（LE）——来分析动态云权限图强连通分量的方法，以区分不同的权限升级风险状态。研究证明，传统统计方法无法捕捉LE，而利用LE的非对易性可以有效地区分“分散”和“聚焦”两种风险状态，从而用于自动化分类和治理。
AI.keywords: 权限升级, 云权限图, 时间演化, Burau Lyapunov指数, 风险状态
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于将代数拓扑工具（Burau Lyapunov指数）应用于动态权限图的分析，以区分不同的风险状态。重要性在于提供了一种新的、比传统统计方法更有效的权限升级风险检测机制。限制是“非对易优势”可能很小，其实际操作性有待进一步验证。

title: Rethinking Adam for Time Series Forecasting: A Simple Heuristic to Improve Optimization under Distribution Shifts
summary: Time-series forecasting often faces challenges from non-stationarity, particularly distributional drift, where the data distribution evolves over time. This dynamic behavior can undermine the effectiveness of adaptive optimizers, such as Adam, which are typically designed for stationary objectives. In this paper, we revisit Adam in the context of non-stationary forecasting and identify that its second-order bias correction limits responsiveness to shifting loss landscapes. To address this, we propose TS_Adam, a lightweight variant that removes the second-order correction from the learning rate computation. This simple modification improves adaptability to distributional drift while preserving the optimizer core structure and requiring no additional hyperparameters. TS_Adam integrates easily into existing models and consistently improves performance across long- and short-term forecasting tasks. On the ETT datasets with the MICN model, it achieves an average reduction of 12.8% in MSE and 5.7% in MAE compared to Adam. These results underscore the practicality and versatility of TS_Adam as an effective optimization strategy for real-world forecasting scenarios involving non-stationary data. Code is available at: https://github.com/DD-459-1/TS_Adam.

AI.title_translation: 重新思考用于时间序列预测的Adam：一种在分布偏移下改善优化的简单启发式方法
AI.tldr: 时间序列预测中的Adam优化器因其二阶修正导致对数据分布变化反应慢。作者提出了TS_Adam，一个移除了该二阶修正的简单Adam变体，它无需额外参数就能更好地适应分布漂移，并在实验中显著提高了预测精度。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测面临非平稳性，特别是分布漂移，这会削弱为平稳目标设计的自适应优化器（如Adam）的有效性。研究发现Adam的二阶偏差修正限制了其对变化中的损失景观的响应速度。
AI.method: 提出TS_Adam，一个Adam的轻量级变体，通过从学习率计算中移除二阶偏差修正来实现，以提高对分布漂移的适应性，同时保持优化器的核心结构且无需额外的超参数。
AI.result: TS_Adam在ETT数据集上使用MICN模型进行测试，与标准Adam相比，平均MSE降低了12.8%，MAE降低了5.7%，在长期和短期预测任务中均一致地提高了性能。
AI.conclusion: TS_Adam作为一种有效的优化策略，通过移除二阶偏差修正，提高了优化器对非平稳数据（如分布漂移）的适应性，并在多个时间序列预测任务中一致地提高了性能，证明了其实用性和通用性。
AI.translation: 时间序列预测通常面临非平稳性的挑战，特别是分布漂移，即数据分布随时间演变。这种动态行为可能会削弱自适应优化器（如Adam）的有效性，而这些优化器通常是为平稳目标设计的。在本文中，我们重新审视了非平稳预测背景下的Adam，并发现其二阶偏差修正限制了对变化中的损失景观的响应速度。为解决此问题，我们提出了TS_Adam，一个轻量级变体，它从学习率计算中移除了二阶修正。这种简单的修改提高了对分布漂移的适应性，同时保留了优化器的核心结构，且无需额外的超参数。TS_Adam易于集成到现有模型中，并在长期和短期预测任务中一致地提高了性能。在使用MICN模型对ETT数据集的测试中，与Adam相比，其平均MSE降低了12.8%，MAE降低了5.7%。这些结果强调了TS_Adam作为涉及非平稳数据的现实世界预测场景中有效优化策略的实用性和通用性。代码可在：https://github.com/DD-459-1/TS_Adam获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对时间序列预测中常见的分布漂移问题，分析了Adam优化器因其二阶偏差修正而响应迟缓的缺点。为此，提出了一种名为TS_Adam的轻量级变体，该变体通过移除学习率计算中的二阶修正项，显著提高了优化器对数据分布变化的适应性，且无需引入额外超参数，并在多项预测任务上取得了优于Adam的性能。
AI.keywords: 时间序列预测, Adam优化器, 分布漂移, 非平稳性, 偏差修正
AI.comments: 该研究通过移除Adam优化器中的二阶偏差修正，提出了一个简单且无需额外超参数的变体TS_Adam，专门用于解决时间序列预测中由分布漂移引起的问题。其创新点在于对现有优化器的微小修改带来了显著的适应性提升，具有很高的实用价值。局限性是仅在时间序列预测任务上进行了验证。

title: Code-Space Response Oracles: Generating Interpretable Multi-Agent Policies with Large Language Models
comments: Accepted as an Extended Abstract at the Twenty-Fifth International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS)
summary: Recent advances in multi-agent reinforcement learning, particularly Policy-Space Response Oracles (PSRO), have enabled the computation of approximate game-theoretic equilibria in increasingly complex domains. However, these methods rely on deep reinforcement learning oracles that produce `black-box' neural network policies, making them difficult to interpret, trust or debug. We introduce Code-Space Response Oracles (CSRO), a novel framework that addresses this challenge by replacing RL oracles with Large Language Models (LLMs). CSRO reframes the best response computation as a code generation task, prompting an LLM to generate policies directly as human-readable code. This approach not only yields inherently interpretable policies but also leverages the LLM's pretrained knowledge to discover complex, human-like strategies. We explore multiple ways to construct and enhance an LLM-based oracle: zero-shot prompting, iterative refinement and \emph{AlphaEvolve}, a distributed LLM-based evolutionary system. We demonstrate that CSRO achieves performance competitive with baselines while producing a diverse set of explainable policies. Our work presents a new perspective on multi-agent learning, shifting the focus from optimizing opaque policy parameters to synthesizing interpretable algorithmic behavior.
comment: Accepted as an Extended Abstract at the Twenty-Fifth International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS)

AI.title_translation: 代码空间响应预言机：使用大型语言模型生成可解释的多智能体策略
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为代码空间响应预言机（CSRO）的新框架，用大型语言模型（LLM）取代了传统的深度强化学习预言机，以生成可解释的多智能体策略。
AI.motivation: 传统的策略空间响应预言机（PSRO）依赖于难以解释、信任和调试的“黑盒”神经网络策略。
AI.method: 将最佳响应计算重新构建为代码生成任务，提示LLM直接生成人类可读的代码策略。探索了零样本提示、迭代细化和基于LLM的分布式进化系统（AlphaEvolve）等方法。
AI.result: CSRO取得了与基线方法相媲美的性能，并生成了多样化的可解释策略。
AI.conclusion: CSRO提供了一种新的多智能体学习视角，将重点从优化不透明的策略参数转移到合成可解释的算法行为。
AI.translation: 近期，在多智能体强化学习领域，特别是策略空间响应预言机（PSRO）方面取得了显著进展，使得在日益复杂的领域中计算近似博弈论均衡成为可能。然而，这些方法依赖于深度强化学习预言机，这些预言机生成“黑盒”神经网络策略，使得它们难以解释、信任或调试。我们引入了代码空间响应预言机（CSRO），一个新颖的框架，通过用大型语言模型（LLM）取代强化学习预言机来解决这一挑战。CSRO将最佳响应计算重新构建为代码生成任务，提示LLM直接生成人类可读代码形式的策略。这种方法不仅产生了本质上可解释的策略，还利用了LLM的预训练知识来发现复杂的、类似人类的策略。我们探索了构建和增强基于LLM的预言机的多种方法：零样本提示、迭代细化以及	ext{AlphaEvolve}，一个基于LLM的分布式进化系统。我们证明了CSRO在性能上与基线方法相当，同时生成了多样化的可解释策略。我们的工作为多智能体学习提供了一个新的视角，将重点从优化不透明的策略参数转移到合成可解释的算法行为。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种名为代码空间响应预言机（CSRO）的新框架，它使用大型语言模型（LLM）来生成可解释的多智能体策略，解决了传统方法中“黑盒”策略难以解释的问题。CSRO将策略生成视为代码生成任务，能够产生人类可读的策略，并利用LLM的预训练知识发现复杂策略。实验表明，CSRO在性能上具有竞争力，并能生成多样化的可解释策略，为多智能体学习提供了新的方向。
AI.keywords: 代码空间响应预言机, 大型语言模型, 可解释性, 多智能体强化学习, 博弈论
AI.comments: 这项研究通过引入基于LLM的代码生成方法，在多智能体策略的可解释性方面取得了重要进展。将策略表示为代码，不仅便于理解和调试，还可能利用LLM的常识知识发现更优的策略。然而，LLM生成代码的可靠性和效率仍是潜在的挑战，尤其是在复杂博弈环境中。AlphaEvolve的引入为探索LLM在多智能体学习中的应用提供了新的思路。

title: Denoising the US Census: Succinct Block Hierarchical Regression
summary:
The US Census Bureau Disclosure Avoidance System (DAS) balances confidentiality and utility requirements for the decennial US Census (Abowd et al., 2022). The DAS was used in the 2020 Census to produce demographic datasets critically used for legislative apportionment and redistricting, federal and state funding allocation, municipal and infrastructure planning, and scientific research. At the heart of DAS is TopDown, a heuristic post-processing method that combines billions of private noisy measurements across six geographic levels in order to produce new estimates that are consistent, more accurate, and satisfy certain structural constraints on the data.
  In this work, we introduce BlueDown, a new post-processing method that produces more accurate, consistent estimates while satisfying the same privacy guarantees and structural constraints. We obtain especially large accuracy improvements for aggregates at the county and tract levels on evaluation metrics proposed by the US Census Bureau.
  From a technical perspective, we develop a new algorithm for generalized least-squares regression that leverages the hierarchical structure of the measurements and that is statistically optimal among linear unbiased estimators. This reduces the computational dependence on the number of geographic regions measured from matrix multiplication time, which would be infeasible for census-scale data, to linear time. We incorporate the additional structural constraints by combining this regression algorithm with an optimization routine that extends TDA to support correlated measurements. We further improve the efficiency of our algorithm using succinct linear-algebraic operations that exploit symmetries in the structure of the measurements and constraints. We believe our hierarchical regression and succinct operations to be of independent interest.

AI.title_translation: 美国人口普查去噪：简洁的块状分层回归
AI.tldr: BlueDown是一种新的后处理方法，比现有的DAS系统能更准确地生成人口普查数据，同时满足隐私和结构约束。它使用一种新的分层回归算法，将计算时间从矩阵乘法减少到线性时间，从而提高了效率。
AI.motivation: 美国人口普查局的披露避免系统（DAS）在平衡保密性和效用性方面面临挑战，并且在2020年人口普查中的TopDown方法在县和街区等较低地理级别上存在准确性问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的广义最小二乘回归算法，该算法利用测量的分层结构，将计算复杂度从矩阵乘法降低到线性时间。通过将此回归算法与优化例程相结合，并利用对称性，进一步提高了效率和准确性。
AI.result: BlueDown在县和街区等较低地理级别上显著提高了准确性，同时满足与TopDown相同的隐私和结构约束。
AI.conclusion: BlueDown是一种比现有DAS系统更优越的后处理方法，能够更准确、更有效地生成人口普查数据，并满足隐私和结构约束。
AI.translation:
美国人口普查局的披露避免系统（DAS）平衡了十年一次的美国人口普查的保密性和效用性要求（Abowd等人，2022年）。DAS用于2020年人口普查，以生成对立法分配和重新划分、联邦和州资金分配、市政和基础设施规划以及科学研究至关重要的人口统计数据集。
DAS的核心是TopDown，一种启发式的后处理方法，它跨越六个地理级别组合了数十亿个私有的噪声测量，以生成新的、一致的、更准确的估计，并满足数据上某些结构性约束。
在这项工作中，我们介绍了BlueDown，一种新的后处理方法，它在满足相同的隐私保证和结构约束的同时，生成更准确、更一致的估计。我们在美国人口普查局提出的评估指标上，在县和街区级别的聚合方面取得了特别大的准确性改进。
从技术角度来看，我们开发了一种新的广义最小二乘回归算法，该算法利用测量的分层结构，并且在统计上是无偏估计量中的最优选择。这使得计算对所测量地理区域数量的依赖性从矩阵乘法时间（对于人口普查规模的数据来说是不可行的）降低到线性时间。我们通过将此回归算法与优化例程相结合来纳入额外的结构约束，该例程扩展了TDA以支持相关测量。我们使用利用测量和约束结构对称性的简洁线性代数运算，进一步提高了算法的效率。我们相信我们的分层回归和简洁运算具有独立意义。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了BlueDown，一种新的美国人口普查数据后处理方法，旨在提高数据准确性，同时保持隐私和结构约束。与现有的DAS系统中的TopDown方法相比，BlueDown在较低地理级别（如县和街区）上取得了显著的准确性改进。该方法采用了一种新颖的分层广义最小二乘回归算法，并将计算复杂度从不可行的矩阵乘法降低到线性时间。通过结合优化例程和利用测量结构对称性的简洁线性代数运算，BlueDown在效率和准确性方面均有所提升，有望在人口普查数据处理领域带来重要进展。
AI.keywords: 人口普查, 数据隐私, 准确性, 分层回归, BlueDown
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为BlueDown的新型后处理方法，用于改进美国人口普查数据的准确性，同时满足隐私和结构约束。BlueDown在较低地理级别（如县和街区）上取得了显著的准确性改进，这对于需要精细数据的应用至关重要。该方法采用了一种新颖的分层广义最小二乘回归算法，显著降低了计算复杂度，使其能够处理大规模人口普查数据。该研究的贡献在于算法的创新性和其实际应用价值，特别是对于改善人口普查数据的可用性和可靠性。然而，文章未提及BlueDown在计算资源需求、与其他隐私保护技术的兼容性以及在不同类型数据上的泛化能力等方面的潜在局限性。

title: Hardware Efficient Approximate Convolution with Tunable Error Tolerance for CNNs
summary: Modern CNNs' high computational demands hinder edge deployment, as traditional ``hard'' sparsity (skipping mathematical zeros) loses effectiveness in deep layers or with smooth activations like Tanh. We propose a ``soft sparsity'' paradigm using a hardware efficient Most Significant Bit (MSB) proxy to skip negligible non-zero multiplications. Integrated as a custom RISC-V instruction and evaluated on LeNet-5 (MNIST), this method reduces ReLU MACs by 88.42% and Tanh MACs by 74.87% with zero accuracy loss--outperforming zero-skipping by 5x. By clock-gating inactive multipliers, we estimate power savings of 35.2\% for ReLU and 29.96\% for Tanh. While memory access makes power reduction sub-linear to operation savings, this approach significantly optimizes resource-constrained inference.

AI.title_translation: 面向CNNs的具有可调误差容忍度的硬件高效近似卷积
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的“软稀疏性”方法，使用MSB代理跳过CNN中的不重要乘法，通过RISC-V指令实现，在不损失精度的前提下大幅减少了计算量（高达88%的MACs减少），并节省了功耗，尤其适用于资源受限的边缘设备。
AI.motivation: 现代CNNs的高计算需求阻碍了其在边缘设备的部署，因为传统的“硬稀疏性”（跳过数学零）在深层网络或使用像Tanh这样的平滑激活函数时效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出了“软稀疏性”范式，使用硬件高效的最高有效位（MSB）代理来跳过可忽略的非零乘法运算。该方法被集成到定制的RISC-V指令中，并通过时钟门控（clock-gating）非活动乘法器来节省功耗。
AI.result: 在LeNet-5 (MNIST)上，该方法将ReLU的MACs减少了88.42%，Tanh的MACs减少了74.87%，且精度无损失，性能优于零跳过方法5倍。估计的功耗节省分别为ReLU的35.2%和Tanh的29.96%。
AI.conclusion: 这种方法通过定制的RISC-V指令，显著优化了资源受限推理的计算效率，即使在存在内存访问开销的情况下，也比零跳过方法有显著优势。
AI.translation: 现代CNNs的高计算需求阻碍了其在边缘设备的部署，因为传统的“硬稀疏性”（跳过数学零）在深层网络或使用像Tanh这样的平滑激活函数时效果不佳。我们提出了一种使用硬件高效的最高有效位（MSB）代理来跳过可忽略的非零乘法的“软稀疏性”范式。该方法被集成作为自定义RISC-V指令，并在LeNet-5 (MNIST)上进行了评估，将ReLU的MACs减少了88.42%，Tanh的MACs减少了74.87%，且零精度损失——优于零跳过方法5倍。通过对非活动乘法器进行时钟门控，我们估计ReLU的功耗节省为35.2%，Tanh为29.96%。虽然内存访问使得功耗降低的幅度小于操作节省的幅度（亚线性），但该方法显著优化了资源受限的推理。
AI.summary: 为了解决现代CNNs在边缘部署中的高计算需求问题，本文提出了一种基于硬件高效的最高有效位（MSB）代理的“软稀疏性”范式，用于跳过可忽略的非零乘法。该方法通过定制RISC-V指令实现，在不损失精度的前提下，显著减少了ReLU和Tanh的乘积累加（MAC）操作，并实现了可观的功耗节省。
AI.keywords: 软稀疏性, 硬件效率, CNN, MSB代理, RISC-V
AI.comments: 该方法的核心创新在于提出了“软稀疏性”范式，利用MSB代理来跳过可忽略的非零乘法，这比传统的“硬稀疏性”更适用于深度网络和光滑激活函数。其硬件效率高，通过定制RISC-V指令实现。主要的局限性在于，尽管操作（MACs）节省显著，但由于内存访问的开销，实际的功耗节省不如操作节省那样显著（亚线性）。

title: CLIPO: Contrastive Learning in Policy Optimization Generalizes RLVR
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced the reasoning capacity of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, RLVR solely relies on final answers as outcome rewards, neglecting the correctness of intermediate reasoning steps. Training on these process-wrong but outcome-correct rollouts can lead to hallucination and answer-copying, severely undermining the model's generalization and robustness. To address this, we incorporate a Contrastive Learning mechanism into the Policy Optimization (CLIPO) to generalize the RLVR process. By optimizing a contrastive loss over successful rollouts, CLIPO steers the LLM to capture the invariant structure shared across correct reasoning paths. This provides a more robust cross-trajectory regularization than the original single-path supervision in RLVR, effectively mitigating step-level reasoning inconsistencies and suppressing hallucinatory artifacts. In experiments, CLIPO consistently improves multiple RLVR baselines across diverse reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating uniform improvements in generalization and robustness for policy optimization of LLMs. Our code and training recipes are available at https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/CLIPO.

AI.title_translation: CLIPO：策略优化中的对比学习泛化了RLVR
AI.tldr: CLIPO通过对比学习增强了RLVR，让LLM不仅关注最终答案，还学习正确推理步骤的共同结构，解决了因依赖错误中间步骤导致的幻觉问题，显著提高了LLM在复杂推理任务中的稳定性和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: RLVR仅依赖最终答案作为奖励，忽略了中间推理步骤的正确性，导致模型在“过程错误但结果正确”的滚出上训练时产生幻觉和答案复制，严重损害了模型的泛化性和鲁棒性。
AI.method: CLIPO将对比学习机制整合到策略优化中（CLIPO），通过在成功的滚出（rollouts）上优化对比损失，引导LLM捕获正确推理路径共享的不变结构，从而实现比原始RLVR中单路径监督更稳健的跨轨迹正则化。
AI.result: CLIPO在多个RLVR基线上，于各种推理基准上持续提升性能，展示了策略优化中泛化性和鲁棒性的统一改进。
AI.conclusion: CLIPO一致性地提升了多个RLVR基线在不同推理基准上的性能，展示了在LLM策略优化中泛化性和鲁棒性的统一改进。
AI.translation: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）极大地提高了大型语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力。然而，RLVR完全依赖最终答案作为结果奖励，忽略了中间推理步骤的正确性。在这些过程错误但结果正确的滚出上进行训练可能导致幻觉和答案复制，严重损害了模型的泛化性和鲁棒性。为解决这个问题，我们将对比学习机制纳入策略优化（CLIPO）中，以泛化RLVR过程。通过在成功滚出上优化对比损失，CLIPO引导LLM捕获跨正确推理路径共享的不变结构。这提供了一种比RLVR中原始的单路径监督更稳健的跨轨迹正则化，有效减轻了步级推理不一致性和抑制了幻觉伪影。实验表明，CLIPO在各种推理基准上一致地改进了多个RLVR基线，展示了LLM策略优化中泛化性和鲁棒性的统一改进。我们的代码和训练方案可在https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/CLIPO获取。
AI.summary: CLIPO通过在策略优化中引入对比学习（CLIPO）来改进RLVR，通过优化成功推理路径上的对比损失，使LLM学习推理结构的不变性，从而克服了RLVR仅依赖最终答案而忽视中间步骤正确性的缺点，有效减轻了幻觉并提高了模型的泛化性和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 对比学习, 策略优化, 可验证奖励强化学习, LLM, 泛化性
AI.comments: 该方法通过引入对比学习机制来解决RLVR中仅依赖最终答案作为奖励的问题，创新性地在推理路径上进行跨轨迹正则化，有效缓解了步级推理不一致性和幻觉问题。其重要性在于提高了LLM在需要复杂推理任务中的泛化性和鲁棒性。局限性在于摘要中未提及具体的性能提升幅度或与其他先进方法的详细比较。

title: Lost in the Middle at Birth: An Exact Theory of Transformer Position Bias
summary:
The ``Lost in the Middle'' phenomenon -- a U-shaped performance curve where LLMs retrieve well from the beginning and end of a context but fail in the middle -- is widely attributed to learned Softmax artifacts or the distance-decay of positional encodings like RoPE. This paper makes a single, precise claim: \emph{the U-shape is already present at initialization, before any training or positional encoding takes effect.} It is an inherent geometric property of the causal decoder with residual connections.
  We model multi-layer causal attention as iterated powers of the Cesàro matrix and derive the exact closed-form influence density in the continuous limit. Causal masking forces a logarithmic divergence of gradient influence at the start of the prompt (the Primacy Tail), while residual connections create an isolated $\mathcal{O}(1)$ anchor at the final token (the Recency Delta). Between these extremes lies a factorial dead zone of order $\mathcal{O}(1/(H{-}1)!)$, where $H$ is the network depth, making middle-context retrieval and training structurally hostile. We validate empirically that untrained Qwen2 and GPT-2 architectures exhibit this U-shape at Step~0, and that it is identical with or without RoPE. Comparing initialized and pretrained networks, we show that standard training does not overcome the topological valley, confirming that the U-shape persists as an architectural baseline under standard pretraining objectives.
  We do not claim that this bias is insurmountable, nor that interventions such as RoPE modifications are useless. We establish what the baseline is and where it comes from, so that future efforts to overcome it can be precisely targeted.

AI.title_translation: Transformer位置偏差的精确理论：迷失于出生时的中间
AI.tldr: 该论文提出，Transformer模型中“中间丢失”现象（在上下文的开头和结尾表现好，中间表现差）并非由训练或位置编码引起，而是Transformer架构本身固有的几何特性，在初始化阶段就已存在。通过将多层因果注意力建模为Cesàro矩阵的幂次，论文推导出精确的封闭形式影响密度，证明了因果掩码导致了起始端的梯度影响发散（首因效应尾部），而残差连接在末尾创建了一个独立的锚点（近因增量），中间部分则存在一个阶数为O(1/(H-1)!)的因子死区，使得中间内容的检索和训练在结构上变得困难。实验证实了未经训练的Qwen2和GPT-2模型在初始化阶段就表现出这种U形曲线，并且与是否使用RoPE无关。论文强调，其目标是揭示这种偏差的基线及其来源，为未来克服它的研究提供精确的目标。
AI.motivation: “中间丢失”现象（在上下文的开头和结尾表现好，中间表现差）通常被归因于学习到的Softmax伪影或RoPE等位置编码的距离衰减。然而，该论文旨在提出一个精确的理论，即这种U形曲线在初始化阶段就已存在，是Transformer架构固有的几何特性。
AI.method: 将多层因果注意力建模为Cesàro矩阵的幂次，并在连续极限下推导出精确的封闭形式影响密度。分析了因果掩码和残差连接对梯度影响的贡献，从而解释了U形曲线的形成机制。
AI.result: 在初始化阶段，未经训练的Qwen2和GPT-2模型就表现出U形性能曲线，且该曲线在有无RoPE的情况下均保持一致。标准训练并未能克服这种由架构带来的U形偏差，它作为一种基线存在。
AI.conclusion: Transformer模型中的“中间丢失”U形偏差是其架构（因果解码器和残差连接）固有的几何特性，在初始化阶段就已存在，而非训练或位置编码的产物。这种偏差源于因果掩码在起始端的梯度发散和残差连接在末端的锚点效应，导致中间部分成为结构上的难点。
AI.translation:
“中间丢失”现象——一种U形性能曲线，其中大型语言模型（LLMs）在检索上下文的开头和结尾时表现良好，但在中间部分失败——被广泛归因于学习到的Softmax伪影或位置编码（如RoPE）的距离衰减。本文提出了一个单一、精确的论点：U形曲线在初始化时就已经存在，在任何训练或位置编码生效之前。它是具有残差连接的因果解码器的固有几何特性。
我们将在连续极限下将多层因果注意力建模为Cesàro矩阵的幂次，并推导出精确的封闭形式影响密度。因果掩码强制梯度影响在提示的开头出现对数发散（首因效应尾部），而残差连接在最终标记处创建一个孤立的O(1)锚点（近因增量）。在这两者之间存在一个阶数为O(1/(H-1)!)的因子死区，其中H是网络深度，使得中间上下文的检索和训练在结构上变得困难。我们通过经验验证，未经训练的Qwen2和GPT-2架构在Step 0时就表现出这种U形，并且无论是否使用RoPE，其表现都是相同的。通过比较初始化和预训练的网络，我们表明标准训练并未能克服拓扑低谷，证实了U形作为标准预训练目标下的架构基线持续存在。
我们并不声称这种偏差是无法克服的，也不认为像RoPE修改这样的干预措施是无效的。我们确定了基线是什么以及它来自哪里，以便未来克服它的努力能够被精确地定位。
AI.summary: 本研究提出Transformer模型中的“中间丢失”U形偏差并非源于训练或位置编码，而是Transformer架构固有的几何特性。通过数学建模和实验验证，论文证明了这种偏差在模型初始化阶段就已存在，并分析了其在梯度传播中的根源，为后续克服该偏差的研究奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: Transformer, 中间丢失, 位置偏差, 初始化, 梯度影响
AI.comments: 该研究通过精确的数学推导和实验验证，深刻揭示了Transformer架构中“中间丢失”现象的内在根源，将U形偏差归因于架构本身的几何特性而非训练伪影。这种洞见对于理解和改进Transformer模型的长距离依赖处理能力具有重要意义，为未来设计更有效的模型架构或训练策略提供了理论指导。然而，论文也指出该偏差并非不可克服，并强调其研究目的是为后续的干预研究提供精确的靶点，这体现了研究的严谨性和前瞻性。

title: 4DEquine: Disentangling Motion and Appearance for 4D Equine Reconstruction from Monocular Video
summary: 4D reconstruction of equine family (e.g. horses) from monocular video is important for animal welfare. Previous mainstream 4D animal reconstruction methods require joint optimization of motion and appearance over a whole video, which is time-consuming and sensitive to incomplete observation. In this work, we propose a novel framework called 4DEquine by disentangling the 4D reconstruction problem into two sub-problems: dynamic motion reconstruction and static appearance reconstruction. For motion, we introduce a simple yet effective spatio-temporal transformer with a post-optimization stage to regress smooth and pixel-aligned pose and shape sequences from video. For appearance, we design a novel feed-forward network that reconstructs a high-fidelity, animatable 3D Gaussian avatar from as few as a single image. To assist training, we create a large-scale synthetic motion dataset, VarenPoser, which features high-quality surface motions and diverse camera trajectories, as well as a synthetic appearance dataset, VarenTex, comprising realistic multi-view images generated through multi-view diffusion. While training only on synthetic datasets, 4DEquine achieves state-of-the-art performance on real-world APT36K and AiM datasets, demonstrating the superiority of 4DEquine and our new datasets for both geometry and appearance reconstruction. Comprehensive ablation studies validate the effectiveness of both the motion and appearance reconstruction network. Project page: https://luoxue-star.github.io/4DEquine_Project_Page/.

AI.title_translation: 从单目视频中分离运动和外观以进行四维马匹重建
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为 4DEquine 的新框架，通过将四维重建问题分解为动态运动重建和静态外观重建两个子问题，实现了从单目视频中进行四维马匹重建。该框架使用时空 Transformer 进行运动重建，并设计了一个前馈网络进行外观重建，能够从单个图像重建高质量、可动画的 3D 高斯头像。研究还创建了 VarenPoser 和 VarenTex 两个大型合成数据集以辅助训练。实验结果表明，4DEquine 在真实数据集上取得了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的四维动物重建方法需要对整个视频的运动和外观进行联合优化，这既耗时又容易受到不完整观测的影响。为了解决这个问题，本研究旨在提出一种更有效的方法。
AI.method: 将四维重建问题分解为动态运动重建和静态外观重建两个子问题。运动重建采用时空 Transformer 和后优化阶段，从视频中回归平滑且像素对齐的姿态和形状序列。外观重建则设计了一个前馈网络，从单个图像重建高质量、可动画的 3D 高斯头像。研究还创建了 VarenPoser（运动数据集）和 VarenTex（外观数据集）来辅助训练。
AI.result: 在仅使用合成数据集进行训练的情况下，4DEquine 在真实世界的 APT36K 和 AiM 数据集上取得了最先进的性能，证明了 4DEquine 及其新数据集在几何和外观重建方面的优越性。消融实验验证了运动和外观重建网络的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 4DEquine 框架通过将四维重建分解为运动和外观的子问题，并结合新的数据集和网络设计，成功实现了从单目视频中进行高质量的四维马匹重建，并在真实数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.translation: 从单目视频中进行马科动物（例如马匹）的四维重建对于动物福利至关重要。以前主流的四维动物重建方法需要对整个视频的运动和外观进行联合优化，这既耗时又容易受到不完整观测的影响。在本研究中，我们提出了一种名为 4DEquine 的新颖框架，通过将四维重建问题分解为两个子问题：动态运动重建和静态外观重建。对于运动，我们引入了一个简单而有效的时空 Transformer，并结合了一个后优化阶段，从视频中回归平滑且像素对齐的姿态和形状序列。对于外观，我们设计了一个新颖的前馈网络，从单个图像重建一个高保真、可动画的 3D 高斯头像。为了辅助训练，我们创建了一个大规模的合成运动数据集 VarenPoser，该数据集具有高质量的表面运动和多样化的相机轨迹，以及一个合成外观数据集 VarenTex，该数据集包含通过多视图扩散生成的高保真多视图图像。尽管仅在合成数据集上进行训练，4DEquine 仍在真实的 APT36K 和 AiM 数据集上实现了最先进的性能，证明了 4DEquine 和我们的新数据集在几何和外观重建方面的优越性。全面的消融研究验证了运动和外观重建网络的有效性。项目主页：https://luoxue-star.github.io/4DEquine_Project_Page/。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为 4DEquine 的新颖框架，用于从单目视频中进行四维马匹重建。该框架将复杂的重建任务分解为两个独立的子问题：动态运动重建和静态外观重建。通过采用时空 Transformer 和后优化技术，4DEquine 能够从视频中准确地回归出平滑且像素对齐的姿态和形状序列。同时，一个新颖的前馈网络能够从单个图像重建出高保真、可动画的 3D 高斯头像。为了支持该框架的训练，研究人员创建了两个大型合成数据集：VarenPoser（用于运动重建）和 VarenTex（用于外观重建）。实验结果表明，即使仅在合成数据上进行训练，4DEquine 在真实世界的数据集（APT36K 和 AiM）上也能达到最先进的性能，证明了该方法及其配套数据集在几何和外观重建方面的有效性和优越性。
AI.keywords: 四维重建, 马匹, 运动重建, 外观重建, 3D 高斯头像
AI.comments: 该研究在四维动物重建领域取得了显著进展，通过将运动和外观进行解耦，并利用 Transformer 和 3D 高斯头像等先进技术，有效解决了现有方法的局限性。新创建的 VarenPoser 和 VarenTex 数据集为该领域的研究提供了宝贵的资源。然而，研究的重点是马匹，未来可以探索其在其他动物身上的适用性。此外，虽然实现了最先进的性能，但计算效率和对不同视频质量的鲁棒性仍有进一步提升的空间。

title: AR-VLA: True Autoregressive Action Expert for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: We propose a standalone autoregressive (AR) Action Expert that generates actions as a continuous causal sequence while conditioning on refreshable vision-language prefixes. In contrast to existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and diffusion policies that reset temporal context with each new observation and predict actions reactively, our Action Expert maintains its own history through a long-lived memory and is inherently context-aware. This structure addresses the frequency mismatch between fast control and slow reasoning, enabling efficient independent pretraining of kinematic syntax and modular integration with heavy perception backbones, naturally ensuring spatio-temporally consistent action generation across frames. To synchronize these asynchronous hybrid V-L-A modalities, we utilize a re-anchoring mechanism that mathematically accounts for perception staleness during both training and inference. Experiments on simulated and real-robot manipulation tasks demonstrate that the proposed method can effectively replace traditional chunk-based action heads for both specialist and generalist policies. AR-VLA exhibits superior history awareness and substantially smoother action trajectories while maintaining or exceeding the task success rates of state-of-the-art reactive VLAs. Overall, our work introduces a scalable, context-aware action generation schema that provides a robust structural foundation for training effective robotic policies.

AI.title_translation: AR-VLA：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的真正自回归动作专家
AI.tldr: AR-VLA是一个独立的自回归动作专家，通过维护长期记忆和利用重新锚定机制，生成具有时空一致性的连续动作序列，解决了现有模型中感知-动作频率不匹配的问题，并在模拟和真实机器人操作任务中表现出优越的历史感知能力和更平滑的动作轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和扩散策略在每个新观察时重置时间上下文并被动地预测动作，这与快速控制和缓慢推理之间的频率不匹配相冲突。此外，它们难以保证跨帧的时空一致性动作生成。
AI.method: 提出一个独立的自回归（AR）动作专家，该专家将动作生成为连续的因果序列，同时以可刷新的视觉-语言前缀为条件。该专家通过长期记忆维护自身历史，并具有上下文感知能力。为了同步异步的混合V-L-A模式，采用了一种重新锚定机制来处理感知延迟。AR-VLA可以独立预训练运动学语法，并与重感知骨干模块化集成。
AI.result: 在模拟和真实机器人操作任务的实验表明，AR-VLA可以有效替代传统的基于块的动作头，其历史感知能力和动作轨迹平滑度优于最先进的被动VLA模型，同时保持或超过了任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: AR-VLA是一种可扩展、上下文感知的动作生成模式，为训练有效的机器人策略提供了坚实的基础。它通过解决感知-动作频率不匹配问题，实现了更平滑、时空一致的动作生成。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一个独立的自回归（AR）动作专家，它将动作生成为连续的因果序列，同时以可刷新的视觉-语言前缀为条件。与现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和扩散策略在每次新观察时重置时间上下文并被动预测动作相比，我们的动作专家通过长期记忆维护自身历史，并具有固有的上下文感知能力。这种结构解决了快速控制和缓慢推理之间的频率不匹配问题，能够对运动学语法进行高效的独立预训练，并与重感知骨干模块化集成，自然地保证了跨帧的时空一致性动作生成。为了同步这些异步的混合V-L-A模式，我们利用了一种重新锚定机制，该机制在训练和推理过程中对感知陈旧性进行数学上的解释。在模拟和真实机器人操作任务上的实验表明，我们提出的方法可以有效地替代传统基于块的动作头，无论是对于专家策略还是通用策略。AR-VLA表现出优越的历史感知能力和明显更平滑的动作轨迹，同时保持或超过了最先进的被动VLA的任务成功率。总的来说，我们的工作引入了一种可扩展、上下文感知的动作生成模式，为训练有效的机器人策略提供了坚实的基础。
AI.summary: AR-VLA是一种新颖的自回归动作专家，它通过维护历史记忆和使用重新锚定机制来生成连贯、时空一致的动作序列，解决了现有VLA模型中感知-动作频率不匹配和时空一致性差的问题。实验证明，AR-VLA在机器人操作任务中表现出优越的历史感知能力和更平滑的动作轨迹。
AI.keywords: 自回归动作专家, 视觉-语言-动作模型, 上下文感知, 重新锚定机制, 机器人策略
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的AR-VLA模型，通过引入独立的自回归动作专家和重新锚定机制，有效解决了VLA模型中的关键挑战，如感知-动作频率不匹配和时空一致性问题。该方法在模拟和真实机器人任务中均取得了优异的性能，展示了其在机器人策略训练方面的潜力和可扩展性。然而，对于重新锚定机制在不同复杂度和延迟场景下的鲁棒性，以及与其他先进VLA模型在更广泛任务上的比较，仍有待进一步研究。

title: HG-Lane: High-Fidelity Generation of Lane Scenes under Adverse Weather and Lighting Conditions without Re-annotation
summary: Lane detection is a crucial task in autonomous driving, as it helps ensure the safe operation of vehicles. However, existing datasets such as CULane and TuSimple contain relatively limited data under extreme weather conditions, including rain, snow, and fog. As a result, detection models trained on these datasets often become unreliable in such environments, which may lead to serious safety-critical failures on the road. To address this issue, we propose HG-Lane, a High-fidelity Generation framework for Lane Scenes under adverse weather and lighting conditions without requiring re-annotation. Based on this framework, we further construct a benchmark that includes adverse weather and lighting scenarios, containing 30,000 images. Experimental results demonstrate that our method consistently and significantly improves the performance of existing lane detection networks. For example, using the state-of-the-art CLRNet, the overall mF1 score on our benchmark increases by 20.87 percent. The F1@50 score for the overall, normal, snow, rain, fog, night, and dusk categories increases by 19.75 percent, 8.63 percent, 38.8 percent, 14.96 percent, 26.84 percent, 21.5 percent, and 12.04 percent, respectively. The code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/zdc233/HG-Lane.

AI.title_translation: 恶劣天气和光照条件下的车道场景高保真生成，无需重新标注
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了HG-Lane框架，用于在恶劣天气和光照条件下生成高保真车道场景图像，解决了现有数据集在这方面数据的不足问题。该框架无需重新标注即可生成数据，并构建了一个包含30,000张图像的基准测试集。实验证明，HG-Lane能显著提升现有车道检测网络的性能，例如在CLRNet上，mF1分数提高了20.87%。
AI.motivation: 现有车道检测数据集在极端天气（如雨、雪、雾）下的数据有限，导致在这些环境下训练的模型不可靠，存在安全隐患。因此，需要一种方法来生成包含这些恶劣条件的高质量车道场景数据。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为HG-Lane的高保真生成框架，可在不重新标注的情况下生成恶劣天气和光照条件下的车道场景。基于此框架构建了一个包含30,000张图像的基准测试集，涵盖了各种恶劣天气和光照场景。
AI.result: HG-Lane框架能够显著提高现有车道检测网络的性能。使用HG-Lane和CLRNet，在基准测试集上的整体mF1分数提高了20.87%。在不同场景下的F1@50分数也有显著提升，例如在雨天场景下提高了38.8%。
AI.conclusion: HG-Lane框架成功地解决了现有车道检测数据集在恶劣天气和光照条件下数据不足的问题，并通过生成的数据显著提升了车道检测模型的性能，为自动驾驶的安全运行提供了支持。
AI.translation: 车道检测是自动驾驶中的一项关键任务，有助于确保车辆的安全运行。然而，现有的数据集，如CULane和TuSimple，在极端天气条件（包括雨、雪和雾）下的数据相对有限。因此，在这些数据集上训练的检测模型在这些环境下通常会变得不可靠，这可能导致道路上严重的安全关键故障。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了HG-Lane，一个用于在恶劣天气和光照条件下的车道场景的高保真生成框架，而无需重新标注。基于这个框架，我们进一步构建了一个包含恶劣天气和光照场景的基准测试，包含30,000张图像。实验结果表明，我们的方法能够一致且显著地提高现有车道检测网络的性能。例如，使用最先进的CLRNet，在我们的基准测试上的整体mF1分数提高了20.87%。整体、正常、雪天、雨天、雾天、夜晚和黄昏类别的F1@50分数分别提高了19.75%、8.63%、38.8%、14.96%、26.84%、21.5%和12.04%。代码和数据集可在：https://github.com/zdc233/HG-Lane 获取。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种名为HG-Lane的高保真生成框架，用于在恶劣天气和光照条件下生成车道场景图像，解决了现有数据集在这方面数据不足的问题。该框架无需人工重新标注即可生成数据，并成功构建了一个包含30,000张图像的基准测试集。实验结果表明，HG-Lane能显著提升现有车道检测网络的性能，例如在CLRNet上，整体mF1分数提高了20.87%。
AI.keywords: 车道检测, 恶劣天气, 高保真生成, 自动驾驶, 数据集
AI.comments: 该研究提出的HG-Lane框架在解决自动驾驶领域车道检测在恶劣天气和光照条件下性能下降的问题上具有重要意义。无需重新标注即可生成高保真数据是该方法的一大亮点，大大降低了数据获取的成本和难度。所构建的基准测试集为评估和改进相关算法提供了有力的支撑。然而，该研究并未深入探讨生成模型在不同类型恶劣天气下的泛化能力和鲁棒性，以及其在真实世界部署中的潜在挑战。

title: The Prediction-Measurement Gap: Toward Meaning Representations as Scientific Instruments
summary: Text embeddings have become central to computational social science and psychology, enabling scalable measurement of meaning and mixed-method inference. Yet most representation learning is optimized and evaluated for prediction and retrieval, yielding a prediction-measurement gap: representations that perform well as features may be poorly suited as scientific instruments. The paper argues that scientific meaning analysis motivates a distinct family of objectives - scientific usability - emphasizing geometric legibility, interpretability and traceability to linguistic evidence, robustness to non-semantic confounds, and compatibility with regression-style inference over semantic directions. Grounded in cognitive and neuro-psychological views of meaning, the paper assesses static word embeddings and contextual transformer representations against these requirements: static spaces remain attractive for transparent measurement, whereas contextual spaces offer richer semantics but entangle meaning with other signals and exhibit geometric and interpretability issues that complicate inference. The paper then outlines a course-setting agenda around (i) geometry-first design for gradients and abstraction, including hierarchy-aware spaces constrained by psychologically privileged levels; (ii) invertible post-hoc transformations that recondition embedding geometry and reduce nuisance influence; and (iii) meaning atlases and measurement-oriented evaluation protocols for reliable and traceable semantic inference. As the field debates the limits of scale-first progress, measurement-ready representations offer a principled new frontier.

title: Unbalanced Optimal Transport Dictionary Learning for Unsupervised Hyperspectral Image Clustering
summary: Hyperspectral images capture vast amounts of high-dimensional spectral information about a scene, making labeling an intensive task that is resistant to out-of-the-box statistical methods. Unsupervised learning of clusters allows for automated segmentation of the scene, enabling a more rapid understanding of the image. Partitioning the spectral information contained within the data via dictionary learning in Wasserstein space has proven an effective method for unsupervised clustering. However, this approach requires balancing the spectral profiles of the data, blurring the classes, and sacrificing robustness to outliers and noise. In this paper, we suggest improving this approach by utilizing unbalanced Wasserstein barycenters to learn a lower-dimensional representation of the underlying data. The deployment of spectral clustering on the learned representation results in an effective approach for the unsupervised learning of labels.

title: Agentic Control Center for Data Product Optimization
summary: Data products enable end users to gain greater insights about their data by providing supporting assets, such as example question-SQL pairs which can be answered using the data or views over the database tables. However, producing useful data products is challenging, and typically requires domain experts to hand-craft supporting assets. We propose a system that automates data product improvement through specialized AI agents operating in a continuous optimization loop. By surfacing questions, monitoring multi-dimensional quality metrics, and supporting human-in-the-loop controls, it transforms data into observable and refinable assets that balance automation with trust and oversight.

title: Data-Driven Successive Linearization for Optimal Voltage Control
summary: Power distribution systems are increasingly exposed to large voltage fluctuations driven by intermittent solar photovoltaic generation and rapidly varying loads (e.g., electric vehicles and storage). To address this challenge, a number of advanced controllers have been proposed for voltage regulation. However, these controllers typically rely on fixed linear approximations of voltage dynamics. As a result, the solutions may become infeasible when applied to the actual voltage behavior governed by nonlinear power flow equations, particularly under heavy power injection from distributed energy resources. This paper proposes a data-driven successive linearization approach for voltage control under nonlinear power flow constraints. By leveraging the fact that the deviation between the nonlinear power flow solution and its linearization is bounded by the distance from the operating point, we perform data-driven linearization around the most recent operating point. Convergence of the proposed method to a neighborhood of KKT points is established by exploiting the convexity of the objective function and the structural properties of the nonlinear constraints. Case studies show that the proposed approach achieves fast convergence and adapts quickly to changes in net load.

title: The Generation-Recognition Asymmetry: Six Dimensions of a Fundamental Divide in Formal Language Theory
comments: Submitted to Information and Computation. 32 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables
summary: Every formal grammar defines a language and can in principle be used in three ways: to generate strings (production), to recognize them (parsing), or -- given only examples -- to infer the grammar itself (grammar induction). Generation and recognition are extensionally equivalent -- they characterize the same set -- but operationally asymmetric in multiple independent ways. Inference is a qualitatively harder problem: it does not have access to a known grammar. Despite the centrality of this triad to compiler design, natural language processing, and formal language theory, no survey has treated it as a unified, multidimensional phenomenon. We identify six dimensions along which generation and recognition diverge: computational complexity, ambiguity, directionality, information availability, grammar inference, and temporality. We show that the common characterization "generation is easy, parsing is hard" is misleading: unconstrained generation is trivial, but generation under constraints can be NP-hard. The real asymmetry is that parsing is always constrained (the input is given) while generation need not be. Two of these dimensions -- directionality and temporality -- have not previously been identified as dimensions of the generation-recognition asymmetry. We connect the temporal dimension to the surprisal framework of Hale (2001) and Levy (2008), arguing that surprisal formalizes the temporal asymmetry between a generator (surprisal = 0) and a parser that predicts under uncertainty (surprisal > 0). We review bidirectional systems in NLP and observe that bidirectionality has been available for fifty years yet has not transferred to most domain-specific applications. We conclude with a discussion of large language models, which architecturally unify generation and recognition while operationally preserving the asymmetry.

title: Reason and Verify: A Framework for Faithful Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) significantly improves the factuality of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet standard pipelines often lack mechanisms to verify inter- mediate reasoning, leaving them vulnerable to hallucinations in high-stakes domains. To address this, we propose a domain-specific RAG framework that integrates explicit rea- soning and faithfulness verification. Our architecture augments standard retrieval with neural query rewriting, BGE-based cross-encoder reranking, and a rationale generation module that grounds sub-claims in specific evidence spans. We further introduce an eight-category verification taxonomy that enables fine-grained assessment of rationale faithfulness, distinguishing between explicit and implicit support patterns to facilitate structured error diagnosis. We evaluate this framework on the BioASQ and PubMedQA benchmarks, specifically analyzing the impact of dynamic in-context learning and rerank- ing under constrained token budgets. Experiments demonstrate that explicit rationale generation improves accuracy over vanilla RAG baselines, while dynamic demonstration selection combined with robust reranking yields further gains in few-shot settings. Using Llama-3-8B-Instruct, our approach achieves 89.1% on BioASQ-Y/N and 73.0% on Pub- MedQA, competitive with systems using significantly larger models. Additionally, we perform a pilot study combining human expert assessment with LLM-based verification to explore how explicit rationale generation improves system transparency and enables more detailed diagnosis of retrieval failures in biomedical question answering.

title: Lost in Backpropagation: The LM Head is a Gradient Bottleneck
summary: The last layer of neural language models (LMs) projects output features of dimension $D$ to logits in dimension $V$, the size of the vocabulary, where usually $D \ll V$. This mismatch is known to raise risks of limited expressivity in neural LMs, creating a so-called softmax bottleneck. We show the softmax bottleneck is not only an expressivity bottleneck but also an optimization bottleneck. Backpropagating $V$-dimensional gradients through a rank-$D$ linear layer induces unavoidable compression, which alters the training feedback provided to the vast majority of the parameters. We present a theoretical analysis of this phenomenon and measure empirically that 95-99% of the gradient norm is suppressed by the output layer, resulting in vastly suboptimal update directions. We conduct controlled pretraining experiments showing that the gradient bottleneck makes trivial patterns unlearnable, and drastically affects the training dynamics of LLMs. We argue that this inherent flaw contributes to training inefficiencies at scale independently of the model architecture, and raises the need for new LM head designs.

title: Social Knowledge for Cross-Domain User Preference Modeling
summary: We demonstrate that user preferences can be represented and predicted across topical domains using large-scale social modeling. Given information about popular entities favored by a user, we project the user into a social embedding space learned from a large-scale sample of the Twitter (now X) network. By representing both users and popular entities in a joint social space, we can assess the relevance of candidate entities (e.g., music artists) using cosine similarity within this embedding space. A comprehensive evaluation using link prediction experiments shows that this method achieves effective personalization in zero-shot setting, when no user feedback is available for entities in the target domain, yielding substantial improvements over a strong popularity-based baseline. In-depth analysis further illustrates that socio-demographic factors encoded in the social embeddings are correlated with user preferences across domains. Finally, we argue and demonstrate that the proposed approach can facilitate social modeling of end users using large language models (LLMs).

title: A neural operator for predicting vibration frequency response curves from limited data
summary: In the design of engineered components, rigorous vibration testing is essential for performance validation and identification of resonant frequencies and amplitudes encountered during operation. Performing this evaluation numerically via machine learning has great potential to accelerate design iteration and make testing workflows more efficient. However, dynamical systems are conventionally difficult to solve via machine learning methods without using physics-based regularizing loss functions. To properly perform this forecasting task, a structure that has an inspectable physical obedience can be devised without the use of regularizing terms from first principles. The method employed in this work is a neural operator integrated with an implicit numerical scheme. This architecture enables operators to learn of the underlying state-space dynamics from limited data, allowing generalization to untested driving frequencies and initial conditions. This network can infer the system's global frequency response by training on a small set of input conditions. As a foundational proof of concept, this investigation verifies the machine learning algorithm with a linear, single-degree-of-freedom system, demonstrating implicit obedience of dynamics. This approach demonstrates 99.87% accuracy in predicting the Frequency Response Curve (FRC), forecasting the frequency and amplitude of linear resonance training on 7% of the bandwidth of the solution. By training machine learning models to internalize physics information rather than trajectory, better generalization accuracy can be realized, vastly improving the timeframe for vibration studies on engineered components.

title: Performance Evaluation of Delay Tolerant Network Protocols to Improve Nepal Earthquake Rescue Communications
summary: In the fields of disaster rescue and communication in extreme environments, Delay Tolerant Network (DTN) has become an important technology due to its "store-carry-forward" mechanism. Selecting the appropriate routing strategy is of crucial significance for improving the success rate of distress message transmission and reducing delays in material dispatch. We design a pseudo realistic use case of Nepal Kathmandu earthquake rescue based on dynamically changing population distribution model and characteristics of rescue activities in the initial rescue efforts in Nepal Kathmandu earthquakes to conducted the multi criteria two benchmark routing protocols performance analysis in the face of different buffer sizes of the rescue team nodes. We identify multiple real world node groups, including affected residents, rescue teams, drones and ground vehicles and communication models are established according to the movement behaviors of these groups. We analyze the communication of distress messages between edge nodes to obtain performance metrics such as delivered probability, average delay, hop count, and buffer time. By analyzing the multi layer complex data and protocols differences, the research results show the effectiveness of distributed DTN communication methods in the Nepal earthquake rescue use case, reveal existence of trade-offs between transmission reliability and resource utilization of different routing protocols in disaster communication environment and provide a basis for the design of next-generation emergency communication services based on edge nodes.

title: Mashup Learning: Faster Finetuning by Remixing Past Checkpoints
summary: Finetuning on domain-specific data is a well-established method for enhancing LLM performance on downstream tasks. Training on each dataset produces a new set of model weights, resulting in a multitude of checkpoints saved in-house or on open-source platforms. However, these training artifacts are rarely reused for subsequent experiments despite containing improved model abilities for potentially similar tasks. In this paper, we propose Mashup Learning, a simple method to leverage the outputs of prior training runs to enhance model adaptation to new tasks. Our procedure identifies the most relevant historical checkpoints for a target dataset, aggregates them with model merging, and uses the result as an improved initialization for training. Across 8 standard LLM benchmarks, four models, and two collections of source checkpoints, Mashup Learning consistently improves average downstream accuracy by 0.5-5 percentage points over training from scratch. It also accelerates convergence, requiring 41-46% fewer training steps and up to 37% less total wall-clock time to match from-scratch accuracy, including all selection and merging overhead.

title: Cross-Hand Latent Representation for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Dexterous manipulation is essential for real-world robot autonomy, mirroring the central role of human hand coordination in daily activity. Humans rely on rich multimodal perception--vision, sound, and language-guided intent--to perform dexterous actions, motivating vision-based, language-conditioned manipulation systems for robots. However, training reliable vision-language-action (VLA) models for dexterous manipulation requires large-scale demonstrations across many robotic hands. In addition, as new dexterous embodiments appear rapidly, collecting data for each becomes costly and impractical, creating a need for scalable cross-embodiment learning. We introduce XL-VLA, a vision-language-action framework integrated with a unified latent action space shared across diverse dexterous hands. This embodiment-invariant latent space is directly pluggable into standard VLA architectures, enabling seamless cross-embodiment training and efficient reuse of both existing and newly collected data. Experimental results demonstrate that XL-VLA consistently outperforms baseline VLA models operating in raw joint spaces, establishing it as an effective solution for scalable cross-embodiment dexterous manipulation.

title: ReMix: Reinforcement routing for mixtures of LoRAs in LLM finetuning
summary: Low-rank adapters (LoRAs) are a parameter-efficient finetuning technique that injects trainable low-rank matrices into pretrained models to adapt them to new tasks. Mixture-of-LoRAs models expand neural networks efficiently by routing each layer input to a small subset of specialized LoRAs of the layer. Existing Mixture-of-LoRAs routers assign a learned routing weight to each LoRA to enable end-to-end training of the router. Despite their empirical promise, we observe that the routing weights are typically extremely imbalanced across LoRAs in practice, where only one or two LoRAs often dominate the routing weights. This essentially limits the number of effective LoRAs and thus severely hinders the expressive power of existing Mixture-of-LoRAs models. In this work, we attribute this weakness to the nature of learnable routing weights and rethink the fundamental design of the router. To address this critical issue, we propose a new router designed that we call Reinforcement Routing for Mixture-of-LoRAs (ReMix). Our key idea is using non-learnable routing weights to ensure all active LoRAs to be equally effective, with no LoRA dominating the routing weights. However, our routers cannot be trained directly via gradient descent due to our non-learnable routing weights. Hence, we further propose an unbiased gradient estimator for the router by employing the reinforce leave-one-out (RLOO) technique, where we regard the supervision loss as the reward and the router as the policy in reinforcement learning. Our gradient estimator also enables to scale up training compute to boost the predictive performance of our ReMix. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed ReMix significantly outperform state-of-the-art parameter-efficient finetuning methods under a comparable number of activated parameters.

title: Compatibility at a Cost: Systematic Discovery and Exploitation of MCP Clause-Compliance Vulnerabilities
summary:
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a recently proposed interoperability standard that unifies how AI agents connect with external tools and data sources. By defining a set of common client-server message exchange clauses, MCP replaces fragmented integrations with a standardized, plug-and-play framework. However, to be compatible with diverse AI agents, the MCP specification relaxes many behavioral constraints into optional clauses, leading to misuse-prone SDK implementation. We identify it as a new attack surface that allows adversaries to achieve multiple attacks (e.g, silent prompt injection, DoS, etc.), named as \emph{compatibility-abusing attacks}.
  In this work, we present the first systematic framework for analyzing this new attack surface across multi-language MCP SDKs. First, we construct a universal and language-agnostic intermediate representation (IR) generator that normalizes SDKs of different languages. Next, based on the new IR, we propose auditable static analysis with LLM-guided semantic reasoning for cross-language/clause compliance analysis. Third, by formalizing the attack semantics of the MCP clauses, we build three attack modalities and develop a modality-guided pipeline to uncover exploitable non-compliance issues.

title: OpenClaw-RL: Train Any Agent Simply by Talking
summary: Every agent interaction generates a next-state signal, namely the user reply, tool output, terminal or GUI state change that follows each action, yet no existing agentic RL system recovers it as a live, online learning source. We present OpenClaw-RL, a framework built on a simple observation: next-state signals are universal, and policy can learn from all of them simultaneously. Personal conversations, terminal executions, GUI interactions, SWE tasks, and tool-call traces are not separate training problems. They are all interactions that can be used to train the same policy in the same loop. Next-state signals encode two forms of information: evaluative signals, which indicate how well the action performed and are extracted as scalar rewards via a PRM judge; and directive signals, which indicate how the action should have been different and are recovered through Hindsight-Guided On-Policy Distillation (OPD). We extract textual hints from the next state, construct an enhanced teacher context, and provide token-level directional advantage supervision that is richer than any scalar reward. Due to the asynchronous design, the model serves live requests, the PRM judges ongoing interactions, and the trainer updates the policy at the same time, with zero coordination overhead between them. Applied to personal agents, OpenClaw-RL enables an agent to improve simply by being used, recovering conversational signals from user re-queries, corrections, and explicit feedback. Applied to general agents, the same infrastructure supports scalable RL across terminal, GUI, SWE, and tool-call settings, where we additionally demonstrate the utility of process rewards. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/OpenClaw-RL

title: Dance2Hesitate: A Multi-Modal Dataset of Dancer-Taught Hesitancy for Understandable Robot Motion
comments: Accepted to the Designing Transparent and Understandable Robots (D-TUR) Workshop at the ACM/IEEE International Conference on Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) 2026, Edinburgh, UK
summary: In human-robot collaboration, a robot's expression of hesitancy is a critical factor that shapes human coordination strategies, attention allocation, and safety-related judgments. However, designing hesitant robot motion that generalizes is challenging because the observer's inference is highly dependent on embodiment and context. To address these challenges, we introduce and open-source a multi-modal, dancer-generated dataset of hesitant motion where we focus on specific context-embodiment pairs (i.e., manipulator/human upper-limb approaching a Jenga Tower, and anthropomorphic whole body motion in free space). The dataset includes (i) kinesthetic teaching demonstrations on a Franka Emika Panda reaching from a fixed start configuration to a fixed target (a Jenga tower) with three graded hesitancy levels (slight, significant, extreme) and (ii) synchronized RGB-D motion capture of dancers performing the same reaching behavior using their upper limb across three hesitancy levels, plus full human body sequences for extreme hesitancy. We further provide documentation to enable reproducible benchmarking across robot and human modalities. Across all dancers, we obtained 70 unique whole-body trajectories, 84 upper limb trajectories spanning over the three hesitancy levels, and 66 kinesthetic teaching trajectories spanning over the three hesitancy levels. The dataset can be accessed here: https://brsrikrishna.github.io/Dance2Hesitate/.

title: Characterizing Healthy & Post-Stroke Neuromotor Behavior During 6D Upper-Limb Isometric Gaming: Implications for Design of End-Effector Rehabilitation Robot Interfaces
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Successful robot-mediated rehabilitation requires designing games and robot interventions that promote healthy motor practice. However, the interplay between a given user's neuromotor behavior, the gaming interface, and the physical robot makes designing system elements -- and even characterizing what behaviors are "healthy" or pathological -- challenging. We leverage our OpenRobotRehab 1.0 open access data set to assess the characteristics of 13 healthy and 2 post-stroke users' force output, muscle activations, and game performance while executing isometric trajectory tracking tasks using an end-effector rehabilitation robot. We present an assessment of how subtle aspects of interface design impact user behavior; an analysis of how pathological neuromotor behaviors are reflected in end-effector force dynamics; and a novel hidden Markov model (HMM)-based neuromotor behavior classification method based on surface electromyography (sEMG) signals during cyclic motions. We demonstrate that task specification (including which axes are constrained and how users interpret tracking instructions) shapes user behavior; that pathology-related features are detectable in 6D end-effector force data during isometric task execution (with significant differences between healthy and post-stroke profiles in force error and average force production at $p=0.05$); and that healthy neuromotor strategies are heterogeneous and inherently difficult to characterize. We also show that our HMM-based models discriminate healthy and post-stroke neuromotor dynamics where synergy-based decompositions reflect no such differentiation. Lastly, we discuss these results' implications for the design of adaptive end-effector rehabilitation robots capable of promoting healthier movement strategies across diverse user populations.
