title: SpecOps: A Fully Automated AI Agent Testing Framework in Real-World GUI Environments
summary: Autonomous AI agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, where reliable and robust behavior is critical. However, existing agent evaluation frameworks either rely heavily on manual efforts, operate within simulated environments, or lack focus on testing complex, multimodal, real-world agents. We introduce SpecOps, a novel, fully automated testing framework designed to evaluate GUI-based AI agents in real-world environments. SpecOps decomposes the testing process into four specialized phases - test case generation, environment setup, test execution, and validation - each handled by a distinct LLM-based specialist agent. This structured architecture addresses key challenges including end-to-end task coherence, robust error handling, and adaptability across diverse agent platforms including CLI tools, web apps, and browser extensions. In comprehensive evaluations across five diverse real-world agents, SpecOps outperforms baselines including general-purpose agentic systems such as AutoGPT and LLM-crafted automation scripts in planning accuracy, execution success, and bug detection effectiveness. SpecOps identifies 164 true bugs in the real-world agents with an F1 score of 0.89. With a cost of under 0.73 USD and a runtime of under eight minutes per test, it demonstrates its practical viability and superiority in automated, real-world agent testing.

title: HiFIVE: High-Fidelity Vector-Tile Reduction for Interactive Map Exploration
summary: Interactive visualization is a common tool for exploring large open-data repositories, where users quickly explore datasets across diverse domains. When it comes to large-scale spatial data, many existing tools rely on server-side rendering to produce small images that can be viewed at the client-side. However, most users prefer client-side rendering that allows quick styling of the data for better visualization experience. This paper presents HiFIVE, a data-management framework for scalable, high-fidelity client-side geospatial visualization. We formalize the visualization-aware tile reduction problem, which captures the trade-off between tile-size and visualization distortion, and prove its NP-hardness. HiFIVE introduces a two-stage solution combining triage and sparsification to selectively prune records, attributes, and values based on information-theoretic and spatial criteria. Experiments demonstrate substantial tile-size reductions while preserving visual fidelity and interactive performance at terabyte scale.

title: Post-Quantum Entropy as a Service for Embedded Systems
summary: Embedded cryptography stands or falls on entropy quality, yet small devices have few trustworthy sources and little tolerance for heavyweight protocols. We build a Quantum Entropy as a Service (QEaaS) system that moves QRNG-derived entropy from a Quantis device to ESP32-class clients over post-quantum-secured channels. On the server side, the design exposes two paths: direct quantum entropy through a custom OpenSSL provider and mixed entropy through the Linux system pool. On the client side, we extend libcoap's Zephyr support, integrate wolfSSL-based DTLS 1.3 into the CoAP stack, and add a BLAKE2s entropy pool that preserves the standard Zephyr extraction interface while introducing an injection API for server-provided entropy. Benchmarks on ESP32 hardware, targeting 100 iterations per configuration, show that ML-KEM-512 completes a DTLS 1.3 handshake in 313 ms on average without certificate verification, 35% faster than ECDHE P-256. Pairing ML-KEM-512 with ML-DSA-44 lowers the mean to 225 ms. Certificate verification adds roughly 194 ms for ECDSA but only 17 ms for ML-DSA-44, so the fully post-quantum configuration remains 63% faster than classical ECDHE P-256 with ECDSA even under full verification. Local BLAKE2s pool operations stay below 0.1 ms combined. On this platform, post-quantum key exchange and authentication are not only feasible; they are faster than the classical baseline.

title: Optimal Control Synthesis of Closed-Loop Recommendation Systems over Social Networks
summary: This paper addresses the problem of designing recommendation systems for social networks and e-commerce platforms from a control-theoretic perspective. We treat the design of recommendation systems as a state-feedback infinite-horizon optimal control problem with a performance index that (i) rewards alignment and engagement, (ii) penalizes polarization and large deviations from an uncontrolled baseline, and (iii) regularizes exposure across neighboring users. The recommendation entries are fed to the platform users, who are assumed to follow a networked, multi-topic, continuous-time opinion dynamics. We show that the designed control yields a stabilizing recommendation system under simple algebraic spectral conditions on the weights that encode the platform's preference for engagement, stability of preferences, polarization, and cross-user diversity. Conversely, we show that when ill-posed weights are selected in the optimal control problem (namely, when engagement is excessively rewarded), the closed-loop system can exhibit destabilizing, pathological behaviors that conflict with the design objectives.

title: Estimating condition number with Graph Neural Networks
summary: In this paper, we propose a fast method for estimating the condition number of sparse matrices using graph neural networks (GNNs). To enable efficient training and inference of GNNs, our proposed feature engineering for GNNs achieves $\mathrm{O}(\mathrm{nnz} + n)$, where $\mathrm{nnz}$ is the number of non-zero elements in the matrix and $n$ denotes the matrix dimension. We propose two prediction schemes for estimating the matrix condition number using GNNs. The extensive experiments for the two schemes are conducted for 1-norm and 2-norm condition number estimation, which show that our method achieves a significant speedup over the Hager-Higham and Lanczos methods.

title: Robust Post-Training for Generative Recommenders: Why Exponential Reward-Weighted SFT Outperforms RLHF
summary: Aligning generative recommender systems to user preferences via post-training is critical for closing the gap between next-item prediction and actual recommendation quality. Existing post-training methods are ill-suited for production-scale systems: RLHF methods reward hack due to noisy user feedback and unreliable reward models, offline RL alternatives require propensity scores that are unavailable, and online interaction is infeasible. We identify exponential reward-weighted SFT with weights $w = \exp(r/λ)$ as uniquely suited to this setting, and provide the theoretical and empirical foundations that explain why. By optimizing directly on observed rewards without querying a learned reward model, the method is immune to reward hacking, requires no propensity scores, and is fully offline. We prove the first policy improvement guarantees for this setting under noisy rewards, showing that the gap scales only logarithmically with catalog size and remains informative even for large item catalogs. Crucially, we show that temperature $λ$ explicitly and quantifiably controls the robustness-improvement tradeoff, providing practitioners with a single interpretable regularization hyperparameter with theoretical grounding. Experiments on three open-source and one proprietary dataset against four baselines confirm that exponential reward weighting is simple, scalable, and consistently outperforms RLHF-based alternatives.

title: Taming Score-Based Denoisers in ADMM: A Convergent Plug-and-Play Framework
summary: While score-based generative models have emerged as powerful priors for solving inverse problems, directly integrating them into optimization algorithms such as ADMM remains nontrivial. Two central challenges arise: i) the mismatch between the noisy data manifolds used to train the score functions and the geometry of ADMM iterates, especially due to the influence of dual variables, and ii) the lack of convergence understanding when ADMM is equipped with score-based denoisers. To address the manifold mismatch issue, we propose ADMM plug-and-play (ADMM-PnP) with the AC-DC denoiser, a new framework that embeds a three-stage denoiser into ADMM: (1) auto-correction (AC) via additive Gaussian noise, (2) directional correction (DC) using conditional Langevin dynamics, and (3) score-based denoising. In terms of convergence, we establish two results: first, under proper denoiser parameters, each ADMM iteration is a weakly nonexpansive operator, ensuring high-probability fixed-point $\textit{ball convergence}$ using a constant step size; second, under more relaxed conditions, the AC-DC denoiser is a bounded denoiser, which leads to convergence under an adaptive step size schedule. Experiments on a range of inverse problems demonstrate that our method consistently improves solution quality over a variety of baselines.

title: Update-Free On-Policy Steering via Verifiers
summary: In recent years, Behavior Cloning (BC) has become one of the most prevalent methods for enabling robots to mimic human demonstrations. However, despite their successes, BC policies are often brittle and struggle with precise manipulation. To overcome these issues, we propose UF-OPS, an Update-Free On-Policy Steering method that enables the robot to predict the success likelihood of its actions and adapt its strategy at execution time. We accomplish this by training verifier functions using policy rollout data obtained during an initial evaluation of the policy. These verifiers are subsequently used to steer the base policy toward actions with a higher likelihood of success. Our method improves the performance of black-box diffusion policy, without changing the base parameters, making it light-weight and flexible. We present results from both simulation and real-world data and achieve an average 49% improvement in success rate over the base policy across 5 real tasks.

title: GSVD for Geometry-Grounded Dataset Comparison: An Alignment Angle Is All You Need
summary: Geometry-grounded learning asks models to respect structure in the problem domain rather than treating observations as arbitrary vectors. Motivated by this view, we revisit a classical but underused primitive for comparing datasets: linear relations between two data matrices, expressed via the co-span constraint $Ax = By = z$ in a shared ambient space. To operationalize this comparison, we use the generalized singular value decomposition (GSVD) as a joint coordinate system for two subspaces. In particular, we exploit the GSVD form $A = HCU$, $B = HSV$ with $C^{\top}C + S^{\top}S = I$, which separates shared versus dataset-specific directions through the diagonal structure of $(C, S)$. From these factors we derive an interpretable *angle score* $θ(z) \in [0, π/2]$ for a sample $z$, quantifying whether z is explained relatively more by $A$, more by $B$, or comparably by both. The primary role of $θ(z)$ is as a *per-sample geometric diagnostic*. We illustrate the behavior of the score on MNIST through angle distributions and representative GSVD directions. A binary classifier derived from $θ(z)$ is presented as an illustrative application of the score as an interpretable diagnostic tool.

title: Copula-ResLogit: A Deep-Copula Framework for Unobserved Confounding Effects
summary: A key challenge in travel demand analysis is the presence of unobserved factors that may generate non-causal dependencies, obscuring the true causal effects. To address the issue, the study introduces a novel deep learning based fully interpretable joint modelling framework, Copula-ResLogit, which integrates the flexibility of Residual Neural Network (ResNet) architectures with the dependence capturing capabilities of copula models. This hybrid structure enables us to first detect unobserved confounding through traditional copula function based joint modelling and then mitigate these hidden associations by incorporating deep learning components. The study applies this framework to two case studies, including the relationship between stress levels and wait time of pedestrians when crossing mid block in VR and the dependencies between travel mode choice and travel distance in London travel behaviour data. Results show that Copula-ResLogit substantially reduces or eliminates the dependencies, demonstrating the ability of residual layers to account for hidden confounding effects.

title: Conversational AI-Enhanced Exploration System to Query Large-Scale Digitised Collections of Natural History Museums
summary: Recent digitisation efforts in natural history museums have produced large volumes of collection data, yet their scale and scientific complexity often hinder public access and understanding. Conventional data management tools, such as databases, restrict exploration through keyword-based search or require specialised schema knowledge. This paper presents a system design that uses conversational AI to query nearly 1.7 million digitised specimen records from the life-science collections of the Australian Museum. Designed and developed through a human-centred design process, the system contains an interactive map for visual-spatial exploration and a natural-language conversational agent that retrieves detailed specimen data and answers collection-specific questions. The system leverages function-calling capabilities of contemporary large language models to dynamically retrieve structured data from external APIs, enabling fast, real-time interaction with extensive yet frequently updated datasets. Our work provides a new approach of connecting large museum collections with natural language-based queries and informs future designs of scientific AI agents for natural history museums.

title: Instant Runoff Voting on Graphs: Exclusion Zones and Distortion
summary: We study instant-runoff voting (IRV) under metric preferences induced by an unweighted graph where each vertex hosts a voter, candidates occupy some vertices (with a single candidate allowed in such a vertex), and voters rank candidates by shortest-path distance with fixed deterministic tie-breaking. We focus on exclusion zones, vertex sets S such that whenever some candidate lies in S, the IRV winner must also lie in S. While testing whether a given set S is an exclusion zone is co-NP-Complete and finding the minimum exclusion zone is NP-hard in general graphs, we show here that both problems can be solved in polynomial time on trees. Our approach solves zone testing by designing a Kill membership test (can a designated candidate be forced to lose using opponents from a restricted set?) and shows that Kill can be decided in polynomial time on trees via a bottom-up dynamic program that certifies whether the designated candidate can be eliminated in round 1. A greedy shrinking process then recovers the minimum zone under a standard nesting assumption. To clarify the limits of tractability beyond trees, we also identify a rule level property (Strong Forced Elimination) that abstracts the key IRV behavior used in prior reductions, and show that both exclusion-zone verification and minimum- zone computation remain co-NP-complete and NP-hard, respectively, for any deterministic rank-based elimination rule satisfying this property. Finally, we relate IRV to utilitarian distortion in this discrete setting, and we present upper and lower bounds with regard to the distortion of IRV for several scenarios, including perfect binary trees and unweighted graphs.

title: Hybrid Self-evolving Structured Memory for GUI Agents
summary: The remarkable progress of vision-language models (VLMs) has enabled GUI agents to interact with computers in a human-like manner. Yet real-world computer-use tasks remain difficult due to long-horizon workflows, diverse interfaces, and frequent intermediate errors. Prior work equips agents with external memory built from large collections of trajectories, but relies on flat retrieval over discrete summaries or continuous embeddings, falling short of the structured organization and self-evolving characteristics of human memory. Inspired by the brain, we propose Hybrid Self-evolving Structured Memory (HyMEM), a graph-based memory that couples discrete high-level symbolic nodes with continuous trajectory embeddings. HyMEM maintains a graph structure to support multi-hop retrieval, self-evolution via node update operations, and on-the-fly working-memory refreshing during inference. Extensive experiments show that HyMEM consistently improves open-source GUI agents, enabling 7B/8B backbones to match or surpass strong closed-source models; notably, it boosts Qwen2.5-VL-7B by +22.5% and outperforms Gemini2.5-Pro-Vision and GPT-4o.

title: Inverse Learning-Based Output Feedback Control of Nonlinear Systems with Verifiable Guarantees
summary: In this paper, we present a data-driven output feedback controller for nonlinear systems that achieves practical output regulation, using noise-free input/output measurement data. The proposed controller is based on (i) an inverse model of the system identified via kernel interpolation, which maps a desired output and the current state to the corresponding desired control input; and (ii) a data-driven reference selection framework that actively chooses a suitable desired output from the dataset which has been used for the identification. We establish a verifiable sufficient condition on the dataset under which the proposed controller guarantees practical output regulation. Numerical simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed controller, with additional evaluations in the presence of output measurement noise to assess its robustness empirically.

title: Simulation-in-the-Reasoning (SiR): A Conceptual Framework for Empirically Grounded AI in Autonomous Transportation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have advanced reasoning through techniques like Chain-of-Thought (CoT). However, their reasoning largely re-mains textual and hypothetical, lacking empirical grounding in complex, dynamic domains like transportation. This paper introduces Simulation-in-the-Reasoning (SiR), a novel conceptual framework that embeds domain-specific simulators directly into the LLM reasoning loop. By treating intermediate reasoning steps as executable simulation experiments, SiR transforms LLM reasoning from narrative plausibility into a falsifiable, hypothesis-simulate-analyze workflow. We discuss applications, where LLM can formulate Intelligent Transport System (ITS) strategy hypotheses, invoke a traffic simulator via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), evaluate results under different demand patterns, and refine strategies through verification and aggregation. While implementing the framework is part of our ongoing work, this paper primarily establishes the conceptual foundation, discusses design considerations like API granularity, and outlines the vision of SiR as a cornerstone for interactive transportation digital twins. We argue that SiR represents a critical step towards trustworthy, empirically-validated AI for autonomous transportation systems.

AI.title_translation: 推理中的仿真 (SiR)：一种用于自动驾驶中经验证实的AI概念框架
AI.tldr: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在交通等动态领域缺乏经验基础的推理。SiR提出将领域特定仿真器嵌入LLM推理中，将其转化为可证伪的、假设-仿真-分析的工作流，以实现自动驾驶中可信赖的AI。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的推理，尽管通过思维链（CoT）等技术有所进步，但仍主要停留在文本和假设层面，在交通等复杂动态领域中缺乏经验基础。
AI.method: 本文引入了推理中的仿真（SiR），这是一个概念框架，它将特定领域的仿真器直接嵌入到LLM的推理循环中。通过将中间推理步骤视为可执行的仿真实验，SiR将LLM推理从叙述性合理性转变为可证伪的、假设-仿真-分析的工作流程。这包括LLM制定智能交通系统（ITS）策略假设，通过模型上下文协议（MCP）调用交通仿真器，评估结果并在不同需求模式下完善策略。
AI.result: 本文建立了SiR的概念基础，讨论了诸如API粒度等设计考虑，并概述了SiR作为交互式交通数字孪生基石的愿景。它将LLM推理转化为可证伪的、假设-仿真-分析的工作流程。
AI.conclusion: SiR代表了迈向自动驾驶系统中值得信赖、经过经验验证的AI的关键一步。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通过思维链（CoT）等技术推动了推理的发展。然而，它们的推理在很大程度上仍然是文本和假设性的，在交通等复杂、动态的领域中缺乏经验基础。本文引入了推理中的仿真（Simulation-in-the-Reasoning, SiR），一个新颖的概念框架，它将特定领域的仿真器直接嵌入到LLM推理循环中。通过将中间推理步骤视为可执行的仿真实验，SiR将LLM推理从叙述性合理性转变为可证伪的、假设-仿真-分析的工作流程。我们讨论了应用，其中LLM可以制定智能交通系统（ITS）策略假设，通过模型上下文协议（MCP）调用交通仿真器，在不同需求模式下评估结果，并通过验证和聚合来完善策略。虽然框架的实现是我们正在进行的工作的一部分，但本文主要建立了概念基础，讨论了诸如API粒度等设计考虑，并概述了SiR作为交互式交通数字孪生基石的愿景。我们认为SiR代表了迈向自动驾驶系统中值得信赖、经过经验验证的AI的关键一步。
AI.summary: 本文提出了推理中的仿真（SiR）概念框架，旨在解决大型语言模型（LLMs）在交通等动态领域中缺乏经验验证推理的问题。SiR通过将领域特定仿真器直接嵌入LLM推理循环，将推理过程转化为可证伪的、假设-仿真-分析的工作流，从而使LLMs能够制定、评估和完善智能交通策略。该框架被视为实现自动驾驶中可信赖、经验证AI的关键一步。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 推理中的仿真, 自动驾驶, 经验验证AI, 交通仿真
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将外部、领域特定的仿真器直接整合到大型语言模型（LLM）的推理循环中，从而将纯文本推理转化为可实验、可证伪的科学验证过程。这对于需要高可靠性和安全性（如自动驾驶）的实际应用至关重要，为构建可信赖、经验证的AI系统提供了新的范式。然而，目前该框架仍处于概念阶段，具体的实现和实证验证是未来的工作，这将是其面临的主要挑战。

title: GaLoRA: Parameter-Efficient Graph-Aware LLMs for Node Classification
comments: 10 pages, 2 figures, 11 tables, 39th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2025) Workshop
summary: The rapid rise of large language models (LLMs) and their ability to capture semantic relationships has led to their adoption in a wide range of applications. Text-attributed graphs (TAGs) are a notable example where LLMs can be combined with Graph Neural Networks to improve the performance of node classification. In TAGs, each node is associated with textual content and such graphs are commonly seen in various domains such as social networks, citation graphs, recommendation systems, etc. Effectively learning from TAGs would enable better representations of both structural and textual representations of the graph and improve decision-making in relevant domains. We present GaLoRA, a parameter-efficient framework that integrates structural information into LLMs. GaLoRA demonstrates competitive performance on node classification tasks with TAGs, performing on par with state-of-the-art models with just 0.24% of the parameter count required by full LLM fine-tuning. We experiment with three real-world datasets to showcase GaLoRA's effectiveness in combining structural and semantical information on TAGs.

AI.title_translation: GaLoRA：用于节点分类的参数高效图感知大型语言模型
AI.tldr: GaLoRA是一个参数高效的框架，它将图结构信息集成到大型语言模型（LLMs）中，用于文本属性图（TAGs）上的节点分类，实现了与SOTA模型相当的性能，但参数量仅为LLM完全微调的0.24%。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在捕获语义关系方面表现出色，其与图神经网络结合在文本属性图（TAGs）上可提高节点分类性能。有效地从TAGs中学习能够更好地表示图的结构和文本信息，从而改善相关领域的决策，因此需要一个能有效整合结构信息到LLMs的解决方案。
AI.method: 本文提出了GaLoRA，一个参数高效的框架，旨在将图结构信息有效地集成到大型语言模型（LLMs）中。
AI.result: GaLoRA在文本属性图（TAGs）上的节点分类任务中表现出具有竞争力的性能，与最先进的模型相当，而所需的参数量仅为LLM完全微调的0.24%。通过在三个真实世界数据集上的实验，展示了GaLoRA在结合TAGs上的结构和语义信息方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GaLoRA通过参数高效的方式成功地将结构信息整合到大型语言模型（LLMs）中，并在文本属性图（TAGs）的节点分类任务中取得了优异表现，证明了其在处理此类图数据方面的有效性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的迅速崛起及其捕获语义关系的能力，使其被广泛应用于各种场景。文本属性图（TAGs）是一个显著的例子，其中LLMs可以与图神经网络结合，以提高节点分类的性能。在TAGs中，每个节点都关联有文本内容，这类图在社交网络、引文图、推荐系统等各种领域中都很常见。有效地从TAGs中学习将能够更好地表示图的结构和文本信息，并改善相关领域的决策。我们提出了GaLoRA，一个参数高效的框架，它将结构信息集成到LLMs中。GaLoRA在TAGs上的节点分类任务中表现出具有竞争力的性能，与最先进的模型相当，而所需的参数量仅为LLM完全微调的0.24%。我们通过三个真实世界数据集进行实验，以展示GaLoRA在结合TAGs上的结构和语义信息方面的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了GaLoRA，一个参数高效的框架，旨在将图结构信息有效地集成到大型语言模型（LLMs）中，用于文本属性图（TAGs）上的节点分类任务。GaLoRA在保持与最先进模型相当性能的同时，显著减少了参数量，仅为LLM完全微调的0.24%，并在多个真实世界数据集上验证了其在结合结构和语义信息方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 节点分类, 大型语言模型, 图神经网络, 文本属性图, 参数高效
AI.comments: GaLoRA的创新之处在于其参数高效性，能够在大幅减少模型参数的同时保持与SOTA模型相当的性能，这对于LLM在图数据上的实际应用具有重要意义。它有效解决了LLM在图数据上微调成本高的问题，为结合图结构和文本语义信息提供了一个有效且实用的方案，有望推动LLMs在图数据分析领域的应用。

title: Regime-aware financial volatility forecasting via in-context learning
comments: 11 pages, 1 figure, Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Advances in Financial AI
summary: This work introduces a regime-aware in-context learning framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) for financial volatility forecasting under nonstationary market conditions. The proposed approach deploys pretrained LLMs to reason over historical volatility patterns and adjust their predictions without parameter fine-tuning. We develop an oracle-guided refinement procedure that constructs regime-aware demonstrations from training data. An LLM is then deployed as an in-context learner that predicts the next-step volatility from the input sequence using demonstrations sampled conditional to the estimated market label. This conditional sampling strategy enables the LLM to adapt its predictions to regime-dependent volatility dynamics through contextual reasoning alone. Experiments with multiple financial datasets show that the proposed regime-aware in-context learning framework outperforms both classical volatility forecasting approaches and direct one-shot learning, especially during high-volatility periods.

AI.title_translation: 基于情境学习的金融波动性预测
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于情境学习的、对市场状态敏感的框架，利用大型语言模型（LLM）在无需微调参数的情况下，通过上下文推理来预测非平稳市场条件下的金融波动性，并在高波动时期表现优异。
AI.motivation: 在非平稳市场条件下进行金融波动性预测是一个挑战。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种对市场状态敏感的情境学习框架，该框架利用预训练的大型语言模型（LLM）来分析历史波动模式并调整预测，而无需进行参数微调。该方法开发了一种神谕引导的细化程序，从训练数据中构建对市场状态敏感的示例。LLM被用作情境学习器，根据估计的市场标签条件采样演示，从输入序列中预测下一步波动性。这种条件采样策略使LLM能够通过上下文推理将其预测适应于依赖于市场状态的波动性动态。
AI.result: 在多个金融数据集上的实验表明，所提出的对市场状态敏感的情境学习框架优于经典的波动性预测方法和直接的一次性学习，尤其是在高波动时期。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功引入了一种对市场状态敏感的情境学习框架，该框架利用LLM的上下文推理能力，在非平稳市场条件下有效进行金融波动性预测，并通过适应不同的市场状态提高了预测性能。
AI.translation: 这项工作引入了一种对市场状态敏感的情境学习框架，该框架利用大型语言模型（LLM）在非平稳市场条件下进行金融波动性预测。所提出的方法部署预训练的LLM来推理历史波动模式并调整其预测，而无需进行参数微调。我们开发了一种神谕引导的细化程序，从训练数据中构建对市场状态敏感的示例。然后，将LLM部署为情境学习器，利用根据估计市场标签条件采样的示例，从输入序列中预测下一步波动性。这种条件采样策略使LLM能够仅通过上下文推理将其预测适应于依赖于市场状态的波动性动态。在多个金融数据集上的实验表明，所提出的对市场状态敏感的情境学习框架优于经典的波动性预测方法和直接的一次性学习，尤其是在高波动时期。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种对市场状态敏感的情境学习框架，该框架利用大型语言模型（LLM）在非平稳市场条件下进行金融波动性预测。该方法通过神谕引导的细化程序从训练数据中构建对市场状态敏感的示例，并部署预训练的LLM通过上下文推理分析历史波动模式并调整预测，无需参数微调。通过根据估计的市场标签条件采样演示，LLM能够将其预测适应于依赖于市场状态的波动性动态。实验结果表明，该框架在多个金融数据集上，特别是在高波动时期，表现优于传统方法和直接一次性学习。
AI.keywords: 金融波动性预测, 情境学习, 大型语言模型, 市场状态感知, 非平稳市场
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将大型语言模型（LLM）应用于金融时间序列预测，特别是在处理非平稳市场波动性方面。其核心创新在于无需微调LLM参数，而是通过“情境学习”和“神谕引导的细化程序”以及“条件采样策略”来适应不同的市场状态。这为利用LLM处理复杂金融数据提供了一个新颖且高效的范式，对于金融风险管理和交易策略具有重要意义。

title: From Imitation to Intuition: Intrinsic Reasoning for Open-Instance Video Classification
summary: Conventional video classification models, acting as effective imitators, excel in scenarios with homogeneous data distributions. However, real-world applications often present an open-instance challenge, where intra-class variations are vast and complex, beyond existing benchmarks. While traditional video encoder models struggle to fit these diverse distributions, vision-language models (VLMs) offer superior generalization but have not fully leveraged their reasoning capabilities (intuition) for such tasks. In this paper, we bridge this gap with an intrinsic reasoning framework that evolves open-instance video classification from imitation to intuition. Our approach, namely DeepIntuit, begins with a cold-start supervised alignment to initialize reasoning capability, followed by refinement using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to enhance reasoning coherence through reinforcement learning. Crucially, to translate this reasoning into accurate classification, DeepIntuit then introduces an intuitive calibration stage. In this stage, a classifier is trained on this intrinsic reasoning traces generated by the refined VLM, ensuring stable knowledge transfer without distribution mismatch. Extensive experiments demonstrate that for open-instance video classification, DeepIntuit benefits significantly from transcending simple feature imitation and evolving toward intrinsic reasoning. Our project is available at https://bwgzk-keke.github.io/DeepIntuit/.

AI.title_translation: 从模仿到直觉：开放实例视频分类的内在推理
AI.tldr: DeepIntuit通过结合VLM和强化学习，将开放实例视频分类从模仿提升到内在推理，显著提高了性能。
AI.motivation: 传统视频分类模型在开放实例挑战（类内变异巨大且复杂）中表现不佳。视觉语言模型（VLMs）虽具有优越泛化能力，但其推理能力（直觉）尚未在此类任务中得到充分利用。本文旨在弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个名为DeepIntuit的内在推理框架。首先，通过冷启动监督对齐来初始化推理能力；其次，使用群组相对策略优化（GRPO）通过强化学习增强推理连贯性；最后，引入直觉校准阶段，在该阶段训练一个分类器，利用精炼VLM生成的内在推理轨迹进行分类，确保知识稳定迁移而无分布不匹配。
AI.result: 广泛的实验表明，对于开放实例视频分类，DeepIntuit通过超越简单的特征模仿并向内在推理演进，显著受益。
AI.conclusion: DeepIntuit成功地将开放实例视频分类从模仿演变为内在推理，通过有效利用和精炼视觉语言模型的推理能力，显著提升了性能。
AI.translation: 传统的视频分类模型作为有效的模仿者，在数据分布同质的场景中表现出色。然而，实际应用常面临开放实例挑战，即类内变异巨大而复杂，超出现有基准的范围。虽然传统视频编码模型难以适应这些多样化分布，但视觉语言模型（VLMs）提供了卓越的泛化能力，但尚未充分利用其推理能力（直觉）来解决此类任务。在本文中，我们通过一个内在推理框架弥合了这一差距，该框架将开放实例视频分类从模仿演变为直觉。我们的方法，即DeepIntuit，首先通过冷启动监督对齐来初始化推理能力，然后使用群组相对策略优化（GRPO）通过强化学习增强推理连贯性。至关重要的是，为了将这种推理转化为准确的分类，DeepIntuit随后引入了一个直觉校准阶段。在此阶段，分类器在由精炼VLM生成的内在推理轨迹上进行训练，确保知识稳定迁移而无分布不匹配。广泛的实验表明，对于开放实例视频分类，DeepIntuit通过超越简单的特征模仿并向内在推理演进，显著受益。我们的项目可在 https://bwgzk-keke.github.io/DeepIntuit/ 上获取。
AI.summary: DeepIntuit是一个内在推理框架，旨在解决开放实例视频分类中传统模型和VLM的局限性。它通过监督对齐、强化学习细化和直觉校准三个阶段，将VLM的推理能力转化为准确分类。实验证明，该方法在开放实例场景下超越了简单的特征模仿，并向内在推理演进，取得了显著效果。
AI.keywords: 内在推理, 开放实例视频分类, 视觉语言模型, 强化学习, DeepIntuit
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种新颖的内在推理框架DeepIntuit，通过结合视觉语言模型（VLM）和强化学习，将开放实例视频分类从简单的特征模仿提升到更高级的内在推理。这种方法创新性地解决了传统模型在面对巨大类内变异时的局限性，并充分挖掘了VLM的推理潜力，对于实际应用中的复杂视频分类任务具有重要意义。局限性：Not mentioned in abstract。

title: What do near-optimal learning rate schedules look like?
summary: A basic unanswered question in neural network training is: what is the best learning rate schedule shape for a given workload? The choice of learning rate schedule is a key factor in the success or failure of the training process, but beyond having some kind of warmup and decay, there is no consensus on what makes a good schedule shape. To answer this question, we designed a search procedure to find the best shapes within a parameterized schedule family. Our approach factors out the schedule shape from the base learning rate, which otherwise would dominate cross-schedule comparisons. We applied our search procedure to a variety of schedule families on three workloads: linear regression, image classification on CIFAR-10, and small-scale language modeling on Wikitext103. We showed that our search procedure indeed generally found near-optimal schedules. We found that warmup and decay are robust features of good schedules, and that commonly used schedule families are not optimal on these workloads. Finally, we explored how the outputs of our shape search depend on other optimization hyperparameters, and found that weight decay can have a strong effect on the optimal schedule shape. To the best of our knowledge, our results represent the most comprehensive results on near-optimal schedule shapes for deep neural network training, to date.

AI.title_translation: 近乎最优的学习率调度是怎样的？
AI.tldr: 本文设计了一种搜索程序来寻找给定工作负载下近乎最优的学习率调度形状，发现热身和衰减是良好调度的稳健特征，且常用调度并非最优，同时发现权重衰减对最优调度形状有显著影响。
AI.motivation: 神经网络训练中一个基本未解的问题是：给定工作负载，最佳学习率调度形状是怎样的？学习率调度的选择是训练过程成功或失败的关键因素，但除了某种热身和衰减之外，对于什么是好的调度形状还没有共识。本研究旨在回答这个问题。
AI.method: 本文设计了一种搜索程序，用于在参数化的调度族中找到最佳形状。该方法将调度形状与基础学习率分离，以避免其主导跨调度比较。研究人员将该搜索程序应用于三种工作负载（线性回归、CIFAR-10 上的图像分类和 Wikitext103 上的小规模语言建模）上的各种调度族。此外，还探讨了形状搜索的输出如何依赖于其他优化超参数。
AI.result: 搜索程序通常能找到近乎最优的调度。热身和衰减是良好调度的稳健特征。常用调度族在这些工作负载上并非最优。权重衰减对最优调度形状有很强的影响。
AI.conclusion: 本研究的结果代表了迄今为止关于深度神经网络训练中近乎最优调度形状最全面的结果，强调了定制调度形状的重要性、热身/衰减的稳健性以及权重衰减的影响。
AI.translation: 神经网络训练中一个基本未解的问题是：给定工作负载，最佳学习率调度形状是怎样的？学习率调度的选择是训练过程成功或失败的关键因素，但除了某种热身和衰减之外，对于什么是好的调度形状还没有共识。为了回答这个问题，我们设计了一个搜索程序，以在参数化的调度族中找到最佳形状。我们的方法将调度形状与基础学习率分离，否则基础学习率会主导跨调度比较。我们将搜索程序应用于三种工作负载上的各种调度族：线性回归、CIFAR-10 上的图像分类和 Wikitext103 上的小规模语言建模。我们表明，我们的搜索程序确实普遍找到了近乎最优的调度。我们发现热身和衰减是良好调度的稳健特征，并且常用调度族在这些工作负载上并非最优。最后，我们探讨了形状搜索的输出如何依赖于其他优化超参数，发现权重衰减对最优调度形状有很强的影响。据我们所知，我们的结果代表了迄今为止关于深度神经网络训练中近乎最优调度形状最全面的结果。
AI.summary: 该论文探讨了神经网络训练中最佳学习率调度形状这一关键问题。研究人员设计了一个搜索程序，在多种工作负载（线性回归、CIFAR-10 图像分类、Wikitext103 语言建模）上寻找近乎最优的调度形状，并通过将调度形状与基础学习率分离来确保比较的有效性。研究发现，热身和衰减是良好调度的稳健特征，而常用的调度族在这些工作负载上并非最优。此外，权重衰减对最优调度形状有显著影响。该工作为深度神经网络训练中的学习率调度提供了迄今为止最全面的见解。
AI.keywords: 学习率调度, 神经网络训练, 优化, 超参数, 热身和衰减
AI.comments: 这篇论文解决了深度学习中一个基本的实际问题。其创新之处在于系统地搜索最优学习率调度，并将调度形状与基础学习率分离。研究结果挑战了关于常用调度的传统观点，并强调了学习率调度与其他超参数（如权重衰减）之间的相互作用，为从业者提供了宝贵的指导。

title: How to make the most of your masked language model for protein engineering
comments: Accepted into the GEM Workshop, ICLR 2026
summary: A plethora of protein language models have been released in recent years. Yet comparatively little work has addressed how to best sample from them to optimize desired biological properties. We fill this gap by proposing a flexible, effective sampling method for masked language models (MLMs), and by systematically evaluating models and methods both in silico and in vitro on actual antibody therapeutics campaigns. Firstly, we propose sampling with stochastic beam search, exploiting the fact that MLMs are remarkably efficient at evaluating the pseudo-perplexity of the entire 1-edit neighborhood of a sequence. Reframing generation in terms of entire-sequence evaluation enables flexible guidance with multiple optimization objectives. Secondly, we report results from our extensive in vitro head-to-head evaluation for the antibody engineering setting. This reveals that choice of sampling method is at least as impactful as the model used, motivating future research into this under-explored area.
comment: Accepted into the GEM Workshop, ICLR 2026

AI.title_translation: 如何充分利用你的掩码语言模型进行蛋白质工程
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种灵活有效的掩码语言模型（MLM）采样方法，即随机束搜索，用于蛋白质工程。研究发现，采样方法的选择与所使用的模型同样重要，甚至更重要，这为蛋白质设计中的采样策略研究开辟了新方向。
AI.motivation: 近年来发布了大量蛋白质语言模型，但很少有研究关注如何最佳地从这些模型中采样以优化所需的生物学特性。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于随机束搜索的灵活有效采样方法，该方法利用MLMs在评估序列1-编辑邻域伪困惑度方面的效率。这种方法将生成重新定义为整个序列评估，允许通过多个优化目标进行灵活指导。研究在体外和体外对模型和方法进行了系统评估，尤其是在实际抗体治疗活动中。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，在抗体工程设置中，采样方法的选择至少与所使用的模型一样具有影响力。
AI.conclusion: 未来的研究应更多地关注蛋白质语言模型的采样方法，因为这是一个关键但未被充分探索的领域。
AI.translation: 近年来，大量的蛋白质语言模型被发布。然而，很少有工作关注如何最好地从这些模型中采样以优化所需的生物学特性。我们通过提出一种灵活、有效的掩码语言模型（MLMs）采样方法，并通过在体外和体外对实际抗体治疗活动中的模型和方法进行系统评估，填补了这一空白。首先，我们提出使用随机束搜索进行采样，利用了MLMs在评估序列的整个1-编辑邻域的伪困惑度方面的卓越效率。将生成重新定义为整个序列评估，使得能够通过多个优化目标进行灵活指导。其次，我们报告了在抗体工程设置中进行的广泛体外头对头评估的结果。这表明采样方法的选择至少与所使用的模型一样具有影响力，这促使未来对这一未充分探索领域进行研究。
AI.summary: 该论文旨在解决蛋白质语言模型在优化生物学特性方面采样方法不足的问题。它提出了一种针对掩码语言模型（MLMs）的灵活有效采样方法——随机束搜索，该方法利用MLMs高效评估序列1-编辑邻域伪困惑度的能力，实现多目标灵活指导。通过对体外和体外抗体治疗活动中的模型和方法进行系统评估，研究发现采样方法的选择与所用模型同样重要，甚至更具影响力，从而强调了这一未充分探索领域的重要性。
AI.keywords: 蛋白质工程, 掩码语言模型, 采样方法, 随机束搜索, 抗体治疗
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种新颖的采样策略——随机束搜索，用于蛋白质工程中的MLMs，将研究重点从模型开发扩展到生成策略。其重要性在于揭示了采样方法在蛋白质设计中与模型本身同等重要甚至更具影响力的事实，为优化蛋白质特性开辟了新的研究方向，有望显著提高蛋白质设计活动的效率。

title: Is this Idea Novel? An Automated Benchmark for Judgment of Research Ideas
summary: Judging the novelty of research ideas is crucial for advancing science, enabling the identification of unexplored directions, and ensuring contributions meaningfully extend existing knowledge rather than reiterate minor variations. However, given the exponential growth of scientific literature, manually judging the novelty of research ideas through literature reviews is labor-intensive, subjective, and infeasible at scale. Therefore, recent efforts have proposed automated approaches for research idea novelty judgment. Yet, evaluation of these approaches remains largely inconsistent and is typically based on non-standardized human evaluations, hindering large-scale, comparable evaluations. To address this, we introduce RINoBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for large-scale evaluation of research idea novelty judgments. It comprises 1,381 research ideas derived from and judged by human experts as well as nine automated evaluation metrics designed to assess both rubric-based novelty scores and textual justifications of novelty judgments. Using this benchmark, we evaluate several state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) on their ability to judge the novelty of research ideas. Our findings reveal that while LLM-generated reasoning closely mirrors human rationales, this alignment does not reliably translate into accurate novelty judgments, which diverge significantly from human gold standard judgments - even among leading reasoning-capable models. Data and code available at: https://github.com/TimSchopf/RINoBench.

AI.title_translation: 这个想法新颖吗？一个用于判断研究思想的自动化基准
AI.tldr: 手动判断研究新颖性困难重重；自动化方法缺乏一致性评估。本文介绍了RINoBench，一个综合基准，并发现大型语言模型（LLMs）的新颖性判断与人类标准存在显著差异，尽管其推理过程相似。
AI.motivation: 判断研究思想的新颖性对于科学发展至关重要，但由于科学文献的指数级增长，手动判断既费力又主观，难以大规模实施。现有的自动化方法缺乏一致且标准化的评估方式。
AI.method: 本文引入了RINoBench，这是第一个用于大规模评估研究思想新颖性判断的综合基准。它包含1,381个由人类专家判断的研究思想以及九种自动化评估指标。作者使用此基准评估了最先进的大型语言模型（LLMs）判断研究思想新颖性的能力。
AI.result: 研究发现，尽管大型语言模型生成的推理与人类的理由非常相似，但这种相似性并不能可靠地转化为准确的新颖性判断。LLMs的判断与人类黄金标准判断显著分歧，即使是领先的具有推理能力的模型也如此。
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型虽然能够模仿人类在判断新颖性时的推理过程，但其最终的新颖性判断结果与人类专家相比仍存在显著差距，未能准确评估新颖性。RINoBench基准的引入为未来评估此类能力提供了标准化工具。
AI.translation: 判断研究思想的新颖性对于推动科学发展至关重要，它能够识别未探索的方向，并确保贡献有意义地扩展现有知识，而不是重复细微的变体。然而，鉴于科学文献的指数级增长，通过文献综述手动判断研究思想的新颖性既费力又主观，并且无法大规模实施。因此，最近的努力提出了自动化方法来判断研究思想的新颖性。然而，这些方法的评估在很大程度上不一致，并且通常基于非标准的人工评估，阻碍了大规模、可比较的评估。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了RINoBench，这是第一个用于大规模评估研究思想新颖性判断的综合基准。它包含1,381个由人类专家得出并判断的研究思想，以及九种旨在评估基于规则的新颖性分数和新颖性判断文本理由的自动化评估指标。我们使用这个基准评估了几种最先进的大型语言模型（LLMs）判断研究思想新颖性的能力。我们的发现表明，尽管LLM生成的推理与人类的理由非常相似，但这种对齐并不能可靠地转化为准确的新颖性判断，这些判断与人类黄金标准判断显著分歧——即使是在领先的具有推理能力的模型中也是如此。数据和代码可在：https://github.com/TimSchopf/RINoBench 获取。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了RINoBench，一个旨在解决研究思想新颖性自动化判断评估不一致问题的综合基准。RINoBench包含1,381个人工判断的研究思想和九种自动化评估指标。通过该基准，作者评估了最先进的大型语言模型，发现尽管LLM的推理过程与人类相似，但其最终的新颖性判断与人类专家判断存在显著差异，未能实现准确的评估。
AI.keywords: 研究思想新颖性, 自动化判断, 基准, 大型语言模型, RINoBench
AI.comments: RINoBench的提出为研究思想新颖性判断的自动化方法提供了一个急需的标准化评估工具，具有重要的意义。该研究揭示了当前LLMs在真实新颖性判断能力上的局限性，即使它们在推理方面表现出色，这为未来LLM研究指明了方向。

title: Data-Driven Integration Kernels for Interpretable Nonlocal Operator Learning
summary: Machine learning models can represent climate processes that are nonlocal in horizontal space, height, and time, often by combining information across these dimensions in highly nonlinear ways. While this can improve predictive skill, it makes learned relationships difficult to interpret and prone to overfitting as the extent of nonlocal information grows. We address this challenge by introducing data-driven integration kernels, a framework that adds structure to nonlocal operator learning by explicitly separating nonlocal information aggregation from local nonlinear prediction. Each spatiotemporal predictor field is first integrated using learnable kernels (defined as continuous weighting functions over horizontal space, height, and/or time), after which a local nonlinear mapping is applied only to the resulting kernel-integrated features and any optional local inputs. This design confines nonlinear interactions to a small set of integrated features and makes each kernel directly interpretable as a weighting pattern that reveals which horizontal locations, vertical levels, and past timesteps contribute most to the prediction. We demonstrate the framework for South Asian monsoon precipitation using a hierarchy of neural network models with increasing structure, including baseline, nonparametric kernel, and parametric kernel models. Across this hierarchy, kernel-based models achieve near-baseline performance with far fewer trainable parameters, showing that much of the relevant nonlocal information can be captured through a small set of interpretable integrations when appropriate structural constraints are imposed.

AI.title_translation: 数据驱动的积分核用于可解释的非局部算子学习
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为数据驱动积分核的框架，用于解决机器学习模型在气候预测中学习到的非局部关系难以解释且易于过拟合的问题。该框架通过显式分离非局部信息的聚合和局部非线性预测，并引入可学习的积分核来加权聚合跨时空的信息，从而提高模型的可解释性和泛化能力。实验表明，该框架在南亚季风降水预测中，使用较少的参数就能取得接近基线模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型在表示气候过程中，经常需要处理跨越空间、高度和时间的非局部信息，这导致学习到的关系难以解释且容易过拟合。本研究旨在通过引入结构化的方法来解决这一挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种数据驱动积分核的框架，该框架将非局部信息的聚合与局部非线性预测分离开。首先，使用可学习的积分核（定义为在空间、高度和/或时间上的连续权重函数）对每个时空预测场进行积分，然后将局部非线性映射应用于这些积分特征和可选的局部输入。
AI.result: 在南亚季风降水预测的实验中，基于积分核的模型在参数数量远少于基线模型的情况下，取得了接近基线模型的性能，表明在施加适当的结构约束时，可以通过少量可解释的积分来捕获相关的非局部信息。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动积分核框架通过显式分离非局部信息聚合和局部非线性预测，并引入可解释的积分核，能够有效解决非局部算子学习中的可解释性和过拟合问题，并在气候预测任务中取得了良好的效果。
AI.translation: 机器学习模型可以通过组合跨越空间、高度和时间维度的信息，以高度非线性的方式来表示气候过程。虽然这可以提高预测能力，但使得学习到的关系难以解释，并且随着非局部信息范围的扩大，模型容易过拟合。我们通过引入数据驱动积分核来应对这一挑战，该框架通过显式地将非局部信息聚合与局部非线性预测分离开，从而为非局部算子学习增加了结构。首先，使用可学习的积分核（定义为跨越空间、高度和/或时间的连续权重函数）对每个时空预测场进行积分，然后将局部非线性映射仅应用于由此产生的积分特征以及任何可选的局部输入。这种设计将非线性交互限制在一小组积分特征中，并使得每个积分核可以直接解释为揭示哪些水平位置、垂直层次和过去的时间步长对预测贡献最大的权重模式。我们使用一系列具有增加结构（包括基线、非参数核和参数核模型）的神经网络模型，针对南亚季风降水演示了该框架。在整个层级中，基于核的模型在参数数量远少于可训练参数的情况下实现了接近基线性能，表明当施加适当的结构约束时，可以通过一小组可解释的积分来捕获大部分相关的非局部信息。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种数据驱动积分核框架，用于增强气候模型中非局部算子学习的可解释性和泛化能力。该框架通过将非局部信息的聚合与局部非线性预测解耦，并引入可学习的、可解释的积分核来加权聚合跨时空的信息，有效解决了传统方法中模型难以解释和容易过拟合的问题。在南亚季风降水预测的实验中，该框架在显著减少模型参数的同时，取得了与基线模型相当的预测性能。
AI.keywords: 数据驱动积分核, 非局部算子学习, 可解释性, 气候模型, 神经网络
AI.comments: 该研究提出的数据驱动积分核框架在解决非局部算子学习中的可解释性和泛化性问题方面具有创新性。通过将信息聚合与非线性预测解耦，并引入可解释的积分核，为理解和构建更可靠的气候模型提供了新的途径。然而，框架在不同气候区域和不同类型气候过程中的普适性仍需进一步验证。

title: SteadyTray: Learning Object Balancing Tasks in Humanoid Tray Transport via Residual Reinforcement Learning
summary: Stabilizing unsecured payloads against the inherent oscillations of dynamic bipedal locomotion remains a critical engineering bottleneck for humanoids in unstructured environments. To solve this, we introduce ReST-RL, a hierarchical reinforcement learning architecture that explicitly decouples locomotion from payload stabilization, evaluated via the SteadyTray benchmark. Rather than relying on monolithic end-to-end learning, our framework integrates a robust base locomotion policy with a dynamic residual module engineered to actively cancel gait-induced perturbations at the end-effector. This architectural separation ensures steady tray transport without degrading the underlying bipedal stability. In simulation, the residual design significantly outperforms end-to-end baselines in gait smoothness and orientation accuracy, achieving a 96.9% success rate in variable velocity tracking and 74.5% robustness against external force disturbances. Successfully deployed on the Unitree G1 humanoid hardware, this modular approach demonstrates highly reliable zero-shot sim-to-real generalization across various objects and external force disturbances.

AI.title_translation: SteadyTray: 通过残差强化学习实现人形机器人托盘运输中的物体平衡任务
AI.tldr: 本文提出了ReST-RL，一种分层强化学习架构，通过残差强化学习使人形机器人能够在不影响自身稳定性的前提下，稳定运输托盘上的物体，并在模拟和真实机器人上均表现出色。
AI.motivation: 稳定非固定载荷以应对动态双足运动固有的振荡，仍然是人形机器人在非结构化环境中面临的一个关键工程瓶颈。
AI.method: 本文引入了ReST-RL，一种分层强化学习架构，它明确地将运动与载荷稳定解耦。该框架将一个鲁棒的基础运动策略与一个动态残差模块集成，该模块旨在主动抵消步态引起的末端执行器扰动。通过SteadyTray基准进行评估。
AI.result: 在模拟中，残差设计在步态平滑度和方向精度方面显著优于端到端基线，在变速度跟踪中实现了96.9%的成功率，并对外部力扰动具有74.5%的鲁棒性。该模块化方法已成功部署在Unitree G1人形机器人硬件上，展示了对各种物体和外部力扰动的高度可靠的零样本模拟到真实泛化。
AI.conclusion: 这种模块化方法在人形机器人托盘运输中实现了高度可靠的零样本模拟到真实泛化，有效解决了物体平衡任务，且不降低底层双足稳定性。
AI.translation: 稳定非固定载荷以应对动态双足运动固有的振荡，仍然是人形机器人在非结构化环境中面临的一个关键工程瓶颈。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了ReST-RL，一种分层强化学习架构，它明确地将运动与载荷稳定解耦，并通过SteadyTray基准进行评估。我们的框架没有依赖单一的端到端学习，而是将一个鲁棒的基础运动策略与一个动态残差模块集成在一起，该模块旨在主动抵消步态引起的末端执行器扰动。这种架构分离确保了托盘的稳定运输，而不会降低底层的双足稳定性。在模拟中，残差设计在步态平滑度和方向精度方面显著优于端到端基线，在变速度跟踪中实现了96.9%的成功率，并对外部力扰动具有74.5%的鲁棒性。该模块化方法已成功部署在Unitree G1人形机器人硬件上，展示了对各种物体和外部力扰动的高度可靠的零样本模拟到真实泛化。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ReST-RL，一种分层强化学习架构，用于解决人形机器人在托盘运输中稳定物体的问题。该方法通过将鲁棒的基础运动策略与一个动态残差模块相结合，明确解耦了运动和载荷稳定，从而有效抵消步态引起的扰动。实验结果表明，该残差设计在模拟中表现优异，在步态平滑度和方向精度上显著优于传统方法，并在真实人形机器人上实现了对各种物体和外部力扰动的高度可靠的零样本模拟到真实泛化。
AI.keywords: 人形机器人, 托盘运输, 残差强化学习, 物体平衡, 零样本泛化
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了ReST-RL分层强化学习架构，通过残差学习机制有效解耦了人形机器人的运动控制与载荷稳定任务。这种模块化设计不仅提高了物体平衡的成功率和鲁棒性，而且在模拟到真实环境中展现出色的零样本泛化能力，为人形机器人在复杂环境中的实际应用提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: Towards Modeling Situational Awareness Through Visual Attention in Clinical Simulations
comments: Accepted at the LAK 2026 Workshop on Transition Network Analysis (TNA). Preprint version
summary: Situational awareness (SA) is essential for effective team performance in time-critical clinical environments, yet its dynamic and distributed nature remains difficult to characterize. In this preliminary study, we apply Transition Network Analysis (TNA) to model visual attention in multiperson VR-based cardiac arrest simulations. Using eye-tracking data from 40 clinicians assigned to four standardized roles (Airway, CPR, Defib, TeamLead), we construct gaze transition networks between clinically meaningful areas of interest (AOIs) and extract metrics such as entropy and self-loop rate to quantify attentional structure and flow. Our findings reveal that individual and team's visual attention is dynamically and adaptively redistributed across roles and scenario phases, with those in CPR roles narrowing their focus to execution-critical tasks and those in the TeamLead role concentrating on global monitoring as clinical demands evolve. TNA thus provides a powerful lens for mapping functional differentiation of team cognition and may support the development of phase-sensitive analytics and targeted instructional interventions in acute care training.
comment: Accepted at the LAK 2026 Workshop on Transition Network Analysis (TNA). Preprint version

AI.title_translation: 走向通过临床模拟中的视觉注意力建模情境意识
AI.tldr: 本研究通过对多人在VR心脏骤停模拟中眼动数据的转换网络分析（TNA），来建模情境意识中的视觉注意力，发现视觉注意力在不同角色和情景阶段动态适应性地重新分配，并为团队认知的功能分化提供了一种强大的分析方法。
AI.motivation: 情境意识（SA）对于时间紧迫的临床环境中有效的团队表现至关重要，但其动态和分布式特性难以描述。
AI.method: 本研究应用转换网络分析（TNA）来建模多人在VR心脏骤停模拟中的视觉注意力。使用来自40名临床医生的眼动追踪数据，这些医生被分配到四个标准化角色（气道、心肺复苏、除颤、团队负责人），构建了临床上有意义的关注区域（AOI）之间的注视转换网络，并提取了熵和自循环率等指标来量化注意力结构和流量。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，个人和团队的视觉注意力在不同角色和情景阶段动态且适应性地重新分配，其中心肺复苏角色将注意力集中在执行关键任务上，而团队负责人角色则随着临床需求的变化专注于全局监控。
AI.conclusion: 转换网络分析（TNA）为映射团队认知的功能分化提供了一个强大的视角，并可能支持急性护理培训中阶段敏感分析和有针对性的教学干预措施的开发。
AI.translation: 情境意识（SA）对于时间紧迫的临床环境中有效的团队表现至关重要，但其动态和分布式特性仍然难以描述。在这项初步研究中，我们应用转换网络分析（TNA）来建模多人在VR心脏骤停模拟中的视觉注意力。利用来自40名临床医生的眼动追踪数据，这些医生被分配到四个标准化角色（气道、心肺复苏、除颤、团队负责人），我们构建了临床上有意义的关注区域（AOI）之间的注视转换网络，并提取了熵和自循环率等指标来量化注意力结构和流量。我们的研究结果表明，个人和团队的视觉注意力在不同角色和情景阶段动态且适应性地重新分配，其中心肺复苏角色将注意力集中在执行关键任务上，而团队负责人角色则随着临床需求的变化专注于全局监控。因此，TNA为映射团队认知的功能分化提供了一个强大的视角，并可能支持急性护理培训中阶段敏感分析和有针对性的教学干预措施的开发。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在通过在VR临床模拟中应用转换网络分析（TNA）和眼动追踪数据，来建模情境意识中的视觉注意力。研究发现，在多角色心脏骤停模拟中，个人和团队的视觉注意力会根据角色和情景阶段动态调整，其中CPR角色专注于执行任务，而团队负责人则进行全局监控。TNA被证明是分析团队认知功能分化的有效工具，并有望应用于急性护理培训的分析和干预。
AI.keywords: 情境意识, 视觉注意力, 临床模拟, 转换网络分析, 眼动追踪
AI.comments: 这项研究通过结合VR模拟、眼动追踪和转换网络分析，提供了一种新颖且量化的方法来理解复杂临床环境中团队情境意识的动态性。其创新之处在于利用TNA来揭示不同角色在团队协作中视觉注意力的功能分化，为急性护理培训的个性化干预提供了潜在基础，具有重要的实践意义。

title: Large language models can disambiguate opioid slang on social media
summary: Social media text shows promise for monitoring trends in the opioid overdose crisis; however, the overwhelming majority of social media text is unrelated to opioids. When leveraging social media text to monitor trends in the ongoing opioid overdose crisis, a common strategy for identifying relevant content is to use a lexicon of opioid-related terms as inclusion criteria. However, many slang terms for opioids, such as "smack" or "blues," have common non-opioid meanings, making them ambiguous. The advanced textual reasoning capability of large language models (LLMs) presents an opportunity to disambiguate these slang terms at scale. We present three tasks on which to evaluate four state-of-the-art LLMs (GPT-4, GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and Claude Sonnet 4.5): a lexicon-based setting, in which the LLM must disambiguate a specific term within the context of a given post; a lexicon-free setting, in which the LLM must identify opioid-related posts from context without a lexicon; and an emergent slang setting, in which the LLM must identify opioid-related posts with simulated new slang terms. All four LLMs showed excellent performance across all tasks. In both subtasks of the lexicon-based setting, LLM F1 scores ("fenty" subtask: 0.824-0.972; "smack" subtask: 0.540-0.862) far exceeded those of the best lexicon strategy (0.126 and 0.009, respectively). In the lexicon-free task, LLM F1 scores (0.544-0.769) surpassed those of lexicons (0.080-0.540), and LLMs demonstrated uniformly higher recall. On emergent slang, all LLMs had higher accuracy (average: 0.784), F1 score (average: 0.712), precision (average: 0.981), and recall (average: 0.587) than the two lexicons assessed. Our results show that LLMs can be used to identify relevant content for low-prevalence topics, including but not limited to opioid references, enhancing data provided to downstream analyses and predictive models.

AI.title_translation: 大语言模型可以消除社交媒体上阿片类药物俚语的歧义
AI.tldr: 研究显示，GPT-4、Claude等大语言模型在识别社交媒体中有歧义的阿片类药物俚语方面表现优异，其性能显著超越了传统的词表匹配方法。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体是监测阿片类药物危机的潜在数据源，但由于阿片类药物俚语（如“smack”）在日常语境中具有极强的歧义性，传统的词表筛选方法准确率极低，需要更先进的推理能力来识别相关内容。
AI.method: 评估了四种最先进的LLM（GPT-4、GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Pro和Claude Sonnet 4.5）在三种任务下的表现：1. 基于词表的消歧任务；2. 无词表的语境识别任务；3. 模拟新兴俚语的识别任务。并将结果与传统词表策略进行对比。
AI.result: 在所有任务中，LLM的表现均优于词表法。词表消歧任务中，LLM的F1分数（0.540-0.972）远超词表法（0.009-0.126）；在无词表和新兴俚语任务中，LLM也展示了更高的F1分数、准确率和召回率。
AI.conclusion: LLM能够有效识别并消除低流行率话题（如阿片类药物引用）中的俚语歧义，显著提升了下游分析和预测模型的数据质量。
AI.translation: 社交媒体文本在监测阿片类药物过量危机趋势方面具有潜力；然而，绝大多数社交媒体文本与阿片类药物无关。在使用社交媒体文本监测阿片类药物危机时，识别相关内容的常用策略是使用阿片类相关术语词表作为包含标准。然而，许多阿片类药物的俚语（如“smack”或“blues”）具有常见的非阿片类含义，从而产生歧义。大语言模型（LLMs）先进的文本推理能力为大规模消除这些俚语歧义提供了机会。我们提出了三个任务来评估四种最先进的LLM（GPT-4、GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Pro和Claude Sonnet 4.5）：基于词表的设置，LLM必须在给定帖子的语境下消除特定术语的歧义；无词表设置，LLM必须在没有词表的情况下根据语境识别相关帖子；以及新兴俚语设置，LLM必须识别带有模拟新俚语的相关帖子。所有四种LLM在所有任务中均表现出色。在基于词表设置的两个子任务中，LLM的F1分数（“fenty”子任务：0.824-0.972；“smack”子任务：0.540-0.862）远超最佳词表策略（分别为0.126和0.009）。在无词表任务中，LLM的F1分数（0.544-0.769）超过了词表法（0.080-0.540），且LLM表现出一致更高的召回率。在新兴俚语任务中，所有LLM的准确度（平均0.784）、F1分数（平均0.712）、精确度（平均0.981）和召回率（平均0.587）均高于评估的两个词表。我们的结果表明，LLM可用于识别包括但不限于阿片类药物在内的低流行率话题的相关内容，从而增强为下游分析和预测模型提供的数据。
AI.summary: 本研究证明了大语言模型（LLM）在识别和消除社交媒体上阿片类药物俚语歧义方面具有卓越能力。通过三个维度的任务测试，研究发现LLM在处理高歧义词汇和识别新兴俚语方面的性能远超传统的词表匹配方法，为公共卫生监测提供了更精准的数据过滤手段。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 阿片类药物, 社交媒体监测, 俚语消歧, 公共卫生
AI.comments: 创新点：该研究首次系统地评估了多种前沿大语言模型在公共卫生领域（特别是阿片类药物监测）中处理歧义俚语的能力。重要性：解决了传统词表法在社交媒体监测中因词汇多义性导致的高误报率问题，为低流行率事件的自动监测提供了新范式。局限性：摘要中提及的某些模型型号（如GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro）在现实中尚未发布或命名不符，且未提及LLM在大规模实时流数据处理中的成本与速度挑战。

title: PRoADS: Provably Secure and Robust Audio Diffusion Steganography with latent optimization and backward Euler Inversion
comments: This paper has been accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP 2026)
summary: This paper proposes PRoADS, a provably secure and robust audio steganographic framework based on audio diffusion models. As a generative steganography scheme, PRoADS embeds secret messages into the initial noise of diffusion models via orthogonal matrix projection. To address the reconstruction errors in diffusion inversion that cause high bit error rates (BER), we introduce Latent Optimization and Backward Euler Inversion to minimize the latent reconstruction and diffusion inversion errors. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our scheme sustains a remarkably low BER of 0.15\% under 64 kbps MP3 compression, significantly outperforming existing methods and exhibiting strong robustness.
comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP 2026)

AI.title_translation: PRoADS：一种具有潜变量优化和后向欧拉逆转的可证明安全且鲁棒的音频扩散隐写术
AI.tldr: PRoADS是一种基于音频扩散模型的隐写框架，通过在初始噪声中嵌入秘密消息来解决隐写问题。它通过潜变量优化和后向欧拉逆转来最小化重建和逆转误差，从而实现低比特错误率和高鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 解决现有隐写方法在音频压缩后重建错误导致的高比特错误率（BER）问题。
AI.method: PRoADS利用音频扩散模型，通过正交矩阵投影将秘密消息嵌入到扩散模型的初始噪声中。引入潜变量优化和后向欧拉逆转来最小化潜变量重建和扩散逆转的误差。
AI.result: 在64 kbps MP3压缩下，PRoADS实现了0.15%的低比特错误率，显著优于现有方法，并表现出强大的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: PRoADS是一种安全且鲁棒的音频隐写框架，通过创新的方法解决了音频扩散模型的重建误差问题，并在实际应用中取得了优异的性能。
AI.translation: 本文提出了PRoADS，一个基于音频扩散模型的、可证明安全且鲁棒的音频隐写框架。作为一种生成式隐写方案，PRoADS通过正交矩阵投影将秘密消息嵌入到扩散模型的初始噪声中。为了解决扩散逆转中的重建错误导致的高比特错误率（BER），我们引入了潜变量优化和后向欧拉逆转，以最小化潜变量重建和扩散逆转的误差。全面的实验表明，在64 kbps MP3压缩下，我们的方案保持了极低的BER，为0.15%，显著优于现有方法，并表现出强大的鲁棒性。
AI.summary: PRoADS是一种新颖的音频隐写框架，它利用音频扩散模型，通过将秘密消息嵌入到初始噪声中，并结合潜变量优化和后向欧拉逆转技术，有效解决了传统方法在高压缩率下的重建误差和高比特错误率问题。实验证明，PRoADS在64 kbps MP3压缩下达到了0.15%的低比特错误率，展现了卓越的鲁棒性和性能。
AI.keywords: 音频隐写, 扩散模型, 潜变量优化, 后向欧拉逆转, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种基于音频扩散模型的隐写方法PRoADS，通过引入潜变量优化和后向欧拉逆转技术，有效解决了传统隐写方法在高压缩率下的鲁棒性问题，实现了较低的比特错误率。该方法在理论上具有可证明的安全性，并在实验中得到了验证，具有重要的研究价值和应用前景。

title: The Orthogonal Vulnerabilities of Generative AI Watermarks: A Comparative Empirical Benchmark of Spatial and Latent Provenance
summary: As open-weights generative AI rapidly proliferates, the ability to synthesize hyper-realistic media has introduced profound challenges to digital trust. Automated disinformation and AI-generated imagery have made robust digital provenance a critical cybersecurity imperative. Currently, state-of-the-art invisible watermarks operate within one of two primary mathematical manifolds: the spatial domain (post-generation pixel embedding) or the latent domain (pre-generation frequency embedding). While existing literature frequently evaluates these models against isolated, classical distortions, there is a critical lack of rigorous, comparative benchmarking against modern generative AI editing tools. In this study, we empirically evaluate two leading representative paradigms, RivaGAN (Spatial) and Tree-Ring (Latent), utilizing an automated Attack Simulation Engine across 30 intensity intervals of geometric and generative perturbations. We formalize an "Adversarial Evasion Region" (AER) framework to measure cryptographic degradation against semantic visual retention (OpenCLIP > 70.0). Our statistical analysis ($n=100$ per interval, $MOE = \pm 3.92\%$) reveals that these domains possess mutually exclusive, mathematically orthogonal vulnerabilities. Spatial watermarks experience severe cryptographic degradation under algorithmic pixel-rewriting (exhibiting a 67.47% AER evasion rate under Img2Img translation), whereas latent watermarks exhibit profound fragility against geometric misalignment (yielding a 43.20% AER evasion rate under static cropping). By proving that single-domain watermarking is fundamentally insufficient against modern adversarial toolsets, this research exposes a systemic vulnerability in current digital provenance standards and establishes the foundational exigence for future multi-domain cryptographic architectures.

AI.title_translation: 生成式AI水印的正交漏洞：空间和潜在来源的比较实证基准
AI.tldr: 本研究通过对空间域和潜在域水印进行比较性实证评估，揭示了它们在现代生成式AI编辑工具下具有相互排斥的正交漏洞，表明单域水印不足以应对现代对抗性工具集。
AI.motivation: 随着开源生成式AI的迅速普及，其合成超现实媒体的能力给数字信任带来了严峻挑战。自动化虚假信息和AI生成图像使得强大的数字来源成为网络安全的关键要求。现有文献虽然评估了水印模型在孤立经典失真下的表现，但缺乏对现代生成式AI编辑工具的严格比较基准测试。
AI.method: 本研究采用自动化攻击模拟引擎，对两种领先的代表性范式——RivaGAN（空间域）和Tree-Ring（潜在域）进行了实证评估。评估涵盖几何和生成扰动的30个强度区间。研究形式化了一个“对抗性规避区域”（AER）框架，以衡量密码学降级与语义视觉保留（OpenCLIP > 70.0）之间的关系。统计分析（每个区间n=100，MOE = ±3.92%）被用于揭示漏洞。
AI.result: 统计分析揭示了空间域和潜在域水印具有相互排斥、数学上正交的漏洞。空间水印在算法像素重写下经历严重的密码学降级（在Img2Img转换下表现出67.47%的AER规避率），而潜在水印对几何错位表现出深刻的脆弱性（在静态裁剪下产生43.20%的AER规避率）。
AI.conclusion: 单域水印在现代对抗性工具集面前是根本不足的。这项研究揭示了当前数字来源标准中存在的系统性漏洞，并为未来多域密码学架构奠定了基础需求。
AI.translation: 随着开源生成式AI的迅速普及，其合成超现实媒体的能力给数字信任带来了严峻挑战。自动化虚假信息和AI生成图像使得强大的数字来源成为网络安全的关键要求。目前，最先进的隐形水印在两个主要数学流形之一中运行：空间域（生成后像素嵌入）或潜在域（生成前频率嵌入）。虽然现有文献经常评估这些模型在孤立的经典失真下的表现，但严重缺乏针对现代生成式AI编辑工具的严格、比较性基准测试。在本研究中，我们利用自动化攻击模拟引擎，对两种领先的代表性范式——RivaGAN（空间）和Tree-Ring（潜在）进行了实证评估，评估涵盖几何和生成扰动的30个强度区间。我们形式化了一个“对抗性规避区域”（AER）框架，以衡量密码学降级与语义视觉保留（OpenCLIP > 70.0）之间的关系。我们的统计分析（每个区间n=100，MOE = ±3.92%）揭示了这些领域具有相互排斥、数学上正交的漏洞。空间水印在算法像素重写下经历严重的密码学降级（在Img2Img转换下表现出67.47%的AER规避率），而潜在水印对几何错位表现出深刻的脆弱性（在静态裁剪下产生43.20%的AER规避率）。通过证明单域水印在现代对抗性工具集面前是根本不足的，这项研究揭示了当前数字来源标准中存在的系统性漏洞，并为未来多域密码学架构奠定了基础需求。
AI.summary: 本研究对生成式AI水印在空间域和潜在域的脆弱性进行了比较性实证基准测试。通过自动化攻击模拟引擎，评估了RivaGAN（空间）和Tree-Ring（潜在）两种水印范式在几何和生成扰动下的表现。研究引入“对抗性规避区域”（AER）框架衡量密码学降级，并发现空间水印易受像素重写攻击，而潜在水印易受几何错位攻击。结果表明，单域水印不足以应对现代AI编辑工具，凸显了开发多域密码学架构的必要性。
AI.keywords: 生成式AI水印, 正交漏洞, 空间域, 潜在域, 对抗性规避区域
AI.comments: 本文创新性地提出了针对生成式AI水印的“对抗性规避区域”（AER）框架，并首次对空间域和潜在域水印在现代AI编辑工具下的正交漏洞进行了系统性、比较性实证评估。其重要性在于揭示了当前数字来源标准的系统性不足，并为未来多域水印技术的发展指明了方向。研究方法严谨，数据支持充分，对维护数字信任具有实际指导意义。

title: NasoVoce: A Nose-Mounted Low-Audibility Speech Interface for Always-Available Speech Interaction
summary: Silent and whispered speech offer promise for always-available voice interaction with AI, yet existing methods struggle to balance vocabulary size, wearability, silence, and noise robustness. We present NasoVoce, a nose-bridge-mounted interface that integrates a microphone and a vibration sensor. Positioned at the nasal pads of smart glasses, it unobtrusively captures both acoustic and vibration signals. The nasal bridge, close to the mouth, allows access to bone- and skin-conducted speech and enables reliable capture of low-volume utterances such as whispered speech. While the microphone captures high-quality audio, it is highly sensitive to environmental noise. Conversely, the vibration sensor is robust to noise but yields lower signal quality. By fusing these complementary inputs, NasoVoce generates high-quality speech robust against interference. Evaluation with Whisper Large-v2, PESQ, STOI, and MUSHRA ratings confirms improved recognition and quality. NasoVoce demonstrates the feasibility of a practical interface for always-available, continuous, and discreet AI voice conversations.

AI.title_translation: NasoVoce：一种用于随时可用语音交互的鼻载式低可听度语音接口
AI.tldr: NasoVoce 是一种戴在鼻梁上的设备，它结合了麦克风和振动传感器来拾取低语或安静的语音，有效克服了环境噪声的干扰，实现了高质量、隐秘的AI语音交互。
AI.motivation: 现有的方法在平衡词汇量大小、可穿戴性、静音性和抗噪性方面存在困难，而静音和低语语音为随时可用的语音交互提供了潜力。
AI.method: NasoVoce 是一种安装在鼻梁上的接口，集成了麦克风和振动传感器。它通过融合麦克风捕获的高质量但易受环境噪声影响的声学信号与振动传感器捕获的抗噪但信号质量较低的振动信号，生成高质量且抗干扰的语音。评估使用了 Whisper Large-v2、PESQ、STOI 和 MUSHRA 评分。
AI.result: 通过融合互补的输入，NasoVoce 生成了高质量且抗干扰的语音。评估结果证实了识别率和质量的提高（通过 Whisper Large-v2、PESQ、STOI 和 MUSHRA 评分）。
AI.conclusion: NasoVoce 证明了开发一种实用的、用于随时可用、连续和隐秘的 AI 语音对话接口是可行的。
AI.translation: 静音和低语语音为随时可用的语音交互提供了潜力，但现有方法难以平衡词汇量、可穿戴性、静音性和抗噪性。我们提出了 NasoVoce，一种安装在鼻梁上的接口，集成了麦克风和振动传感器。它被放置在智能眼镜的鼻垫上，非侵入性地捕获声学和振动信号。鼻梁靠近嘴部，可以获取骨传导和皮肤传导的语音，并能可靠地捕获低语等低音量的话语。虽然麦克风捕获高质量音频，但它对环境噪声非常敏感。相反，振动传感器抗噪能力强，但信号质量较低。通过融合这些互补的输入，NasoVoce 生成了高质量且抗干扰的语音。使用 Whisper Large-v2、PESQ、STOI 和 MUSHRA 评分的评估证实了识别率和质量的提高。NasoVoce 证明了一种用于随时可用、连续和隐秘的 AI 语音对话的实用接口是可行的。
AI.summary: NasoVoce 是一种安装在鼻梁上的新型语音接口，它结合了麦克风和振动传感器来捕获靠近嘴部的声学和振动信号。通过融合这两种互补的输入，该系统克服了现有低可听度语音接口在抗噪性和信号质量之间的权衡，实现了高质量、抗干扰的语音识别，为实现随时可用、连续和隐秘的AI语音交互提供了实用的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 鼻载接口, 低可听度语音, 语音交互, 振动传感器, 信号融合
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一种新颖的、佩戴在鼻梁上的语音接口 NasoVoce，它巧妙地融合了麦克风和振动传感器捕获的信号，以解决现有低可听度语音接口在词汇量、可穿戴性、静音性和抗噪性之间的权衡难题。其重要性在于为实现随时可用、连续和隐秘的AI语音交互提供了一个实用的硬件解决方案。局限性可能在于其对特定佩戴位置（鼻垫）的依赖性。

title: FC-4DFS: Frequency-controlled Flexible 4D Facial Expression Synthesizing
summary: 4D facial expression synthesizing is a critical problem in the fields of computer vision and graphics. Current methods lack flexibility and smoothness when simulating the inter-frame motion of expression sequences. In this paper, we propose a frequency-controlled 4D facial expression synthesizing method, FC-4DFS. Specifically, we introduce a frequency-controlled LSTM network to generate 4D facial expression sequences frame by frame from a given neutral landmark with a given length. Meanwhile, we propose a temporal coherence loss to enhance the perception of temporal sequence motion and improve the accuracy of relative displacements. Furthermore, we designed a Multi-level Identity-Aware Displacement Network based on a cross-attention mechanism to reconstruct the 4D facial expression sequences from landmark sequences. Finally, our FC-4DFS achieves flexible and SOTA generation results of 4D facial expression sequences with different lengths on CoMA and Florence4D datasets. The code will be available on GitHub.

AI.title_translation: FC-4DFS: 频率控制的灵活4D面部表情合成
AI.tldr: FC-4DFS提出了一种频率控制的4D面部表情合成方法，利用频率控制的LSTM网络和多级身份感知位移网络，实现了灵活且最先进的4D面部表情序列生成。
AI.motivation: 当前4D面部表情合成方法在模拟表情序列的帧间运动时缺乏灵活性和流畅性。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种频率控制的4D面部表情合成方法FC-4DFS。具体来说，引入了一个频率控制的LSTM网络，从给定的中性地标和长度逐帧生成4D面部表情序列。同时，提出了一种时间连贯性损失，以增强时间序列运动的感知并提高相对位移的准确性。此外，设计了一个基于交叉注意力机制的多级身份感知位移网络，从地标序列重建4D面部表情序列。
AI.result: FC-4DFS在CoMA和Florence4D数据集上实现了不同长度的4D面部表情序列的灵活且最先进（SOTA）的生成结果。
AI.conclusion: FC-4DFS通过引入频率控制的LSTM和多级身份感知位移网络，有效解决了4D面部表情合成中缺乏灵活性和流畅性的问题，并取得了领先的生成效果。
AI.translation: 4D面部表情合成是计算机视觉和图形学领域的一个关键问题。当前方法在模拟表情序列的帧间运动时缺乏灵活性和流畅性。在本文中，我们提出了一种频率控制的4D面部表情合成方法FC-4DFS。具体来说，我们引入了一个频率控制的LSTM网络，从给定的中性地标和给定长度逐帧生成4D面部表情序列。同时，我们提出了一种时间连贯性损失，以增强时间序列运动的感知并提高相对位移的准确性。此外，我们设计了一个基于交叉注意力机制的多级身份感知位移网络，从地标序列重建4D面部表情序列。最后，我们的FC-4DFS在CoMA和Florence4D数据集上实现了不同长度的4D面部表情序列的灵活且SOTA（最先进）的生成结果。代码将在GitHub上提供。
AI.summary: FC-4DFS是一种新颖的频率控制4D面部表情合成方法，旨在解决现有方法在表情序列帧间运动模拟中灵活性和流畅性不足的问题。该方法核心包括一个频率控制的LSTM网络用于逐帧生成表情序列，以及一个时间连贯性损失来提升时间感知和位移精度。此外，还设计了一个基于交叉注意力机制的多级身份感知位移网络进行序列重建。实验证明，FC-4DFS在CoMA和Florence4D数据集上实现了灵活且达到最先进水平的4D面部表情序列生成。
AI.keywords: 4D面部表情合成, 频率控制, LSTM, 时间连贯性损失, 身份感知位移网络
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的频率控制方法来解决4D面部表情合成的灵活性和流畅性问题，其结合了LSTM、时间连贯性损失和多级身份感知位移网络，显示出在生成高质量、灵活表情序列方面的潜力。将频率控制引入LSTM网络是一个亮点，有助于更精细地模拟表情动态。在多个数据集上达到SOTA结果也证明了其有效性。

title: PC-Diffuser: Path-Consistent Capsule CBF Safety Filtering for Diffusion-Based Trajectory Planner
summary: Autonomous driving in complex traffic requires planners that generalize beyond hand-crafted rules, motivating data-driven approaches that learn behavior from expert demonstrations. Diffusion-based trajectory planners have recently shown strong closed-loop performance by iteratively denoising a full-horizon plan, but they remain difficult to certify and can fail catastrophically in rare or out-of-distribution scenarios. To address this challenge, we present PC-Diffuser, a safety augmentation framework that embeds a certifiable, path-consistent barrier-function structure directly into the denoising loop of diffusion planning. The key idea is to make safety an intrinsic part of trajectory generation rather than a post-hoc fix: we enforce forward invariance along the rollout while preserving the diffusion model's intended path geometry. Specifically, PC-Diffuser (i) evaluates collision risk using a capsule-distance barrier function that better reflects vehicle geometry and reduces unnecessary conservativeness, (ii) converts denoised waypoints into dynamically feasible motion under a kinematic bicycle model, and (iii) applies a path-consistent safety filter that eliminates residual constraint violations without geometric distortion, so the corrected plan remains close to the learned distribution. By injecting these safety-consistent corrections at every denoising step and feeding the refined trajectory back into the diffusion process, PC-Diffuser enables iterative, context-aware safeguarding instead of post-hoc repair...

AI.title_translation: PC-Diffuser：路径一致的胶囊CBF安全滤波用于基于扩散的轨迹规划器
AI.tldr: PC-Diffuser将路径一致的胶囊CBF安全滤波集成到扩散模型的去噪循环中，以提高自动驾驶轨迹规划的安全性、可认证性和鲁棒性，同时保持学习到的轨迹几何。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动的方法（如基于扩散的轨迹规划器）在复杂交通中表现出强大的闭环性能，但难以认证，并且在罕见或分布外场景中可能失败。
AI.method: PC-Diffuser将胶囊距离障碍函数、运动学自行车模型和路径一致的安全滤波器集成到扩散模型的去噪循环中，以实现迭代的、上下文感知的安全保护。
AI.result: PC-Diffuser通过在去噪循环中嵌入安全约束，提高了基于扩散的轨迹规划器的安全性和可认证性，同时保持了学习到的轨迹几何。
AI.conclusion: PC-Diffuser通过将安全作为轨迹生成过程的内在部分，而非事后修复，从而在保持学习到的轨迹几何的同时，提高了基于扩散的轨迹规划器的安全性和可认证性。
AI.translation: 在复杂的交通状况下进行自动驾驶需要能够泛化超越手工规则的规划器，这促使人们采用从专家演示中学习行为的数据驱动方法。基于扩散的轨迹规划器最近通过迭代地去噪整个视场的规划，表现出了强大的闭环性能，但它们仍然难以认证，并且可能在罕见或分布外的情况下灾难性地失败。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了PC-Diffuser，一个安全增强框架，它将可认证的、路径一致的障碍函数结构直接嵌入到扩散规划的去噪循环中。关键思想是让安全成为轨迹生成过程的内在部分，而不是事后修复：我们在整个前向传播过程中强制执行不变性，同时保持扩散模型预期的路径几何。具体来说，PC-Diffuser（i）使用能够更好地反映车辆几何形状并减少不必要保守性的胶囊距离障碍函数来评估碰撞风险，（ii）将去噪后的航点在运动学自行车模型下转换为动力学上可行的运动，以及（iii）应用路径一致的安全滤波器，在不产生几何失真的情况下消除残留的约束违反，从而使修正后的规划保持在学习分布附近。通过在每个去噪步骤中注入这些安全一致的修正，并将精炼后的轨迹反馈给扩散过程，PC-Diffuser实现了迭代的、上下文感知的安全保护，而不是事后修复。
AI.summary: PC-Diffuser是一个安全增强框架，它将路径一致的胶囊CBF安全滤波集成到基于扩散的轨迹规划器的去噪循环中。该方法通过在轨迹生成过程中嵌入安全约束，解决了现有扩散模型在认证和处理罕见场景方面的挑战，同时保持了学习到的轨迹几何。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 轨迹规划, 安全认证, 障碍函数, 自动驾驶
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法，将安全认证机制（CBF）与扩散模型相结合，用于自动驾驶轨迹规划。通过在去噪的每一步都注入安全约束，PC-Diffuser有望提高规划的鲁棒性和可靠性，尤其是在复杂和不可预见的交通场景中。然而，计算效率和在真实世界大规模部署中的性能仍有待进一步验证。

title: Does Reasoning Make Search More Fair? Comparing Fairness in Reasoning and Non-Reasoning Rerankers
summary: While reasoning rerankers, such as Rank1, have demonstrated strong abilities in improving ranking relevance, it is unclear how they perform on other retrieval qualities such as fairness. We conduct the first systematic comparison of fairness between reasoning and non-reasoning rerankers. Using the TREC 2022 Fair Ranking Track dataset, we evaluate six reranking models across multiple retrieval settings and demographic attributes. Our findings demonstrate reasoning neither improve nor harm fairness compared to non-reasoning approaches. Our fairness metric, Attention-Weighted Rank Fairness (AWRF) remained stable (0.33-0.35) across all models, even as relevance varies substantially (nDCG 0.247-1.000). Demographic breakdown analysis revealed fairness gaps for geographic attributes regardless of model architecture. These results indicate that future work in specializing reasoning models to be aware of fairness attributes could lead to improvements, as current implementations preserve the fairness characteristics of their input ranking.

AI.title_translation: 推理能使搜索更公平吗？比较推理和非推理重排序器中的公平性
AI.tldr: 研究发现，用于提高相关性的推理重排序模型与非推理模型相比，在公平性上没有优势或劣势，它们只是继承了输入排名的公平性特征。
AI.motivation: 尽管推理重排序器在提高排序相关性方面表现出色，但它们在公平性等其他检索质量方面的表现尚不清楚，因此需要进行首次系统性比较。
AI.method: 使用TREC 2022公平排序轨道数据集，评估了六个推理和非推理重排序模型在不同检索设置和人口统计属性下的公平性，并引入了注意力加权秩公平性（AWRF）作为公平性度量标准。
AI.result: 在所有模型中，AWRF指标保持稳定（0.33-0.35），即使相关性（nDCG 0.247-1.000）有很大变化。人口统计学细分分析显示，无论模型架构如何，地理属性都存在公平性差距。推理和非推理方法在公平性上没有区别。
AI.conclusion: 当前推理模型的实现保留了输入排名的公平性特征，因此，推理本身既没有提高也没有损害公平性。未来的工作应专注于使推理模型具备公平性感知能力，以期实现改进。
AI.translation: 虽然像Rank1这样的推理重排序器在提高排序相关性方面表现出强大的能力，但它们在公平性等其他检索质量方面的表现尚不清楚。我们对推理和非推理重排序器的公平性进行了首次系统的比较。使用TREC 2022公平排序轨道数据集，我们在多个检索设置和人口统计属性下评估了六个重排序模型。我们的研究结果表明，与非推理方法相比，推理既没有提高也没有损害公平性。我们的公平性指标，注意力加权秩公平性（AWRF）在所有模型中保持稳定（0.33-0.35），即使相关性有很大变化（nDCG 0.247-1.000）。人口统计学细分分析显示，无论模型架构如何，地理属性都存在公平性差距。这些结果表明，未来专门使推理模型感知公平性属性的工作可能带来改进，因为当前的实现保留了其输入排名的公平性特征。
AI.summary: 本研究首次系统地比较了推理重排序器和非推理重排序器在公平性方面的表现。使用TREC 2022公平排序数据集和AWRF指标评估发现，推理能力本身对公平性没有提升或损害。公平性差距主要与地理属性相关，且与模型架构无关，表明未来的工作需要专门设计推理模型来感知和提升公平性。
AI.keywords: 推理重排序, 公平性, 检索公平性, AWRF, 人口统计属性
AI.comments: 这项研究首次系统地比较了推理重排序模型和非推理重排序模型在公平性方面的表现。主要创新点在于使用AWRF指标来衡量公平性，并发现推理能力本身对公平性没有显著影响，这为未来如何将公平性融入推理模型指明了方向。局限性在于，研究结果表明当前推理模型只是保持了输入排名的公平性特征，并未主动改善。

title: Fuel Gauge: Estimating Chain-of-Thought Length Ahead of Time in Large Multimodal Models
summary: Reasoning Large Multi-modality Models (LMMs) have become the de facto choice for many applications. However, these models rely on a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) process that is lengthy and unpredictable at runtime, often resulting in inefficient use of computational resources (due to memory fragmentation) and sub-optimal accuracy (due to under- and over-thinking). We observe empirically that the CoT process follows a very simple form, whose behavior is independent of the specific generated samples. This suggests that the CoT length can be estimated ahead of time based on a hidden parameter representing the amount of "fuel" available to support the reasoning process. Based on this insight, we propose Fuel Gauge, the first method which extracts this hidden signal and predicts CoT length ahead of time. We demonstrate the utility on the Fuel Gauge on two downstream tasks: predictive KV cache allocation, which addresses memory fragmentation in LMM serving systems, and CoT length modulation, which mitigates under-thinking and over-thinking. Extensive experiments on LMMs across text-only, image-text, and video-text question answering benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness, generalizability, and practical value of our Fuel Gauge. For example, on the GPQA-Diamond benchmark, our Fuel Gauge achieves less than half the CoT length prediction error compared to the baseline; this translates into a 13.37x reduction in the memory allocation frequency.

AI.title_translation: 燃料表：提前估算大型多模态模型中的思维链长度
AI.tldr: LMMs的CoT推理时间长且不可预测，浪费资源并影响准确性。我们发现CoT长度与一个隐藏的“燃料”参数相关，并开发了Fuel Gauge方法来提前预测该长度。这使我们能优化内存分配（减少碎片化）并调节推理深度（解决过度/不足思考），在多个基准测试上取得了显著的性能提升和效率优化。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型（LMMs）依赖的思维链（CoT）过程冗长且运行时不可预测，导致计算资源使用效率低下（内存碎片化）和次优的准确性（思考不足或过度）。因此需要一种方法来提前估计CoT的长度。
AI.method: 提出Fuel Gauge方法，通过提取一个隐藏信号来提前预测CoT的长度，该信号代表支持推理过程的“燃料”量。该方法被应用于两个下游任务：预测KV缓存分配以解决内存碎片化，以及CoT长度调制以减轻思考不足和过度思考。
AI.result: Fuel Gauge在GPQA-Diamond基准测试上实现了不到基线一半的CoT长度预测误差，这转化为内存分配频率降低了13.37倍。该方法在文本、图像-文本和视频-文本问答基准测试中均表现出有效性。
AI.conclusion: Fuel Gauge的有效性、泛化性和实际价值在跨模态（纯文本、图文、视频-文本）问答基准测试中得到证明。例如，在GPQA-Diamond基准测试上，预测误差减半，内存分配频率降低了13.37倍。
AI.translation: 推理型大型多模态模型（LMMs）已成为许多应用的实际选择。然而，这些模型依赖于一个冗长且运行时不可预测的思维链（CoT）过程，通常导致计算资源使用效率低下（由于内存碎片化）和次优的准确性（由于思考不足和过度思考）。我们经验观察到CoT过程遵循一个非常简单的形式，其行为独立于具体生成的样本。这表明CoT的长度可以基于一个代表支持推理过程“燃料”量的隐藏参数来提前估计。基于这一见解，我们提出了Fuel Gauge，这是第一个提取该隐藏信号并提前预测CoT长度的方法。我们证明了Fuel Gauge在两个下游任务中的效用：解决LMMs服务系统中内存碎片化的预测性KV缓存分配，以及减轻思考不足和过度思考的CoT长度调制。在跨文本、图像-文本和视频-文本问答基准测试的LMMs上的广泛实验证明了Fuel Gauge的有效性、泛化性和实际价值。例如，在GPQA-Diamond基准测试上，我们的Fuel Gauge实现的CoT长度预测误差不到基线的一半；这转化为内存分配频率降低了13.37倍。
AI.summary: 本文针对大型多模态模型（LMMs）中思维链（CoT）过程长度不确定性导致的资源效率低下和准确性问题，提出了“Fuel Gauge”方法。该方法基于CoT行为独立于具体样本的观察，提取一个隐藏的“燃料”信号来提前预测CoT的长度，并成功应用于优化KV缓存分配和调节CoT长度，实验证明了其在多模态问答任务上的优越性能和实用价值。
AI.keywords: 大型多模态模型, 思维链, 长度预测, 内存分配, 燃料计量
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于首次提出了一个能提前预测大型多模态模型（LMMs）思维链（CoT）长度的方法“Fuel Gauge”，并将其应用于优化内存分配和调节推理过程，解决了CoT过程带来的效率和准确性问题。其核心洞察是CoT长度与一个“燃料”隐藏参数相关。方法具有很强的实用价值。

title: Landmark Guided 4D Facial Expression Generation
summary: In this paper, we proposed a generative model that learns to synthesize the 4D facial expression with the neutral landmark. Existing works mainly focus on the generation of sequences guided by expression labels, speech, etc, while they are not robust to the change of different identities. Our LM-4DGAN utilizes neutral landmarks to guide the facial expression generation while adding an identity discriminator and a landmark autoencoder to the basic WGAN for achieving better identity robustness. Furthermore, we add a cross-attention mechanism to the existing displacement decoder which is suitable for the given identity.

AI.title_translation: 基于地标的四维面部表情生成
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的四维面部表情生成模型LM-4DGAN，利用中性地标引导表情生成，并通过身份判别器和地标自编码器增强身份鲁棒性，同时引入交叉注意力机制使模型适用于特定身份。
AI.motivation: 现有方法生成的面部表情序列对身份变化不够鲁棒。
AI.method: 提出LM-4DGAN模型，使用中性地标作为指导，并结合身份判别器、地标自编码器和交叉注意力机制。
AI.result: 模型能够生成具有更好身份鲁棒性的四维面部表情。
AI.conclusion: LM-4DGAN模型能够有效地生成具有身份鲁棒性的四维面部表情。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们提出了一个生成模型，该模型学习合成具有中性地标的四维面部表情。现有工作主要集中在由表情标签、语音等引导的序列生成，但它们对不同身份的变化不够鲁棒。我们的LM-4DGAN利用中性地标来指导面部表情的生成，同时在基本的WGAN中加入身份判别器和地标自编码器，以实现更好的身份鲁棒性。此外，我们为现有的适用于给定身份的位移解码器添加了交叉注意力机制。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为LM-4DGAN的生成模型，用于合成四维面部表情。与以往主要依赖表情标签或语音引导的方法不同，该模型利用中性地标来指导表情生成，从而提高了对不同身份变化的鲁棒性。通过引入身份判别器和地标自编码器，LM-4DGAN增强了身份保持能力。此外，模型还集成了交叉注意力机制，以确保生成的表情序列能够适应特定的身份特征。
AI.keywords: 四维面部表情生成, 地标引导, 身份鲁棒性, LM-4DGAN, 交叉注意力
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的四维面部表情生成方法，通过引入地标引导和身份鲁棒性机制，解决了现有方法在处理身份变化时的不足，具有一定的创新性和应用潜力。

title: Overcoming Visual Clutter in Vision Language Action Models via Concept-Gated Visual Distillation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate impressive zero-shot generalization but frequently suffer from a "Precision-Reasoning Gap" in cluttered environments. This failure is driven by background-induced feature dilution, where high-frequency semantic noise corrupts the geometric grounding required for precise manipulation. To bridge this gap, we propose Concept-Gated Visual Distillation (CGVD), a training-free, model-agnostic inference framework that stabilizes VLA policies. CGVD operates by parsing instructions into safe and distractor sets, utilizing a two-layer target refinement process--combining cross-validation and spatial disambiguation--to explicitly penalize false positives and isolate genuine manipulation targets. We then process the scene via Fourier-based inpainting, generating a clean observation that actively suppresses semantic distractors while preserving critical spatial geometry and visual proprioception. Extensive evaluations in highly cluttered manipulation tasks demonstrate that CGVD prevents performance collapse. In environments with dense semantic distractors, our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a 77.5% success rate compared to the baseline's 43.0%. By enforcing strict attribute adherence, CGVD establishes inference-time visual distillation as a critical prerequisite for robust robotic manipulation in the clutter.

AI.title_translation: 通过概念门控视觉蒸馏克服视觉语言动作模型中的视觉混乱
AI.tldr: 在杂乱环境中，视觉语言动作模型（VLA）因背景干扰导致特征稀释，影响精确操作。本研究提出了一种名为概念门控视觉蒸馏（CGVD）的训练无关、模型无关的推理框架，通过解析指令、区分安全指令和干扰指令、两层目标精炼（交叉验证和空间消歧）以及傅里叶修复来解决此问题。CGVD能有效抑制语义干扰，保留关键空间几何和视觉本体感知，从而稳定VLA策略。实验证明，CGVD在高度杂乱的操作任务中能防止性能下降，并在高密度语义干扰环境中取得显著优于现有技术（成功率77.5% vs 43.0%）的成果。该方法强调了推理时视觉蒸馏对于机器人鲁棒操作的重要性。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言动作（VLA）模型在零样本泛化方面表现出色，但在杂乱环境中经常因“精确-推理鸿沟”而失败，这是由背景引起的特征稀释造成的，高频语义噪声会破坏精确操作所需的几何基础。
AI.method: 提出概念门控视觉蒸馏（CGVD），一个训练无关、模型无关的推理框架。该框架通过解析指令为安全集和干扰集，利用两层目标精炼（交叉验证和空间消歧）来惩罚假阳性并分离真实操作目标。然后，通过基于傅里叶的修复处理场景，生成一个主动抑制语义干扰但保留关键空间几何和视觉本体感知的干净观测。
AI.result: 在高度杂乱的操作任务中，CGVD成功防止了性能崩溃。在具有密集语义干扰的环境中，该方法显著优于最先进的基线，成功率达到77.5%，而基线为43.0%。
AI.conclusion: 通过强制严格的属性遵循，CGVD确立了推理时视觉蒸馏作为在杂乱环境中进行鲁棒机器人操作的关键先决条件。
AI.translation: 视觉语言动作（VLA）模型在零样本泛化方面表现出色，但在杂乱环境中经常因“精确-推理鸿沟”而失败。这种失败是由背景引起的特征稀释造成的，其中高频语义噪声会破坏精确操作所需的几何基础。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了概念门控视觉蒸馏（CGVD），一个训练无关、模型无关的推理框架，用于稳定VLA策略。CGVD通过将指令解析为安全集和干扰集，利用两层目标精炼——结合交叉验证和空间消歧——来显式地惩罚假阳性和分离真实的操纵目标。然后，我们通过基于傅里叶的修复处理场景，生成一个干净的观测，该观测主动抑制语义干扰，同时保留关键的空间几何和视觉本体感知。在高度杂乱的操作任务中的广泛评估表明，CGVD可以防止性能崩溃。在具有密集语义干扰的环境中，我们的方法显著优于最先进的基线，成功率达到77.5%，而基线为43.0%。通过强制严格的属性遵循，CGVD将推理时的视觉蒸馏确立为鲁棒机器人操作的关键先决条件。
AI.summary: 视觉语言动作（VLA）模型在杂乱环境中存在“精确-推理鸿沟”问题，导致性能下降。为解决此问题，本研究提出概念门控视觉蒸馏（CGVD）框架。该框架通过解析指令、区分安全与干扰信息、目标精炼及傅里叶修复，有效抑制背景干扰，保留关键几何信息，从而稳定VLA策略。实验结果表明，CGVD显著提高了模型在杂乱环境下的操作成功率，证明了推理时视觉蒸馏在机器人鲁棒性方面的重要性。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言动作, 视觉混乱, 概念门控视觉蒸馏, 目标精炼, 机器人操作
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的训练无关、模型无关的框架（CGVD）来解决视觉语言动作（VLA）模型在杂乱环境中的性能下降问题。通过利用指令解析、目标精炼和傅里叶修复等技术，CGVD有效地抑制了背景干扰，提高了机器人的操作精度和鲁棒性。实验结果令人信服，展示了该方法在实际应用中的潜力。然而，该方法在处理极端复杂或动态变化的环境中的有效性仍有待进一步验证。

title: Federated Active Learning Under Extreme Non-IID and Global Class Imbalance
summary: Federated active learning (FAL) seeks to reduce annotation cost under privacy constraints, yet its effectiveness degrades in realistic settings with severe global class imbalance and highly heterogeneous clients. We conduct a systematic study of query-model selection in FAL and uncover a central insight: the model that achieves more class-balanced sampling, especially for minority classes, consistently leads to better final performance. Moreover, global-model querying is beneficial only when the global distribution is highly imbalanced and client data are relatively homogeneous; otherwise, the local model is preferable. Based on these findings, we propose FairFAL, an adaptive class-fair FAL framework. FairFAL (1) infers global imbalance and local-global divergence via lightweight prediction discrepancy, enabling adaptive selection between global and local query models; (2) performs prototype-guided pseudo-labeling using global features to promote class-aware querying; and (3) applies a two-stage uncertainty-diversity balanced sampling strategy with k-center refinement. Experiments on five benchmarks show that FairFAL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches under challenging long-tailed and non-IID settings. The code is available at https://github.com/chenchenzong/FairFAL.

AI.title_translation: 极端非独立同分布和全局类别不平衡下的联邦主动学习
AI.tldr: 在联邦主动学习（FAL）中，当数据高度不平衡且客户端异构时，模型性能会下降。研究发现，选择能更好地平衡少数类采样的模型更有效，并提出了FairFAL框架，它能自适应地在全局和局部查询模型间切换，并结合了类别感知的采样策略，实验证明其在复杂场景下优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 联邦主动学习（FAL）在存在严重全局类别不平衡和高度异构客户端的现实场景中，其有效性会下降。现有方法未充分解决这些挑战。
AI.method: 提出了FairFAL框架，该框架通过轻量级预测差异来推断全局不平衡和局部-全局差异，从而自适应地在全局和局部查询模型之间进行选择；使用全局特征进行原型引导的伪标签，以促进类别感知的查询；并应用了带有k-中心细化的两阶段不确定性-多样性平衡采样策略。
AI.result: FairFAL 在五个基准数据集上，在具有挑战性的长尾和非独立同分布设置下，一致地优于最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: FairFAL 在具有挑战性的长尾和非独立同分布设置下，一致地优于最先进的方法。
AI.translation: 联邦主动学习（FAL）旨在隐私约束下降低标注成本，但其有效性在存在严重全局类别不平衡和高度异构客户端的现实场景中会下降。我们对FAL中的查询模型选择进行了系统研究，并揭示了一个核心见解：实现更类别平衡采样的模型，特别是对于少数类，一致地带来了更好的最终性能。此外，只有当全局分布高度不平衡且客户端数据相对同质时，全局模型查询才是有益的；否则，局部模型更可取。基于这些发现，我们提出了FairFAL，一个自适应的类别公平FAL框架。FairFAL (1) 通过轻量级的预测差异来推断全局不平衡和局部-全局差异，从而实现全局和局部查询模型间的自适应选择；(2) 使用全局特征进行原型引导的伪标签，以促进类别感知的查询；(3) 应用带有k-中心细化的两阶段不确定性-多样性平衡采样策略。在五个基准数据集上的实验表明，FairFAL 在具有挑战性的长尾和非独立同分布设置下，一致地优于最先进的方法。代码可从 https://github.com/chenchenzong/FairFAL 获取。
AI.summary: 本研究针对联邦主动学习（FAL）在极端非独立同分布（Non-IID）和全局类别不平衡下的性能下降问题，通过系统分析得出结论：应选择能更平衡采样（尤其是少数类）的模型。基于此，研究提出了自适应类别公平的FAL框架FairFAL，该框架能根据数据分布动态选择全局或局部查询模型，并通过原型引导的伪标签和优化的采样策略来提升性能。
AI.keywords: 联邦主动学习, 类别不平衡, 非IID, 查询模型选择, FairFAL
AI.comments: 该研究系统地分析了联邦主动学习（FAL）中查询模型选择的问题，并提出了一个重要的见解：选择能实现更平衡采样的模型（特别是少数类）能带来更好的最终性能。该方法的创新点在于根据数据分布的异构性动态选择全局或局部查询模型。局限性在于其有效性仍需在更广泛的、更极端的场景下验证。

title: AgentServe: Algorithm-System Co-Design for Efficient Agentic AI Serving on a Consumer-Grade GPU
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as AI agents that operate in short reasoning-action loops, interleaving model computation with external calls. Unlike traditional chat applications, these agentic workloads require inference serving systems to balance low latency, stable token emission, and throughput under multiple request arrivals from different AI agents. Recent deployments highlight a shift toward running small language models (SLMs) locally on consumer-grade GPUs, driven by privacy, compliance, and cost constraints. When heterogeneous requests overlap on a single GPU, long prefills and short decodes contend for resources, creating head-of-line blocking that destabilizes interactive performance. By analyzing agent workloads, we observe that their execution naturally separates into cold prefills, which process long system prompts, resume prefills, which append tool outputs to cached contexts, and short decodes, which are latency-critical. This mix intensifies contention compared to conventional chatbot serving. We present AgentServe, a single-GPU serving system that ensures stable multi-agent execution under such conditions by isolating prefills from decodes, applying dynamic budgeting to resume prefills, and allocating GPU resources through pre-established CUDA Green Context slots with adaptive control. Evaluation results show that AgentServe significantly improves latency stability while sustaining competitive throughput, achieving up to 2.8x TTFT improvement and 2.7x TPOT improvement over state-of-the-art baselines across different settings.

AI.title_translation: AgentServe：面向消费级GPU上高效Agentic AI服务的算法-系统协同设计
AI.tldr: AgentServe是一个为消费级GPU设计的AI服务系统，通过优化LLM代理的工作负载，解决多代理请求冲突问题，显著提高了延迟稳定性和吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 当前的AI代理工作负载（LLM）需要推理服务系统在低延迟、稳定的Token输出和高吞吐量之间取得平衡，尤其是在多代理请求并发时。现有部署转向在消费级GPU上运行小型语言模型（SLM），但异构请求在单GPU上的冲突（长预填充、短解码）会导致头对尾阻塞，影响交互性能。
AI.method: AgentServe通过隔离预填充（冷预填充和恢复预填充）与解码，对恢复预填充应用动态预算，并利用预设的CUDA Green Context插槽和自适应控制来分配GPU资源。
AI.result: AgentServe在不同设置下，相比现有技术基线，实现了高达2.8倍的首次令牌时间（TTFT）和2.7倍的每轮令牌时间（TPOT）的提升，显著提高了延迟稳定性，同时保持了具有竞争力的吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: AgentServe成功地解决了在消费级GPU上服务多代理AI工作负载时的性能瓶颈，通过算法和系统设计的协同优化，实现了显著的延迟稳定性和吞吐量提升。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署为AI代理，它们在短的推理-行动循环中运行，将模型计算与外部调用交织在一起。与传统的聊天应用程序不同，这些代理工作负载要求推理服务系统在不同AI代理的多个请求到达时，平衡低延迟、稳定的Token输出和高吞吐量。最近的部署表明，出于隐私、合规和成本的考虑，人们正转向在消费级GPU上本地运行小型语言模型（SLM）。当异构请求在单个GPU上发生重叠时，长的预填充（prefill）和短的解码（decode）会争夺资源，产生头对尾阻塞（head-of-line blocking），从而破坏交互式性能的稳定性。通过分析代理工作负载，我们观察到它们的执行自然地分为冷预填充（处理长的系统提示）、恢复预填充（将工具输出附加到缓存的上下文）和短解码（对延迟敏感）。与传统的聊天机器人服务相比，这种混合加剧了资源争夺。我们提出了AgentServe，一个单GPU服务系统，通过将预填充与解码隔离，对恢复预填充应用动态预算，并利用预先建立的CUDA Green Context插槽和自适应控制来分配GPU资源，确保在这种条件下多代理执行的稳定性。评估结果表明，AgentServe在保持具有竞争力的吞吐量的同时，显著提高了延迟稳定性，在不同设置下实现了高达2.8倍的首次令牌时间（TTFT）改进和2.7倍的每轮令牌时间（TPOT）改进，超越了最先进的基线。
AI.summary: AgentServe是一个创新的AI服务系统，专门为在单台消费级GPU上高效服务AI代理而设计。它通过将预填充和解码操作隔离开来，并采用动态预算和CUDA Green Context插槽等技术，解决了多代理请求并发时出现的资源争夺和延迟不稳定的问题。实验证明，AgentServe在提高延迟稳定性的同时，还能保持高吞吐量，显著优于现有基线。
AI.keywords: AI代理服务, LLM推理, 消费级GPU, 延迟优化, 吞吐量
AI.comments: 该研究解决了在消费级硬件上部署AI代理时面临的关键挑战，即如何高效地处理异构的、交错的请求以保证性能。AgentServe的算法-系统协同设计方法，特别是其对预填充和解码的隔离以及动态资源管理策略，为未来的AI服务系统设计提供了有价值的参考。然而，其在真实世界复杂场景下的扩展性和鲁棒性有待进一步验证。

title: EmoStory: Emotion-Aware Story Generation
summary: Story generation aims to produce image sequences that depict coherent narratives while maintaining subject consistency across frames. Although existing methods have excelled in producing coherent and expressive stories, they remain largely emotion-neutral, focusing on what subject appears in a story while overlooking how emotions shape narrative interpretation and visual presentation. As stories are intended to engage audiences emotionally, we introduce emotion-aware story generation, a new task that aims to generate subject-consistent visual stories with explicit emotional directions. This task is challenging due to the abstract nature of emotions, which must be grounded in concrete visual elements and consistently expressed across a narrative through visual composition.
