title: MultiGraSCCo: A Multilingual Anonymization Benchmark with Annotations of Personal Identifiers
comments: Accepted at the International Conference on Language Resources and Evaluation (LREC2026)
summary: Accessing sensitive patient data for machine learning is challenging due to privacy concerns. Datasets with annotations of personally identifiable information are crucial for developing and testing anonymization systems to enable safe data sharing that complies with privacy regulations. Since accessing real patient data is a bottleneck, synthetic data offers an efficient solution for data scarcity, bypassing privacy regulations that apply to real data. Moreover, neural machine translation can help to create high-quality data for low-resource languages by translating validated real or synthetic data from a high-resource language. In this work, we create a multilingual anonymization benchmark in ten languages, using a machine translation methodology that preserves the original annotations and renders names of cities and people in a culturally and contextually appropriate form in each target language. Our evaluation study with medical professionals confirms the quality of the translations, both in general and with respect to the translation and adaptation of personal information. Our benchmark with over 2,500 annotations of personal information can be used in many applications, including training annotators, validating annotations across institutions without legal complications, and helping improve the performance of automatic personal information detection. We make our benchmark and annotation guidelines available for further research.
comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Language Resources and Evaluation (LREC2026)

AI.title_translation: MultiGraSCCo：一个带有个人身份标识注释的多语言匿名化基准
AI.tldr: 本文提出了MultiGraSCCo，一个包含十种语言、2500多个个人身份信息注释的多语言匿名化基准，旨在解决敏感患者数据隐私和数据稀缺问题，其质量已由医学专业人员验证，可用于开发和测试匿名化系统。
AI.motivation: 由于隐私问题，访问敏感患者数据进行机器学习具有挑战性。开发和测试匿名化系统需要带有个人身份信息注释的数据集，但真实数据获取困难。合成数据是解决数据稀缺的有效方案，而神经机器翻译可为低资源语言创建高质量数据。
AI.method: 通过机器翻译方法创建了一个十种语言的多语言匿名化基准。该方法保留了原始注释，并以文化和上下文适当的形式在每种目标语言中呈现城市和人名。
AI.result: 成功创建了一个包含2500多个个人信息注释的多语言匿名化基准。与医学专业人员进行的评估研究证实了翻译的质量，包括一般翻译以及个人信息的翻译和改编。
AI.conclusion: 该基准可用于多种应用，例如培训注释员、在没有法律并发症的情况下跨机构验证注释，以及帮助提高自动个人信息检测的性能。该基准和注释指南已公开供进一步研究。
AI.translation: 由于隐私问题，访问敏感患者数据进行机器学习具有挑战性。带有个人身份信息注释的数据集对于开发和测试匿名化系统至关重要，以实现符合隐私法规的安全数据共享。由于访问真实患者数据是一个瓶颈，合成数据为数据稀缺提供了一种高效的解决方案，绕过了适用于真实数据的隐私法规。此外，神经机器翻译可以通过翻译高资源语言中经过验证的真实或合成数据，帮助为低资源语言创建高质量数据。在这项工作中，我们使用一种机器翻译方法创建了一个十种语言的多语言匿名化基准，该方法保留了原始注释，并以文化和上下文适当的形式在每种目标语言中呈现城市和人名。我们与医学专业人员进行的评估研究证实了翻译的质量，无论是在一般情况下还是在个人信息的翻译和改编方面。我们包含2500多个个人信息注释的基准可用于许多应用，包括培训注释员、在没有法律并发症的情况下跨机构验证注释，以及帮助提高自动个人信息检测的性能。我们公开了我们的基准和注释指南，以供进一步研究。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了MultiGraSCCo，一个多语言匿名化基准，旨在解决敏感患者数据在机器学习中因隐私和数据稀缺面临的挑战。该基准涵盖十种语言，通过机器翻译方法创建，在保留原始注释的同时，确保个人信息（如城市和人名）在目标语言中具有文化和上下文的适宜性。该基准包含超过2500个个人信息注释，并经过医学专业人员的质量验证。它可用于培训注释员、跨机构验证注释以及提升自动个人信息检测系统的性能。
AI.keywords: 多语言匿名化, 个人身份信息, 基准数据集, 机器翻译, 隐私保护
AI.comments: 这项工作通过创建一个多语言、带注释的合成数据基准，创新性地解决了敏感数据匿名化和数据稀缺的难题。其结合机器翻译和文化适应的方法对于提升低资源语言的匿名化技术具有重要意义。该基准的公开将极大地推动相关研究和应用开发，尤其是在医疗健康领域。

title: Exploring the Design of GenAI-Based Systems to Support Socially Shared Metacognition
summary: Socially shared metacognition (SSM) refers to the collective monitoring and regulation of joint cognitive processes in collaborative problem-solving, and is essential for effective knowledge work and learning. Generative AI (GenAI)-based systems offer new opportunities to support SSM, but emerging evidence suggests that poorly designed systems can encourage over-reliance on AI-generated explicit instruction and erode groups' capacity to develop autonomous regulatory processes. Group awareness tools (GATs) address this challenge through established design principles that make social and cognitive awareness information visible, highlight differences between group members to create cognitive conflict, and trigger autonomous elaboration and discussion, thereby implicitly guiding autonomous SSM emergence. This paper explores the design of GenAI-augmented GATs to support autonomous SSM in collaborative work and learning through an initial literature search, presenting preliminary design principles for discussion.

AI.title_translation: 探索支持社会共享元认知的生成式人工智能（GenAI）系统的设计
AI.tldr: 为了避免GenAI系统削弱群体自主解决问题的能力，本研究探索了将GenAI与群体意识工具（GATs）相结合的设计，旨在利用GenAI支持社会共享元认知（SSM），同时通过设计策略（如突出差异）来促进群体的自主调节和讨论，而不是依赖AI的明确指令。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI系统为支持社会共享元认知（SSM）提供了新机会，但设计不当可能导致过度依赖AI指令并削弱群体自主调节能力。因此，需要探索设计GenAI增强的GATs来支持自主SSM。
AI.method: 通过初步的文献搜索，探索和提出了支持自主SSM的GenAI增强型群体意识工具（GATs）的设计原则。
AI.result: 提出了支持自主SSM的GenAI增强型GATs的初步设计原则，这些原则借鉴了现有GATs的设计原则，旨在使信息可见、突出差异以产生认知冲突，并触发自主的阐述和讨论。
AI.conclusion: 尚未明确得出结论，但提出了支持自主SSM的GenAI增强GATs的初步设计原则，以供讨论。
AI.translation: 本文探索了基于生成式人工智能（GenAI）的系统设计，以支持社会共享的元认知。社会共享元认知（SSM）指的是协作解决问题中对联合认知过程的集体监控和调节，对有效的知识工作和学习至关重要。生成式人工智能（GenAI）系统为支持SSM提供了新的机会，但新兴证据表明，设计不当的系统可能会鼓励过度依赖AI生成的明确指令，并削弱群体发展自主调节过程的能力。群体意识工具（GATs）通过既定的设计原则解决了这一挑战，这些原则使社会和认知意识信息可见，突出小组成员之间的差异以产生认知冲突，并触发自主的阐述和讨论，从而隐性地引导自主SSM的出现。本文通过初步的文献搜索，探讨了设计GenAI增强型GATs以支持协作工作和学习中的自主SSM，并提出了初步的设计原则以供讨论。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了如何设计基于生成式人工智能（GenAI）的群体意识工具（GATs），以支持协作解决问题中的社会共享元认知（SSM）。鉴于设计不当的GenAI系统可能导致过度依赖，研究借鉴了现有GATs的设计原则，旨在通过使信息可见和引发认知冲突等方式，隐性地引导群体发展自主的调节过程。研究通过初步文献搜索，提出了支持自主SSM的GenAI增强GATs的设计原则，以供进一步讨论。
AI.keywords: 社会共享元认知, 生成式人工智能, 群体意识工具, 自主调节, 协作学习
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将现有的群体意识工具（GATs）的设计原则与生成式人工智能（GenAI）相结合，以支持自主的社会共享元认知（SSM），避免了过度依赖AI指令的风险。其重要性在于为设计既能利用GenAI能力又能维护和增强群体自主调节过程的协作系统提供了初步框架。局限性在于这只是一个初步的文献搜索和设计原则的提出，需要进一步的实证研究来验证这些原则的有效性。

title: A New Modeling to Feature Selection Based on the Fuzzy Rough Set Theory in Normal and Optimistic States on Hybrid Information Systems
comments: 18 pages, 14 figures, 9 tables. Published version available at International Journal of Engineering. This preprint is distributed under CC BY 4.0 license
summary: Considering the high volume, wide variety, and rapid speed of data generation, investigating feature selection methods for big data presents various applications and advantages. By removing irrelevant and redundant features, feature selection reduces data dimensions, thereby facilitating optimal decision-making within decision systems. One of the key tools for feature selection in hybrid information systems is fuzzy rough set theory. However, this theory faces two significant challenges: First, obtaining fuzzy equivalence relations through intersection operations in high-dimensional spaces can be both time-consuming and memory-intensive. Additionally, this method may produce noisy data, complicating the feature selection process. The purpose and innovation of this paper are to address these issues. We proposed a new feature selection model that calculates the combined distance between objects and subsequently used this information to derive the fuzzy equivalence relation. Rather than directly solving the feature selection problem, this approach reformulates it into an optimization problem that can be tackled using appropriate meta-heuristic algorithms. We have named this new approach FSbuHD. The FSbuHD model operates in two modes - normal and optimistic - based on the selection of one of the two introduced fuzzy equivalence relations. The model is then tested on standard datasets from the UCI repository and compared with other algorithms. The results of this research demonstrate that FSbuHD is one of the most efficient and effective methods for feature selection when compared to previous methods and algorithms.

AI.title_translation: 一种基于模糊粗糙集理论在混合信息系统正常和乐观状态下的新特征选择建模
AI.tldr: 为了解决传统模糊粗糙集特征选择在高维数据下计算慢和产生噪声的问题，本文提出了FSbuHD模型，它通过计算对象间的距离来构建模糊等价关系，并将问题转化为可优化的形式，实验证明其性能更优。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于模糊粗糙集理论的特征选择方法在处理高维数据时，通过交集操作获取模糊等价关系耗时且占用内存，并且可能产生噪声数据，阻碍了特征选择过程。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的特征选择模型FSbuHD，该模型通过计算对象间的联合距离来推导模糊等价关系，并将特征选择问题重新表述为一个可以通过元启发式算法解决的优化问题。该模型在“正常”和“乐观”两种状态下运行。
AI.result: FSbuHD模型在UCI存储库的标准数据集上进行了测试，并与其他算法进行了比较，结果表明其效率和有效性优于先前的方法和算法。
AI.conclusion: FSbuHD是目前最有效和高效的特征选择方法之一，优于先前的方法和算法。
AI.translation: 考虑到数据生成的高量、广域和高速，研究大数据特征选择方法具有各种应用和优势。通过去除不相关和冗余的特征，特征选择可以降低数据维度，从而促进决策系统内的最优决策。模糊粗糙集理论是混合信息系统中特征选择的关键工具之一。然而，该理论面临两个重大挑战：第一，在高维空间中通过交集操作获得模糊等价关系可能既耗时又占用大量内存。此外，该方法可能会产生噪声数据，使特征选择过程复杂化。本文的目的和创新在于解决这些问题。我们提出了一种新的特征选择模型，该模型计算对象之间的联合距离，并利用该信息来推导模糊等价关系。该方法没有直接解决特征选择问题，而是将其重新构建为一个可以通过适当的元启发式算法解决的优化问题。我们将这种新方法命名为FSbuHD。FSbuHD模型根据所选择的两种引入的模糊等价关系中的一种，在正常和乐观两种模式下运行。然后，该模型在UCI存储库的标准数据集上进行了测试，并与其他算法进行了比较。本研究的结果表明，与先前的方法和算法相比，FSbuHD是最高效和最有效的特征选择方法之一。
AI.summary: 本文针对混合信息系统中基于模糊粗糙集理论的特征选择方法在高维数据处理中面临的计算复杂性和噪声问题，提出了一种名为FSbuHD的新模型。该模型通过计算对象间的联合距离来推导模糊等价关系，并将特征选择转化为一个优化问题，该模型具有“正常”和“乐观”两种运行模式。实验结果证明了FSbuHD的高效性和有效性。
AI.keywords: 特征选择, 模糊粗糙集理论, 混合信息系统, 优化问题, 联合距离
AI.comments: 该论文的主要创新在于将模糊粗糙集理论中的特征选择问题重新构建为一个优化问题，并引入了基于对象间联合距离来推导模糊等价关系的新方法（FSbuHD），从而解决了传统方法在处理高维数据时计算复杂和产生噪声的问题。其引入的“正常”和“乐观”两种状态模式是其方法的特色。

title: Design Guidance Towards Addressing Over-Reliance on AI in Sensemaking
summary: Sensemaking in collaborative work and learning is increasingly supported by GenAI systems, however, emerging evidence suggests that poorly designed GenAI systems tend to provide explicit instruction that groups passively follow, fostering over-reliance and eroding autonomous sensemaking. Group awareness tools (GATs) address this challenge through implicit guidance: rather than instructing groups on what to do, GATs externalize observable collaboration data through visualizations that reveal differences between group members to create cognitive conflict, which triggers autonomous elaboration and discussion, thereby implicitly guiding autonomous sensemaking emergence. Drawing on an initial literature search of existing GAT systems, this paper explores the design of GenAI-augmented GATs to support autonomous sensemaking in collaborative work and learning, presenting preliminary design principles for discussion.

AI.title_translation: 关于解决过度依赖人工智能进行认知感知的（Sensemaking）的设计指南
AI.tldr: GenAI容易导致人们过度依赖其明确指令，削弱自主思考。本文建议结合群体意识工具（GATs）——通过可视化数据制造认知冲突来隐式引导思考——来设计增强了GenAI的系统，以促进协作中的自主认知，并提出了初步的设计原则。
AI.motivation: 新兴证据表明，设计不当的GenAI系统倾向于提供明确的指令，导致群体被动遵循，从而助长过度依赖并侵蚀自主认知。因此，需要设计新的机制来支持自主认知。
AI.method: 通过对现有GATs系统的初步文献检索，探讨了设计增强了GenAI的GATs以支持协作工作和学习中的自主认知，并提出了初步的设计原则。
AI.result: 提出了支持协作工作和学习中自主认知的GenAI增强型GATs的设计探索和初步设计原则。
AI.translation: 在协作工作和学习中，认知感知越来越多地得到生成式人工智能（GenAI）系统的支持，然而，新兴证据表明，设计不当的GenAI系统倾向于提供群体被动遵循的明确指令，从而助长过度依赖并侵蚀自主认知。群体意识工具（GATs）通过隐式引导来应对这一挑战：GATs不是指导群体该做什么，而是通过可视化来外化可观察的协作数据，揭示群体成员间的差异，从而产生认知冲突，引发自主阐述和讨论，进而隐式地引导自主认知的出现。本文基于对现有GATs系统的初步文献检索，探讨了设计增强了GenAI的GATs以支持协作工作和学习中的自主认知，并提出了供讨论的初步设计原则。
AI.summary: 为解决生成式AI支持的认知过程中过度依赖的问题，本文提出利用群体意识工具（GATs）的隐式引导机制。GATs通过可视化协作数据来揭示群体成员间的差异，从而引发认知冲突，进而激发自主的阐述和讨论，以支持自主认知。文章基于现有GATs的文献探索了增强型GATs的设计，并提出了初步的设计原则。
AI.keywords: 生成式AI,过度依赖,群体意识工具,自主认知,设计原则
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于探索如何利用Group Awareness Tools (GATs) 的隐式引导机制来应对生成式AI（GenAI）系统中常见的过度依赖问题，并提出了将GATs与GenAI相结合的设计原则，这对于未来人机协作系统的设计具有重要的指导意义。其局限性在于目前仅是初步的设计原则探讨。

title: PathoScribe: Transforming Pathology Data into a Living Library with a Unified LLM-Driven Framework for Semantic Retrieval and Clinical Integration
summary: Pathology underpins modern diagnosis and cancer care, yet its most valuable asset, the accumulated experience encoded in millions of narrative reports, remains largely inaccessible. Although institutions are rapidly digitizing pathology workflows, storing data without effective mechanisms for retrieval and reasoning risks transforming archives into a passive data repository, where institutional knowledge exists but cannot meaningfully inform patient care. True progress requires not only digitization, but the ability for pathologists to interrogate prior similar cases in real time while evaluating a new diagnostic dilemma. We present PathoScribe, a unified retrieval-augmented large language model (LLM) framework designed to transform static pathology archives into a searchable, reasoning-enabled living library. PathoScribe enables natural language case exploration, automated cohort construction, clinical question answering, immunohistochemistry (IHC) panel recommendation, and prompt-controlled report transformation within a single architecture. Evaluated on 70,000 multi-institutional surgical pathology reports, PathoScribe achieved perfect Recall@10 for natural language case retrieval and demonstrated high-quality retrieval-grounded reasoning (mean reviewer score 4.56/5). Critically, the system operationalized automated cohort construction from free-text eligibility criteria, assembling research-ready cohorts in minutes (mean 9.2 minutes) with 91.3% agreement to human reviewers and no eligible cases incorrectly excluded, representing orders-of-magnitude reductions in time and cost compared to traditional manual chart review. This work establishes a scalable foundation for converting digital pathology archives from passive storage systems into active clinical intelligence platforms.

title: Differentially Private Secure Multiplication: Beyond Two Multiplicands
summary: We study the problem of differentially private (DP) secure multiplication in distributed computing systems, focusing on regimes where perfect privacy and perfect accuracy cannot be simultaneously achieved. Specifically, N nodes collaboratively compute the product of M private inputs while guaranteeing epsilon-DP against any collusion of up to T nodes. Prior work has characterized the fundamental privacy-accuracy trade-off for the multiplication of two multiplicands. In this paper, we extend these results to the more general setting of computing the product of an arbitrary number M of multiplicands. We propose a secure multiplication framework based on carefully designed encoding polynomials combined with layered noise injection. The proposed construction generalizes existing schemes and enables the systematic cancellation of lower-order noise terms, leading to improved estimation accuracy. We explore two regimes: (M-1)T+1 <= N <= MT and N = T+1. For (M-1)T+1 <= N <= MT, we characterize the optimal privacy--accuracy trade-off. When N = T+1, we derive nontrivial achievability and converse bounds that are asymptotically tight in the high-privacy regime.

title: PlayWorld: Learning Robot World Models from Autonomous Play
summary: Action-conditioned video models offer a promising path to building general-purpose robot simulators that can improve directly from data. Yet, despite training on large-scale robot datasets, current state-of-the-art video models still struggle to predict physically consistent robot-object interactions that are crucial in robotic manipulation. To close this gap, we present PlayWorld, a simple, scalable, and fully autonomous pipeline for training high-fidelity video world simulators from interaction experience. In contrast to prior approaches that rely on success-biased human demonstrations, PlayWorld is the first system capable of learning entirely from unsupervised robot self-play, enabling naturally scalable data collection while capturing complex, long-tailed physical interactions essential for modeling realistic object dynamics. Experiments across diverse manipulation tasks show that PlayWorld generates high-quality, physically consistent predictions for contact-rich interactions that are not captured by world models trained on human-collected data. We further demonstrate the versatility of PlayWorld in enabling fine-grained failure prediction and policy evaluation, with up to 40% improvements over human-collected data. Finally, we demonstrate how PlayWorld enables reinforcement learning in the world model, improving policy performance by 65% in success rates when deployed in the real world.

title: VIVID-Med: LLM-Supervised Structured Pretraining for Deployable Medical ViTs
summary: Vision-language pretraining has driven significant progress in medical image analysis. However, current methods typically supervise visual encoders using one-hot labels or free-form text, neither of which effectively captures the complex semantic relationships among clinical findings. In this study, we introduce VIVID-Med, a novel framework that leverages a frozen large language model (LLM) as a structured semantic teacher to pretrain medical vision transformers (ViTs). VIVID-Med translates clinical findings into verifiable JSON field-state pairs via a Unified Medical Schema (UMS), utilizing answerability-aware masking to focus optimization. It then employs Structured Prediction Decomposition (SPD) to partition cross-attention into orthogonality-regularized query groups, extracting complementary visual aspects. Crucially, the LLM is discarded post-training, yielding a lightweight, deployable ViT-only backbone. We evaluated VIVID-Med across multiple settings: on CheXpert linear probing, it achieves a macro-AUC of 0.8588, outperforming BiomedCLIP by +6.65 points while using 500x less data. It also demonstrates robust zero-shot cross-domain transfer to NIH ChestX-ray14 (0.7225 macro-AUC) and strong cross-modality generalization to CT, achieving 0.8413 AUC on LIDC-IDRI lung nodule classification and 0.9969 macro-AUC on OrganAMNIST 11-organ classification. VIVID-Med offers a highly efficient, scalable alternative to deploying resource-heavy vision-language models in clinical settings.

title: Transformer-Based Multi-Region Segmentation and Radiomic Analysis of HR-pQCT Imaging for Osteoporosis Classification
summary: Osteoporosis is a skeletal disease typically diagnosed using dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA), which quantifies areal bone mineral density but overlooks bone microarchitecture and surrounding soft tissues. High-resolution peripheral quantitative computed tomography (HR-pQCT) enables three-dimensional microstructural imaging with minimal radiation. However, current analysis pipelines largely focus on mineralized bone compartments, leaving much of the acquired image data underutilized. We introduce a fully automated framework for binary osteoporosis classification using radiomics features extracted from anatomically segmented HR-pQCT images. To our knowledge, this work is the first to leverage a transformer-based segmentation architecture, i.e., the SegFormer, for fully automated multi-region HR-pQCT analysis. The SegFormer model simultaneously delineated the cortical and trabecular bone of the tibia and fibula along with surrounding soft tissues and achieved a mean F1 score of 95.36%. Soft tissues were further subdivided into skin, myotendinous, and adipose regions through post-processing. From each region, 939 radiomic features were extracted and dimensionally reduced to train six machine learning classifiers on an independent dataset comprising 20,496 images from 122 HR-pQCT scans. The best image level performance was achieved using myotendinous tissue features, yielding an accuracy of 80.08% and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.85, outperforming bone-based models. At the patient level, replacing standard biological, DXA, and HR-pQCT parameters with soft tissue radiomics improved AUROC from 0.792 to 0.875. These findings demonstrate that automated, multi-region HR-pQCT segmentation enables the extraction of clinically informative signals beyond bone alone, highlighting the importance of integrated tissue assessment for osteoporosis detection.

title: Agentic AI as a Network Control-Plane Intelligence Layer for Federated Learning over 6G
summary: The shift toward user-customized on-device learning places new demands on wireless systems: models must be trained on diverse, distributed data while meeting strict latency, bandwidth, and reliability constraints. To address this, we propose an Agentic AI as the control layer for managing federated learning (FL) over 6G networks, which translates high-level task goals into actions that are aware of network conditions. Rather than simply viewing FL as a learning challenge, our system sees it as a combined task of learning and network management. A set of specialized agents focused on retrieval, planning, coding, and evaluation utilizes monitoring tools and optimization methods to handle client selection, incentive structuring, scheduling, resource allocation, adaptive local training, and code generation. The use of closed-loop evaluation and memory allows the system to consistently refine its decisions, taking into account varying signal-to-noise ratios, bandwidth conditions, and device capabilities. Finally, our case study has demonstrated the effectiveness of the Agentic AI system's use of tools for achieving high performance.

title: Optimal partition selection with Rényi differential privacy
summary: A common problem in private data analysis is the partition selection problem, where each user holds a set of partitions (e.g. keys in a GROUP BY operation) from a possibly unbounded set. The challenge here is in maximizing the set of released partitions while respecting a differential privacy constraint. Previous work [Desfontaines et al., PoPETS 2022] presented an optimal $(\varepsilon, δ)$-DP algorithm when each user submits only a single partition. We generalize this approach to find the optimal algorithm under $δ$-approximate $(α, \varepsilon)$-Rényi differential privacy (RDP), which allows much tighter analysis under composition. Motivated by the non-existence of a general optimality result in the case where users submit multiple partitions each, we present an extension of our optimal algorithm tuned for $L^2$ bounded weighted partition selection which can be used as a drop-in improvement over the Gaussian mechanism any time the partition frequency is not also needed. We show that our primitive can be easily plugged into state of the art partition selection algorithms (PolicyGaussian from [Gopi et al., ICML 2020] and MAD2R from [Chen et al., ICML 2025]), improving performance both for parallel and sequential adaptive algorithms. Finally, we show that there is an inherent cost to algorithms which do support releasing the frequency as well as the partitions. Specifically, we formulate a basic notion of optimal approximate RDP algorithm for partition selection using additive noise, and show that there is a numerical separation between additive and non-additive noise mechanisms for this problem.

title: Proxy-Guided Measurement Calibration
summary: Aggregate outcome variables collected through surveys and administrative records are often subject to systematic measurement error. For instance, in disaster loss databases, county-level losses reported may differ from the true damages due to variations in on-the-ground data collection capacity, reporting practices, and event characteristics. Such miscalibration complicates downstream analysis and decision-making. We study the problem of outcome miscalibration and propose a framework guided by proxy variables for estimating and correcting the systematic errors. We model the data-generating process using a causal graph that separates latent content variables driving the true outcome from the latent bias variables that induce systematic errors. The key insight is that proxy variables that depend on the true outcome but are independent of the bias mechanism provide identifying information for quantifying the bias. Leveraging this structure, we introduce a two-stage approach that utilizes variational autoencoders to disentangle content and bias latents, enabling us to estimate the effect of bias on the outcome of interest. We analyze the assumptions underlying our approach and evaluate it on synthetic data, semi-synthetic datasets derived from randomized trials, and a real-world case study of disaster loss reporting.

title: Curveball Steering: The Right Direction To Steer Isn't Always Linear
summary: Activation steering is a widely used approach for controlling large language model (LLM) behavior by intervening on internal representations. Existing methods largely rely on the Linear Representation Hypothesis, assuming behavioral attributes can be manipulated using global linear directions. In practice, however, such linear interventions often behave inconsistently. We question this assumption by analyzing the intrinsic geometry of LLM activation spaces. Measuring geometric distortion via the ratio of geodesic to Euclidean distances, we observe substantial and concept-dependent distortions, indicating that activation spaces are not well-approximated by a globally linear geometry. Motivated by this, we propose "Curveball steering", a nonlinear steering method based on polynomial kernel PCA that performs interventions in a feature space, better respecting the learned activation geometry. Curveball steering consistently outperforms linear PCA-based steering, particularly in regimes exhibiting strong geometric distortion, suggesting that geometry-aware, nonlinear steering provides a principled alternative to global, linear interventions.

title: SPAARS: Safer RL Policy Alignment through Abstract Exploration and Refined Exploitation of Action Space
summary: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising paradigm for robotics by pre-training policies on safe, offline demonstrations and fine-tuning them via online interaction. However, a fundamental challenge remains: how to safely explore online without deviating from the behavioral support of the offline data? While recent methods leverage conditional variational autoencoders (CVAEs) to bound exploration within a latent space, they inherently suffer from an exploitation gap -- a performance ceiling imposed by the decoder's reconstruction loss. We introduce SPAARS, a curriculum learning framework that initially constrains exploration to the low-dimensional latent manifold for sample-efficient, safe behavioral improvement, then seamlessly transfers control to the raw action space, bypassing the decoder bottleneck. SPAARS has two instantiations: the CVAE-based variant requires only unordered (s,a) pairs and no trajectory segmentation; SPAARS-SUPE pairs SPAARS with OPAL temporal skill pretraining for stronger exploration structure at the cost of requiring trajectory chunks. We prove an upper bound on the exploitation gap using the Performance Difference Lemma, establish that latent-space policy gradients achieve provable variance reduction over raw-space exploration, and show that concurrent behavioral cloning during the latent phase directly controls curriculum transition stability. Empirically, SPAARS-SUPE achieves 0.825 normalized return on kitchen-mixed-v0 versus 0.75 for SUPE, with 5x better sample efficiency; standalone SPAARS achieves 92.7 and 102.9 normalized return on hopper-medium-v2 and walker2d-medium-v2 respectively, surpassing IQL baselines of 66.3 and 78.3 respectively, confirming the utility of the unordered-pair CVAE instantiation.

title: Reconstructing Movement from Sparse Samples: Enhanced Spatio-Temporal Matching Strategies for Low-Frequency Data
summary: This paper explores potential improvements to the Spatial-Temporal Matching algorithm for aligning the GPS trajectories to road networks. While this algorithm is effective, it presents some limitations in computational efficiency and the accuracy of the results, especially in dense environments with relatively high sampling intervals. To address this, the paper proposes four modifications to the original algorithm: a dynamic buffer, an adaptive observation probability, a redesigned temporal scoring function, and a behavioral analysis to account for the historical mobility patterns. The enhancements are assessed using real-world data from the urban area of Milan, and through newly defined evaluation metrics to be applied in the absence of ground truth. The results of the experiment show significant improvements in performance efficiency and path quality across various metrics.

title: Prune Redundancy, Preserve Essence: Vision Token Compression in VLMs via Synergistic Importance-Diversity
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) face significant computational inefficiencies caused by excessive generation of visual tokens. While prior work shows that a large fraction of visual tokens are redundant, existing compression methods struggle to balance importance preservation and information diversity. To address this, we propose PruneSID, a training-free Synergistic Importance-Diversity approach featuring a two-stage pipeline: (1) Principal Semantic Components Analysis (PSCA) for clustering tokens into semantically coherent groups, ensuring comprehensive concept coverage, and (2) Intra-group Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) for pruning redundant tokens while preserving key representative tokens within each group. Additionally, PruneSID incorporates an information-aware dynamic compression ratio mechanism that optimizes token compression rates based on image complexity, enabling more effective average information preservation across diverse scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, achieving 96.3% accuracy on LLaVA-1.5 with only 11.1% token retention, and 92.8% accuracy at extreme compression rates (5.6%) on LLaVA-NeXT, outperforming prior methods by 2.5% with 7.8 $\times$ faster prefilling speed compared to the original model. Our framework generalizes across diverse VLMs and both image and video modalities, showcasing strong cross-modal versatility. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhengyaoFang/PruneSID.

title: Streaming Autoregressive Video Generation via Diagonal Distillation
comments: ICLR 2026 (31 pages, 10 figures, project page: https://spherelab.ai/diagdistill/)
summary: Large pretrained diffusion models have significantly enhanced the quality of generated videos, and yet their use in real-time streaming remains limited. Autoregressive models offer a natural framework for sequential frame synthesis but require heavy computation to achieve high fidelity. Diffusion distillation can compress these models into efficient few-step variants, but existing video distillation approaches largely adapt image-specific methods that neglect temporal dependencies. These techniques often excel in image generation but underperform in video synthesis, exhibiting reduced motion coherence, error accumulation over long sequences, and a latency-quality trade-off. We identify two factors that result in these limitations: insufficient utilization of temporal context during step reduction and implicit prediction of subsequent noise levels in next-chunk prediction (i.e., exposure bias). To address these issues, we propose Diagonal Distillation, which operates orthogonally to existing approaches and better exploits temporal information across both video chunks and denoising steps. Central to our approach is an asymmetric generation strategy: more steps early, fewer steps later. This design allows later chunks to inherit rich appearance information from thoroughly processed early chunks, while using partially denoised chunks as conditional inputs for subsequent synthesis. By aligning the implicit prediction of subsequent noise levels during chunk generation with the actual inference conditions, our approach mitigates error propagation and reduces oversaturation in long-range sequences. We further incorporate implicit optical flow modeling to preserve motion quality under strict step constraints. Our method generates a 5-second video in 2.61 seconds (up to 31 FPS), achieving a 277.3x speedup over the undistilled model.

title: Context-Nav: Context-Driven Exploration and Viewpoint-Aware 3D Spatial Reasoning for Instance Navigation
summary: Text-goal instance navigation (TGIN) asks an agent to resolve a single, free-form description into actions that reach the correct object instance among same-category distractors. We present \textit{Context-Nav} that elevates long, contextual captions from a local matching cue to a global exploration prior and verifies candidates through 3D spatial reasoning. First, we compute dense text-image alignments for a value map that ranks frontiers -- guiding exploration toward regions consistent with the entire description rather than early detections. Second, upon observing a candidate, we perform a viewpoint-aware relation check: the agent samples plausible observer poses, aligns local frames, and accepts a target only if the spatial relations can be satisfied from at least one viewpoint. The pipeline requires no task-specific training or fine-tuning; we attain state-of-the-art performance on InstanceNav and CoIN-Bench. Ablations show that (i) encoding full captions into the value map avoids wasted motion and (ii) explicit, viewpoint-aware 3D verification prevents semantically plausible but incorrect stops. This suggests that geometry-grounded spatial reasoning is a scalable alternative to heavy policy training or human-in-the-loop interaction for fine-grained instance disambiguation in cluttered 3D scenes.

title: A Saccade-inspired Approach to Image Classification using Vision Transformer Attention Maps
comments: 16 page, 11 figure main paper + 3 pages, 6 appendix
summary: Human vision achieves remarkable perceptual performance while operating under strict metabolic constraints. A key ingredient is the selective attention mechanism, driven by rapid saccadic eye movements that constantly reposition the high-resolution fovea onto task-relevant locations, unlike conventional AI systems that process entire images with equal emphasis. Our work aims to draw inspiration from the human visual system to create smarter, more efficient image processing models. Using DINO, a self-supervised Vision Transformer that produces attention maps strikingly similar to human gaze patterns, we explore a saccade inspired method to focus the processing of information on key regions in visual space. To do so, we use the ImageNet dataset in a standard classification task and measure how each successive saccade affects the model's class scores. This selective-processing strategy preserves most of the full-image classification performance and can even outperform it in certain cases. By benchmarking against established saliency models built for human gaze prediction, we demonstrate that DINO provides superior fixation guidance for selecting informative regions. These findings highlight Vision Transformer attention as a promising basis for biologically inspired active vision and open new directions for efficient, neuromorphic visual processing.
comment: 16 page, 11 figure main paper + 3 pages, 6 appendix

title: Tracking Cancer Through Text: Longitudinal Extraction From Radiology Reports Using Open-Source Large Language Models
summary: Radiology reports capture crucial longitudinal information on tumor burden, treatment response, and disease progression, yet their unstructured narrative format complicates automated analysis. While large language models (LLMs) have advanced clinical text processing, most state-of-the-art systems remain proprietary, limiting their applicability in privacy-sensitive healthcare environments. We present a fully open-source, locally deployable pipeline for longitudinal information extraction from radiology reports, implemented using the llm_extractinator framework. The system applies the qwen2.5-72b model to extract and link target, non-target, and new lesion data across time points in accordance with RECIST criteria. Evaluation on 50 Dutch CT Thorax/Abdomen report pairs yielded high extraction performance, with attribute-level accuracies of 93.7% for target lesions, 94.9% for non-target lesions, and 94.0% for new lesions. The approach demonstrates that open-source LLMs can achieve clinically meaningful performance in multi-timepoint oncology tasks while ensuring data privacy and reproducibility. These results highlight the potential of locally deployable LLMs for scalable extraction of structured longitudinal data from routine clinical text.

title: MM-tau-p$^2$: Persona-Adaptive Prompting for Robust Multi-Modal Agent Evaluation in Dual-Control Settings
comments: A benchmark for evaluating multimodal both voice and text LLM agents in dualcontrol settings. We introduce persona adaptive prompting and 12 new metrics to assess robustness safety efficiency and recovery in customer support scenarios
summary: Current evaluation frameworks and benchmarks for LLM powered agents focus on text chat driven agents, these frameworks do not expose the persona of user to the agent, thus operating in a user agnostic environment. Importantly, in customer experience management domain, the agent's behaviour evolves as the agent learns about user personality. With proliferation of real time TTS and multi-modal language models, LLM based agents are gradually going to become multi-modal. Towards this, we propose the MM-tau-p$^2$ benchmark with metrics for evaluating the robustness of multi-modal agents in dual control setting with and without persona adaption of user, while also taking user inputs in the planning process to resolve a user query. In particular, our work shows that even with state of-the-art frontier LLMs like GPT-5, GPT 4.1, there are additional considerations measured using metrics viz. multi-modal robustness, turn overhead while introducing multi-modality into LLM based agents. Overall, MM-tau-p$^2$ builds on our prior work FOCAL and provides a holistic way of evaluating multi-modal agents in an automated way by introducing 12 novel metrics. We also provide estimates of these metrics on the telecom and retail domains by using the LLM-as-judge approach using carefully crafted prompts with well defined rubrics for evaluating each conversation.
comment: A benchmark for evaluating multimodal both voice and text LLM agents in dualcontrol settings. We introduce persona adaptive prompting and 12 new metrics to assess robustness safety efficiency and recovery in customer support scenarios

title: Fusing Semantic, Lexical, and Domain Perspectives for Recipe Similarity Estimation
comments: Preprint version submitted to IEEE Big Data 2025
summary: This research focuses on developing advanced methods for assessing similarity between recipes by combining different sources of information and analytical approaches. We explore the semantic, lexical, and domain similarity of food recipes, evaluated through the analysis of ingredients, preparation methods, and nutritional attributes. A web-based interface was developed to allow domain experts to validate the combined similarity results. After evaluating 318 recipe pairs, experts agreed on 255 (80%). The evaluation of expert assessments enables the estimation of which similarity aspects--lexical, semantic, or nutritional--are most influential in expert decision-making. The application of these methods has broad implications in the food industry and supports the development of personalized diets, nutrition recommendations, and automated recipe generation systems.
comment: Preprint version submitted to IEEE Big Data 2025

title: AutoViVQA: A Large-Scale Automatically Constructed Dataset for Vietnamese Visual Question Answering
summary:
Visual Question Answering (VQA) is a fundamental multimodal task that requires models to jointly understand visual and textual information. Early VQA systems relied heavily on language biases, motivating subsequent work to emphasize visual grounding and balanced datasets. With the success of large-scale pre-trained transformers for both text and vision domains -- such as PhoBERT for Vietnamese language understanding and Vision Transformers (ViT) for image representation learning -- multimodal fusion has achieved remarkable progress.
  For Vietnamese VQA, several datasets have been introduced to promote research in low-resource multimodal learning, including ViVQA, OpenViVQA, and the recently proposed ViTextVQA. These resources enable benchmarking of models that integrate linguistic and visual features in the Vietnamese context.
  Evaluation of VQA systems often employs automatic metrics originally designed for image captioning or machine translation, such as BLEU, METEOR, CIDEr, Recall, Precision, and F1-score. However, recent research suggests that large language models can further improve the alignment between automatic evaluation and human judgment in VQA tasks.
  In this work, we explore Vietnamese Visual Question Answering using transformer-based architectures, leveraging both textual and visual pre-training while systematically comparing automatic evaluation metrics under multilingual settings.

title: Evaluation of LLMs in retrieving food and nutritional context for RAG systems
comments: This is the preprint for our conference paper for IEEE International Conference on Big Data
summary: In this article, we evaluate four Large Language Models (LLMs) and their effectiveness at retrieving data within a specialized Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system, using a comprehensive food composition database. Our method is focused on the LLMs ability to translate natural language queries into structured metadata filters, enabling efficient retrieval via a Chroma vector database. By achieving high accuracy in this critical retrieval step, we demonstrate that LLMs can serve as an accessible, high-performance tool, drastically reducing the manual effort and technical expertise previously required for domain experts, such as food compilers and nutritionists, to leverage complex food and nutrition data. However, despite the high performance on easy and moderately complex queries, our analysis of difficult questions reveals that reliable retrieval remains challenging when queries involve non-expressible constraints. These findings demonstrate that LLM-driven metadata filtering excels when constraints can be explicitly expressed, but struggles when queries exceed the representational scope of the metadata format.
comment: This is the preprint for our conference paper for IEEE International Conference on Big Data

title: ENIGMA-360: An Ego-Exo Dataset for Human Behavior Understanding in Industrial Scenarios
summary: Understanding human behavior from complementary egocentric (ego) and exocentric (exo) points of view enables the development of systems that can support workers in industrial environments and enhance their safety. However, progress in this area is hindered by the lack of datasets capturing both views in realistic industrial scenarios. To address this gap, we propose ENIGMA-360, a new ego-exo dataset acquired in a real industrial scenario. The dataset is composed of 180 egocentric and 180 exocentric procedural videos temporally synchronized offering complementary information of the same scene. The 360 videos have been labeled with temporal and spatial annotations, enabling the study of different aspects of human behavior in industrial domain. We provide baseline experiments for 3 foundational tasks for human behavior understanding: 1) Temporal Action Segmentation, 2) Keystep Recognition and 3) Egocentric Human-Object Interaction Detection, showing the limits of state-of-the-art approaches on this challenging scenario. These results highlight the need for new models capable of robust ego-exo understanding in real-world environments. We publicly release the dataset and its annotations at https://fpv-iplab.github.io/ENIGMA-360/.

title: Ego: Embedding-Guided Personalization of Vision-Language Models
comments: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
summary: AI assistants that support humans in daily life are becoming increasingly feasible, driven by the rapid advancements in multimodal language models. A key challenge lies in overcoming the generic nature of these models to deliver personalized experiences. Existing approaches to personalizing large vision language models often rely on additional training stages, which limit generality and scalability, or on engineered pipelines with external pre-trained modules, which hinder deployment efficiency. In this work, we propose an efficient personalization method that leverages the model's inherent ability to capture personalized concepts. Specifically, we extract visual tokens that predominantly represent the target concept by utilizing the model's internal attention mechanisms. These tokens serve as a memory of that specific concept, enabling the model to recall and describe it when it appears in test images. We conduct a comprehensive and unified evaluation of our approach and SOTA methods across various personalization settings including single-concept, multi-concept, and video personalization, demonstrating strong performance gains with minimal personalization overhead.
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026

title: MA-EgoQA: Question Answering over Egocentric Videos from Multiple Embodied Agents
summary: As embodied models become powerful, humans will collaborate with multiple embodied AI agents at their workplace or home in the future. To ensure better communication between human users and the multi-agent system, it is crucial to interpret incoming information from agents in parallel and refer to the appropriate context for each query. Existing challenges include effectively compressing and communicating high volumes of individual sensory inputs in the form of video and correctly aggregating multiple egocentric videos to construct system-level memory. In this work, we first formally define a novel problem of understanding multiple long-horizon egocentric videos simultaneously collected from embodied agents. To facilitate research in this direction, we introduce MultiAgent-EgoQA (MA-EgoQA), a benchmark designed to systemically evaluate existing models in our scenario. MA-EgoQA provides 1.7k questions unique to multiple egocentric streams, spanning five categories: social interaction, task coordination, theory-of-mind, temporal reasoning, and environmental interaction. We further propose a simple baseline model for MA-EgoQA named EgoMAS, which leverages shared memory across embodied agents and agent-wise dynamic retrieval. Through comprehensive evaluation across diverse baselines and EgoMAS on MA-EgoQA, we find that current approaches are unable to effectively handle multiple egocentric streams, highlighting the need for future advances in system-level understanding across the agents. The code and benchmark are available at https://ma-egoqa.github.io.

title: Robust Cooperative Localization in Featureless Environments: A Comparative Study of DCL, StCL, CCL, CI, and Standard-CL
comments: Presented at the 2026 12th International Conference on Automation, Robotics and Applications (ICARA); to be published in IEEE conference proceedings
summary: Cooperative localization (CL) enables accurate position estimation in multi-robot systems operating in GPS-denied environments. This paper presents a comparative study of five CL approaches: Centralized Cooperative Localization (CCL), Decentralized Cooperative Localization (DCL), Sequential Cooperative Localization (StCL), Covariance Intersection (CI), and Standard Cooperative Localization (Standard-CL). All methods are implemented in ROS and evaluated through Monte Carlo simulations under two conditions: weak data association and robust detection. Our analysis reveals fundamental trade-offs among the methods. StCL and Standard-CL achieve the lowest position errors but exhibit severe filter inconsistency, making them unsuitable for safety-critical applications. DCL demonstrates remarkable stability under challenging conditions due to its measurement stride mechanism, which provides implicit regularization against outliers. CI emerges as the most balanced approach, achieving near-optimal consistency while maintaining competitive accuracy. CCL provides theoretically optimal estimation but shows sensitivity to measurement outliers. These findings offer practical guidance for selecting CL algorithms based on application requirements.

title: LCA: Local Classifier Alignment for Continual Learning
comments: Accepted to the International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026)
summary: A fundamental requirement for intelligent systems is the ability to learn continuously under changing environments. However, models trained in this regime often suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Leveraging pre-trained models has recently emerged as a promising solution, since their generalized feature extractors enable faster and more robust adaptation. While some earlier works mitigate forgetting by fine-tuning only on the first task, this approach quickly deteriorates as the number of tasks grows and the data distributions diverge. More recent research instead seeks to consolidate task knowledge into a unified backbone, or adapting the backbone as new tasks arrive. However, such approaches may create a (potential) \textit{mismatch} between task-specific classifiers and the adapted backbone. To address this issue, we propose a novel \textit{Local Classifier Alignment} (LCA) loss to better align the classifier with backbone. Theoretically, we show that this LCA loss can enable the classifier to not only generalize well for all observed tasks, but also improve robustness. Furthermore, we develop a complete solution for continual learning, following the model merging approach and using LCA. Extensive experiments on several standard benchmarks demonstrate that our method often achieves leading performance, sometimes surpasses the state-of-the-art methods with a large margin.
comment: Accepted to the International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2026)

AI.title_translation: LCA：持续学习中的局部分类器对齐
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为局部分类器对齐（LCA）的新型损失函数，用于解决持续学习中任务特定分类器与适应性骨干网络之间的不匹配问题，从而减轻灾难性遗忘并提高性能。
AI.motivation: 智能系统需要持续学习以适应不断变化的环境，但这种学习范式常遭受灾难性遗忘。虽然利用预训练模型是一种有前景的解决方案，但现有方法如仅在第一个任务上微调或整合任务知识到统一骨干网络，可能导致任务特定分类器与适应性骨干网络之间出现不匹配。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种新颖的局部分类器对齐（LCA）损失，以更好地将分类器与骨干网络对齐。理论上，LCA损失能使分类器在所有已观测任务上泛化良好并提高鲁棒性。此外，本文开发了一个遵循模型合并方法并使用LCA的完整持续学习解决方案。
AI.result: 在多个标准基准上的大量实验表明，该方法通常能达到领先性能，有时甚至大幅超越现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: LCA损失能够有效解决持续学习中分类器与骨干网络的不匹配问题，提高模型的泛化能力和鲁棒性，并在多个基准测试中展现出卓越的性能。
AI.translation: 智能系统的一个基本要求是能够在不断变化的环境中持续学习。然而，在这种机制下训练的模型经常遭受灾难性遗忘。利用预训练模型最近成为一个有前景的解决方案，因为它们的广义特征提取器能够实现更快、更鲁棒的适应。虽然一些早期工作通过仅在第一个任务上进行微调来减轻遗忘，但随着任务数量的增加和数据分布的分歧，这种方法会迅速退化。最近的研究转而寻求将任务知识整合到统一的骨干网络中，或者在新任务到来时调整骨干网络。然而，这些方法可能会在任务特定分类器和适应性骨干网络之间产生（潜在的）不匹配。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的局部分类器对齐（LCA）损失，以更好地将分类器与骨干网络对齐。理论上，我们表明这种LCA损失不仅能使分类器在所有已观测任务上泛化良好，而且能提高鲁棒性。此外，我们开发了一个遵循模型合并方法并使用LCA的完整持续学习解决方案。在几个标准基准上的大量实验表明，我们的方法通常能达到领先性能，有时甚至大幅超越现有最先进方法。
AI.summary: 本文针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘和任务特定分类器与适应性骨干网络不匹配的问题，提出了一种名为局部分类器对齐（LCA）的新型损失函数。LCA旨在更好地对齐分类器与骨干网络，理论分析表明其能提升泛化能力和鲁棒性。结合模型合并方法，该完整解决方案在多个标准基准测试中取得了领先甚至超越现有最先进方法的性能。
AI.keywords: 持续学习, 灾难性遗忘, 局部分类器对齐, 预训练模型, 模型合并
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入LCA损失，创新性地解决了持续学习中预训练模型适应性骨干网络与任务特定分类器之间的潜在不匹配问题。其理论分析和实验结果均支持了LCA在缓解灾难性遗忘、提高泛化能力和鲁棒性方面的有效性，为持续学习领域提供了一个有价值的新方法。

title: A Voronoi Cell Formulation for Principled Token Pruning in Late-Interaction Retrieval Models
comments: 10 pages, 6 figures, corrected author's name in metadata
summary: Late-interaction models like ColBERT offer a competitive performance across various retrieval tasks, but require storing a dense embedding for each document token, leading to a substantial index storage overhead. Past works address this by attempting to prune low-importance token embeddings based on statistical and empirical measures, but they often either lack formal grounding or are ineffective. To address these shortcomings, we introduce a framework grounded in hyperspace geometry and cast token pruning as a Voronoi cell estimation problem in the embedding space. By interpreting each token's influence as a measure of its Voronoi region, our approach enables principled pruning that retains retrieval quality while reducing index size. Through our experiments, we demonstrate that this approach serves not only as a competitive pruning strategy but also as a valuable tool for improving and interpreting token-level behavior within dense retrieval systems.
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, corrected author's name in metadata

AI.title_translation: 一种基于Voronoi单元的晚期交互检索模型中规范化Token剪枝方法
AI.tldr: 晚期交互检索模型存储开销大。本文提出一种基于超空间几何和Voronoi单元估计的规范化token剪枝框架，有效减小索引大小并保持检索质量。
AI.motivation: 晚期交互检索模型（如ColBERT）性能优异，但存储每个文档token的密集嵌入导致巨大的索引存储开销。现有剪枝方法缺乏形式化基础或效果不佳。
AI.method: 引入一个基于超空间几何的框架，将token剪枝视为嵌入空间中的Voronoi单元估计问题。通过将每个token的影响解释为其Voronoi区域的度量，实现规范化的剪枝。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法不仅是一种具有竞争力的剪枝策略，而且是改进和解释密集检索系统中token级行为的宝贵工具。
AI.conclusion: 基于Voronoi单元的token剪枝方法能够有效减少晚期交互检索模型的索引大小，同时保持检索质量，并为理解token行为提供了新视角。
AI.translation: 像ColBERT这样的晚期交互模型在各种检索任务中提供了具有竞争力的性能，但需要为每个文档token存储一个密集的嵌入，导致巨大的索引存储开销。过去的工作通过尝试基于统计和经验度量来剪枝低重要性token嵌入来解决这个问题，但它们往往要么缺乏形式化基础，要么效果不佳。为了解决这些缺点，我们引入了一个基于超空间几何的框架，并将token剪枝视为嵌入空间中的Voronoi单元估计问题。通过将每个token的影响解释为其Voronoi区域的度量，我们的方法实现了规范化的剪枝，从而在减少索引大小的同时保持检索质量。通过我们的实验，我们证明这种方法不仅是一种具有竞争力的剪枝策略，而且是改进和解释密集检索系统中token级行为的宝贵工具。
AI.summary: 本文针对晚期交互检索模型（如ColBERT）面临的巨大索引存储开销问题，提出了一种基于超空间几何和Voronoi单元估计的规范化token剪枝框架。该方法通过将token影响视为Voronoi区域的度量，实现了在保持检索质量的同时有效减小索引大小。实验证明，该方法不仅是一种有效的剪枝策略，还能帮助理解和改进密集检索系统中的token级行为。
AI.keywords: 晚期交互检索, Token剪枝, Voronoi单元, 密集嵌入, 超空间几何
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将token剪枝问题转化为嵌入空间中的Voronoi单元估计，为晚期交互检索模型的索引优化提供了一个具有坚实几何基础的规范化方法。这不仅解决了存储开销大的实际问题，也为深入理解token在密集检索系统中的作用提供了新的理论工具。

title: Task Aware Modulation Using Representation Learning for Upsaling of Terrestrial Carbon Fluxes
comments: Accepted to the KGML Bridge at AAAI 2026 (non-archival)
summary: Accurately upscaling terrestrial carbon fluxes is central to estimating the global carbon budget, yet remains challenging due to the sparse and regionally biased distribution of ground measurements. Existing data-driven upscaling products often fail to generalize beyond observed domains, leading to systematic regional biases and high predictive uncertainty. We introduce Task-Aware Modulation with Representation Learning (TAM-RL), a framework that couples spatio-temporal representation learning with knowledge-guided encoder-decoder architecture and loss function derived from the carbon balance equation. Across 150+ flux tower sites representing diverse biomes and climate regimes, TAM-RL improves predictive performance relative to existing state-of-the-art datasets, reducing RMSE by 8-9.6% and increasing explained variance (R2) from 19.4% to 43.8%, depending on the target flux. These results demonstrate that integrating physically grounded constraints with adaptive representation learning can substantially enhance the robustness and transferability of global carbon flux estimates.

AI.title_translation: 面向陆地碳通量上推的任务感知调制与表示学习
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为TAM-RL的新框架，通过结合时空表示学习、知识引导的编码器-解码器架构和碳平衡方程推导出的损失函数，来解决陆地碳通量估算中的挑战。实验结果表明，TAM-RL相比现有方法能显著提高预测性能，降低RMSE并提高R2，尤其在不同生态系统和气候条件下表现出更强的鲁棒性和可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 陆地碳通量估算对于全球碳预算至关重要，但由于地面测量数据稀疏且分布不均，精确上推面临挑战。现有数据驱动的上推产品泛化能力不足，导致区域偏差和高预测不确定性。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为任务感知调制与表示学习（TAM-RL）的框架，该框架将时空表示学习与知识引导的编码器-解码器架构相结合，并利用碳平衡方程推导出损失函数。
AI.result: 在150多个通量塔站点上，TAM-RL相比现有最先进的数据集，在预测性能上有所提高。具体而言，根据目标通量的不同，RMSE降低了8-9.6%，解释方差（R2）从19.4%提高到43.8%。
AI.conclusion: 将物理约束与自适应表示学习相结合，可以显著提高全球碳通量估算的鲁棒性和可迁移性。
AI.translation: 准确地估算陆地碳通量是估计全球碳收支的关键，但由于地面测量的稀疏和区域偏差分布，这一直是一个挑战。现有的数据驱动的上推产品往往无法超出观测范围进行泛化，导致系统性的区域偏差和高预测不确定性。我们引入了任务感知调制与表示学习（TAM-RL）框架，该框架将时空表示学习与知识引导的编码器-解码器架构以及源自碳平衡方程的损失函数相结合。在代表不同生物群落和气候状况的150多个通量塔站点上，TAM-RL相对于现有的最先进数据集提高了预测性能，根据目标通量的不同，RMSE降低了8-9.6%，解释方差（R2）从19.4%提高到43.8%。这些结果表明，将物理约束与自适应表示学习相结合，可以显著提高全球碳通量估算的鲁棒性和可迁移性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为TAM-RL的框架，通过结合时空表示学习、知识引导的编码器-解码器架构以及基于碳平衡方程的损失函数，旨在解决陆地碳通量估算中的挑战。该方法在150多个通量塔站点的数据上进行了验证，结果显示其在降低预测误差和提高解释方差方面优于现有技术，证明了整合物理约束和表示学习对于提升碳通量估算鲁棒性和可迁移性的有效性。
AI.keywords: 碳通量,表示学习,任务感知调制,陆地生态系统,数据驱动模型
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的TAM-RL框架，通过整合物理知识和先进的表示学习技术，有效解决了陆地碳通量估算中的关键挑战，即数据稀疏性和泛化能力不足的问题。实验结果令人信服地展示了该方法在提高预测精度和鲁棒性方面的优势。然而，未来研究可以进一步探索该框架在不同空间尺度和时间分辨率下的适用性，以及考虑更多影响碳通量的环境因素。

title: Segmentation of Retinal Low-Cost Optical Coherence Tomography Images using Deep Learning
comments: Accepted for SPIE Medical Imaging 2020: Computer-Aided Diagnosis
summary: The treatment of age-related macular degeneration (AMD) requires continuous eye exams using optical coherence tomography (OCT). The need for treatment is determined by the presence or change of disease-specific OCT-based biomarkers. Therefore, the monitoring frequency has a significant influence on the success of AMD therapy. However, the monitoring frequency of current treatment schemes is not individually adapted to the patient and therefore often insufficient. While a higher monitoring frequency would have a positive effect on the success of treatment, in practice it can only be achieved with a home monitoring solution. One of the key requirements of a home monitoring OCT system is a computer-aided diagnosis to automatically detect and quantify pathological changes using specific OCT-based biomarkers. In this paper, for the first time, retinal scans of a novel self-examination low-cost full-field OCT (SELF-OCT) are segmented using a deep learning-based approach. A convolutional neural network (CNN) is utilized to segment the total retina as well as pigment epithelial detachments (PED). It is shown that the CNN-based approach can segment the retina with high accuracy, whereas the segmentation of the PED proves to be challenging. In addition, a convolutional denoising autoencoder (CDAE) refines the CNN prediction, which has previously learned retinal shape information. It is shown that the CDAE refinement can correct segmentation errors caused by artifacts in the OCT image.
comment: Accepted for SPIE Medical Imaging 2020: Computer-Aided Diagnosis

AI.title_translation: 使用深度学习对视网膜低成本光学相干断层扫描图像进行分割
AI.tldr: 本文首次使用深度学习方法对新型自检低成本全场OCT（SELF-OCT）的视网膜扫描图像进行分割，证明了卷积神经网络（CNN）可以高精度分割视网膜，并利用卷积去噪自编码器（CDAE）进行细化以纠正分割错误，旨在支持年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）的居家监测。
AI.motivation: 年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）的治疗需要持续的眼部检查，但目前的监测频率不足且未针对患者个体化。为了提高监测频率和治疗成功率，需要开发一种居家监测解决方案，其中关键在于通过计算机辅助诊断自动检测和量化病理变化。
AI.method: 本文首次采用基于深度学习的方法对新型自检低成本全场OCT（SELF-OCT）的视网膜扫描图像进行分割。具体方法是利用卷积神经网络（CNN）分割整个视网膜和色素上皮脱离（PED），并使用预先学习了视网膜形状信息的卷积去噪自编码器（CDAE）来细化CNN的预测。
AI.result: 研究表明，基于CNN的方法可以高精度地分割视网膜，但色素上皮脱离（PED）的分割具有挑战性。此外，卷积去噪自编码器（CDAE）的细化功能能够纠正由OCT图像伪影引起的分割错误。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了深度学习方法（包括CNN和CDAE细化）可以有效地对新型低成本自检OCT图像进行视网膜分割，尽管PED分割仍具挑战性，但该方法有望支持AMD的居家监测，提高监测频率和治疗成功率。
AI.translation: 年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）的治疗需要使用光学相干断层扫描（OCT）进行持续的眼部检查。治疗需求取决于是否存在或改变疾病特异性OCT生物标志物。因此，监测频率对AMD治疗的成功率有显著影响。然而，目前治疗方案的监测频率并未根据患者个体进行调整，因此往往不足。虽然更高的监测频率会对治疗成功产生积极影响，但在实践中，只有通过居家监测解决方案才能实现。居家监测OCT系统的关键要求之一是计算机辅助诊断，以使用特定的OCT生物标志物自动检测和量化病理变化。本文首次使用基于深度学习的方法对新型自检低成本全场OCT（SELF-OCT）的视网膜扫描图像进行分割。利用卷积神经网络（CNN）分割整个视网膜以及色素上皮脱离（PED）。结果表明，基于CNN的方法可以高精度地分割视网膜，而PED的分割则具有挑战性。此外，卷积去噪自编码器（CDAE）对CNN的预测进行了细化，该编码器此前已学习了视网膜形状信息。结果表明，CDAE细化可以纠正由OCT图像伪影引起的分割错误。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于深度学习的方法，用于分割新型低成本自检全场OCT（SELF-OCT）图像中的视网膜结构，以支持年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）的居家监测。研究利用卷积神经网络（CNN）对视网膜和色素上皮脱离（PED）进行分割，并采用卷积去噪自编码器（CDAE）对CNN预测结果进行细化。结果显示，CNN能够高精度分割视网膜，但PED分割较难，而CDAE能有效纠正图像伪影导致的分割错误。该方法有望提高AMD的监测频率和治疗成功率。
AI.keywords: 视网膜分割, 低成本OCT, 深度学习, 卷积神经网络, 年龄相关性黄斑变性
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于首次将深度学习应用于新型低成本自检OCT图像的分割，这对于实现AMD的居家监测具有重要意义。通过结合CNN进行初步分割和CDAE进行细化，提高了分割的准确性和鲁棒性，尤其是在处理图像伪影方面。然而，PED分割的挑战性表明该方法仍有改进空间，可能需要更专业的数据集或更复杂的网络结构来提高对病理标志物的识别能力。

title: The Inverse Problem for Single Trajectories of Rough Differential Equations
comments: Final version, accepted for publication in the SIAM/ASA Journal on Uncertainty Quantification
summary:
Motivated by the need to develop a general framework for performing statistical inference for discretely observed random rough differential equations, our aim is to construct a geometric $p$-rough path ${\bf X}$ whose response $Y$, when driving a rough differential equation, matches the observed trajectory $y$. We call this the \textit{continuous inverse problem} and start by rigorously defining its solution. We then develop a framework where the solution can be constructed as a limit of solutions to appropriately designed \textit{discrete inverse problems}, so that convergence holds in $p$-variation. Our approach is based on calibrating the bounded variation paths whose limit defines the rough path `lift' of path $X$ to rough path ${\bf X}$ to the observed trajectory $y$. Moreover, we develop a general numerical algorithm for constructing the solution to the discrete inverse problem. The core idea of the algorithm is to use the signature representation of the path, iterating between the response and the control, each time correcting according to the required properties.
  We apply our framework to the case where the geometric $p$-rough path ${\bf X}$ is defined as the limit of piecewise linear paths in the $p$-variation topology. We express the discrete inverse problem for a fixed observation rate as a solution to a system of equations driven by piecewise linear paths and prove convergence to the solution of the continuous inverse problem for observation time $δ\to 0$. Finally, we show that, in this context, the numerical algorithm for solving the discrete inverse problem simplifies to an iterative simultaneous update of the local gradients and we prove that it converges in $p$-variation uniformly with respect to $δ$.
comment: Final version, accepted for publication in the SIAM/ASA Journal on Uncertainty Quantification

AI.title_translation: 粗糙微分方程单轨迹的逆问题
AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个几何粗糙路径，其响应与观测轨迹匹配，解决了粗糙微分方程的连续逆问题，并提供了一个数值算法。
AI.motivation: 为了开发一个对离散观测的随机粗糙微分方程进行统计推断的通用框架，并构建一个几何p-粗糙路径，使其响应与观测轨迹相匹配。
AI.method: 首先严格定义了连续逆问题及其解。然后，开发了一个框架，将连续解构建为适当设计的离散逆问题解的极限，确保p-变差收敛。该方法基于将有界变差路径校准到观测轨迹。此外，还开发了一个通用的数值算法来构建离散逆问题的解，其核心思想是利用路径的特征表示，在响应和控制之间迭代修正。将该框架应用于分段线性路径，并将离散逆问题表示为方程组的解，并证明其在观测时间δ→0时收敛到连续逆问题的解。最后，证明了在此背景下，数值算法简化为局部梯度的迭代同步更新，并证明其在p-变差中关于δ一致收敛。
AI.result: 严格定义了连续逆问题及其解。开发了一个框架，其中连续解是离散解在p-变差中的极限。提出了一个通用的数值算法用于解决离散逆问题。证明了当应用于分段线性路径时，离散逆问题的解在观测时间δ→0时收敛到连续逆问题的解。证明了在此特定情况下，简化的数值算法在p-变差中关于δ一致收敛。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功定义并解决了粗糙微分方程的连续逆问题，提供了一个鲁棒的框架和一个收敛的数值算法，特别适用于分段线性路径。
AI.translation:
受需要开发一个通用框架来对离散观测的随机粗糙微分方程进行统计推断的启发，我们的目标是构建一个几何p-粗糙路径**X**，其响应Y在驱动粗糙微分方程时与观测轨迹y相匹配。我们称之为“连续逆问题”，并首先严格定义其解。然后，我们开发了一个框架，其中解可以作为适当设计的“离散逆问题”解的极限来构建，使得收敛在p-变差中成立。我们的方法基于将有界变差路径（其极限定义了路径X到粗糙路径**X**的粗糙路径“提升”）校准到观测轨迹y。此外，我们开发了一种通用的数值算法来构建离散逆问题的解。该算法的核心思想是利用路径的特征表示，在响应和控制之间迭代，每次根据所需属性进行修正。
我们将我们的框架应用于几何p-粗糙路径**X**被定义为p-变差拓扑中分段线性路径的极限的情况。我们将固定观测速率下的离散逆问题表示为由分段线性路径驱动的方程组的解，并证明了当观测时间δ→0时，其收敛到连续逆问题的解。最后，我们表明，在这种情况下，求解离散逆问题的数值算法简化为局部梯度的迭代同步更新，并且我们证明了它在p-变差中关于δ一致收敛。
AI.summary: 本文通过构建一个几何p-粗糙路径，使其响应与观测轨迹相匹配，解决了粗糙微分方程的连续逆问题。文章严格定义了该问题，并开发了一个框架，其中连续解是离散逆问题解在p-变差中的极限。提出了一种基于特征表示的通用数值算法。当应用于分段线性路径时，该框架证明了离散解收敛到连续解，并且数值算法简化为迭代梯度更新，展示了其均匀p-变差收敛性。
AI.keywords: 粗糙微分方程, 逆问题, 粗糙路径, 统计推断, 数值算法, p-变差
AI.comments: 该论文为粗糙路径理论和粗糙微分方程的统计推断领域做出了重要贡献。其创新之处在于严格定义了连续逆问题，并提供了一个将其与离散逆问题联系起来的建设性框架，并附带了一个通用的数值算法。使用特征表示是一种优雅的方法。该框架和算法的收敛性证明，特别是在分段线性路径的背景下，突出了其理论健壮性和实际适用性。

title: Digraph Branchings and Matrix Determinants
comments: The authors have moved the 'moving-arcs' theorem and factoring algorithm in the original version of this manuscript to a separate paper, as these sections were appropriate for the other article. We intend to submit the second article to arXiv soon
summary: We present a version of the matrix-tree theorem, which relates the determinant of a matrix to sums of weights of arborescences of its directed graph representation. Our treatment allows for non-zero column sums in the parent matrix by adding a root vertex to the usually considered matrix directed graph. We use our result to prove a version of the matrix-forest, or all-minors, theorem, which relates minors of the matrix to forests of arborescences of the matrix digraph. We apply the theorems to calculations of the time-evolution of a system with discrete states and then consider two strategies using these theorems to compute determinants.

AI.title_translation: 有向图分支与矩阵行列式
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了矩阵树定理的一个新版本，将矩阵行列式与有向图表示中树枝的权重和联系起来。通过增加一个根节点，该方法可以处理列和非零的父矩阵。此结果被用于证明矩阵森林（或所有子式）定理的一个版本，该定理将矩阵的子式与树枝森林联系起来。最后，将这些定理应用于离散状态系统的时变演化计算，并探讨了两种利用这些定理计算行列式的策略。
AI.motivation: 需要一个能处理列和非零的父矩阵的矩阵树定理版本，并将其应用于矩阵森林定理、离散状态系统的时变演化计算以及行列式计算策略。
AI.method: 提出矩阵树定理的一个新版本，通过增加根节点来处理列和非零的父矩阵。利用该定理证明矩阵森林定理的一个版本。将这些定理应用于离散状态系统的时变演化计算和行列式计算。
AI.result: 提出了一个矩阵树定理的新版本，并用它来证明矩阵森林定理的一个版本。这些定理被应用于离散状态系统的时变演化计算和行列式计算。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的矩阵树定理和矩阵森林定理的新版本在理论和应用上都有价值，特别是在处理具有非零列和的矩阵以及计算离散状态系统的时变演化方面。
AI.translation: 我们提出了矩阵树定理的一个版本，它将矩阵的行列式与表示它的有向图的树枝的权重和联系起来。我们的处理方法通过向通常考虑的矩阵有向图中添加一个根节点，允许父矩阵的列和非零。我们使用我们的结果来证明矩阵森林定理，或所有子式定理的一个版本，它将矩阵的子式与矩阵有向图的树枝森林联系起来。我们将这些定理应用于具有离散状态的系统的时变演化计算，然后考虑使用这些定理计算行列式的两种策略。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了矩阵树定理的一个新版本，该版本通过引入根节点，能够处理父矩阵中列和非零的情况。基于此，论文证明了矩阵森林定理的一个版本，该定理将矩阵的子式与有向图的树枝森林联系起来。此外，研究将这些定理应用于离散状态系统的时变演化计算，并探讨了两种利用这些定理进行行列式计算的策略。
AI.keywords: 矩阵树定理, 有向图, 树枝, 矩阵行列式, 矩阵森林定理
AI.comments: 该研究在矩阵树定理和矩阵森林定理的理论基础上进行了扩展，特别是在处理具有非零列和的矩阵方面取得了进展。增加了根节点的方法具有一定的创新性，并且将这些定理应用于离散系统的时变演化和行列式计算也展示了其潜在的应用价值。然而，论文可能需要更详细地阐述这些新版本定理的具体优势以及与其他现有方法的比较。

title: The Power of Shallow-depth Toffoli and Qudit Quantum Circuits
summary:
The relevance of shallow-depth quantum circuits has recently increased, mainly due to their applicability to near-term devices. In this context, one of the main goals of quantum circuit complexity is to find problems that can be solved by shallow quantum circuits but require more computational resources classically.
  Our first contribution in this work is to prove new separations between classical and quantum constant-depth circuits. Firstly, we show a separation between constant-depth quantum circuits with quantum advice $\mathsf{QNC}^0/\mathsf{qpoly}$, and $\mathsf{AC}^0[p]$, which is the class of classical constant-depth circuits with unbounded-fan in and $\mathsf{MOD}_{p}$ gates. Additionally, we show a separation between $\mathsf{QAC}^0$, the circuit class containing Toffoli gates with unbounded control, and $\mathsf{AC}^0[p]$, when $\mathsf{QAC}^0$ is augmented with additional mid-circuit measurements and classical fanout. This establishes the first such separation for a shallow-depth quantum class that does not involve quantum fanout gates, while relying solely on finite quantum gate sets. Equivalently, this yields a separation between $\mathsf{AC}^0[p]$ and $[\mathsf{QNC}^0, \mathsf{AC}^0]^2$, i.e., shallow quantum circuits interleaved with simple classical computation.
  Secondly, we consider $\mathsf{QNC}^0$ circuits with infinite-size gate sets. We show that these circuits, along with quantum prime modular gates or classical prime modular gates in combination with classical fanout, can implement threshold gates, showing that $\mathsf{QNC}^0[p]=\mathsf{QTC}^0$. Finally, we also show that in the infinite-size gate set case, these quantum circuit classes for higher-dimensional Hilbert spaces do not offer any advantage to standard qubit implementations.

AI.title_translation: 浅层Toffoli门和Qudit量子电路的威力
AI.tldr: 本文证明了经典和浅层量子电路之间的新分离，特别是对于使用Toffoli门和有限门集的电路，并指出在无限门集情况下qudit没有优势。
AI.motivation: 浅层量子电路因其在近期设备上的适用性而日益重要。量子电路复杂性的主要目标之一是找到可以用浅层量子电路解决但经典上需要更多计算资源的问题。
AI.method: 本文通过理论证明，探讨了经典和量子恒定深度电路之间的分离。研究了包含量子建议的恒定深度量子电路（QNC^0/qpoly）、具有无界扇入和MODp门的经典恒定深度电路（AC^0[p]）、包含Toffoli门且具有无界控制的量子电路（QAC^0，并辅以中途测量和经典扇出），以及具有无限大门集的QNC^0电路。
AI.result: 1. 证明了包含量子建议的恒定深度量子电路(QNC^0/qpoly)与经典恒定深度电路(AC^0[p])之间的分离。2. 证明了增强型QAC^0（包含Toffoli门、中途测量和经典扇出）与AC^0[p]之间的分离，这是首个不涉及量子扇出门且仅依赖有限量子门集的浅层量子类别的分离。这等价于AC^0[p]与[QNC^0, AC^0]^2之间的分离。3. 对于具有无限大门集的QNC^0电路，结合量子或经典素数模门与经典扇出，可以实现阈值门，即QNC^0[p]=QTC^0。4. 在无限大门集情况下，高维希尔伯特空间（qudit）的量子电路类别并未比标准量子比特实现提供任何优势。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了经典和浅层量子电路之间的新分离，尤其是在涉及Toffoli门和有限量子门集的电路类别中。研究还表明，在无限门集的情况下，高维量子比特（qudit）相对于标准量子比特实现不具有额外的优势。
AI.translation:
浅层量子电路的相关性最近有所增加，这主要归因于它们在近期设备上的适用性。在此背景下，量子电路复杂性的主要目标之一是找到可以用浅层量子电路解决但经典上需要更多计算资源的问题。
我们的第一个贡献是证明了经典和量子恒定深度电路之间的新分离。首先，我们展示了具有量子建议的恒定深度量子电路QNC^0/qpoly与AC^0[p]之间的分离，其中AC^0[p]是具有无界扇入和MODp门的经典恒定深度电路类别。此外，我们展示了QAC^0（包含具有无界控制的Toffoli门的电路类别）与AC^0[p]之间的分离，当QAC^0增强了额外的中途测量和经典扇出时。这建立了第一个不涉及量子扇出门、仅依赖有限量子门集的浅层量子类别的此类分离。同样，这也产生了AC^0[p]与[QNC^0, AC^0]^2（即与简单经典计算交错的浅层量子电路）之间的分离。
其次，我们考虑具有无限大门集的QNC^0电路。我们展示了这些电路，结合量子素数模门或结合经典扇出的经典素数模门，可以实现阈值门，表明QNC^0[p]=QTC^0。最后，我们还表明，在无限大门集情况下，这些用于高维希尔伯特空间的量子电路类别并未比标准量子比特实现提供任何优势。
AI.summary: 本文研究了浅层Toffoli门和Qudit量子电路的计算能力，主要目标是证明经典和浅层量子电路之间的复杂性分离。研究首先证明了包含量子建议的恒定深度量子电路QNC^0/qpoly与经典AC^0[p]电路以及增强型QAC^0与AC^0[p]之间的分离，后者是首个不依赖量子扇出的分离。其次，对于具有无限大门集的QNC^0电路，本文展示了其能够实现阈值门（QNC^0[p]=QTC^0），并指出在此情况下，高维量子系统（qudit）相对于标准量子比特没有额外优势。
AI.keywords: 浅层量子电路, 量子电路复杂性, 量子-经典分离, Toffoli门, Qudit量子电路
AI.comments: 该论文在量子计算复杂性理论领域做出了重要贡献，尤其是在浅层量子电路的研究方面。其创新之处在于首次证明了不依赖量子扇出门的浅层量子类与经典电路的分离，这对于理解近期量子设备的计算能力具有重要意义。同时，对无限门集下qudit电路能力的研究也提供了宝贵的理论见解。

title: Managing Classical Processing Requirements for Quantum Error Correction
summary: Large-scale quantum computers promise transformative speedups, but their viability hinges on fast and reliable quantum error correction (QEC). At the center of QEC are decoders-classical algorithms running on hardware such as FPGAs, GPUs, or CPUs that process error syndromes to detect errors every microsecond to preserve fault-tolerance. Quantum processors, therefore, operate not in isolation, but as accelerators tightly coupled with powerful classical digital hardware. A key challenge is that decoder demand fluctuates unpredictably: bursts of activity can require orders of magnitude more decodes than idle periods. Provisioning hardware for the worst case wastes resources, while provisioning for the average case risks catastrophic slowdowns. We show that this mismatch is a systems problem of capacity planning and scheduling, and propose a two-level framework that treats decoders as shared accelerators managed by the quantum operating system. Our approach reduces decoder requirements by 10-40% across fault-tolerant benchmarks, demonstrating that efficient decoder scheduling is essential to making FTQC practical.

AI.title_translation: 量子纠错中经典处理需求的管理
AI.tldr: 量子计算机需要高效的量子纠错，其中解码器需求波动大。本文提出一个两级框架，将解码器作为共享加速器管理，由量子操作系统调度，可将解码器需求降低10-40%，使容错量子计算更实用。
AI.motivation: 大规模量子计算机的实用性取决于快速可靠的量子纠错（QEC）。QEC中的解码器需求波动大且不可预测，为最坏情况配置硬件会浪费资源，为平均情况配置则可能导致灾难性减速，这阻碍了容错量子计算（FTQC）的实现。
AI.method: 论文将解码器需求不匹配视为容量规划和调度方面的系统问题。提出了一种两级框架，将解码器视为由量子操作系统管理的共享加速器。
AI.result: 该方法在容错基准测试中将解码器需求降低了10-40%。
AI.conclusion: 高效的解码器调度对于使容错量子计算（FTQC）实用化至关重要。
AI.translation: 大规模量子计算机有望带来变革性的加速，但其实用性取决于快速可靠的量子纠错（QEC）。QEC的核心是解码器——在FPGA、GPU或CPU等硬件上运行的经典算法，每微秒处理错误综合征以检测错误，从而保持容错性。因此，量子处理器并非孤立运行，而是与强大的经典数字硬件紧密耦合的加速器。一个关键挑战是解码器需求波动不可预测：活动高峰期可能需要比空闲期多出几个数量级的解码操作。为最坏情况配置硬件会浪费资源，而为平均情况配置则可能导致灾难性减速。我们表明，这种不匹配是一个容量规划和调度方面的系统问题，并提出了一个两级框架，将解码器视为由量子操作系统管理的共享加速器。我们的方法在容错基准测试中将解码器需求降低了10-40%，这表明高效的解码器调度对于使容错量子计算（FTQC）实用化至关重要。
AI.summary: 本文指出，在量子纠错中，经典解码器的需求波动性是一个系统性挑战。为解决资源浪费和性能下降的问题，作者提出了一个两级框架，将解码器作为由量子操作系统管理的共享加速器。实验结果表明，该框架能有效降低10-40%的解码器需求，强调了高效调度对于实现实用容错量子计算的重要性。
AI.keywords: 量子纠错, 解码器, 经典处理, 调度, 容错量子计算
AI.comments: 这篇论文解决了量子计算领域中一个实际且关键的系统级问题。通过将解码器视为共享资源并引入调度框架，它提供了一种创新的方法来优化经典硬件与量子处理器之间的协同工作，对于降低FTQC的硬件成本和提高其效率具有重要意义。

title: Exploratory Optimal Stopping: A Singular Control Formulation
summary: This paper explores continuous-time and state-space optimal stopping problems from a reinforcement learning perspective. We begin by formulating the stopping problem using randomized stopping times, where the decision maker's control is represented by the probability of stopping within a given time-specifically, a bounded, non-decreasing, càdlàg control process. To encourage exploration and facilitate learning, we introduce a regularized version of the problem by penalizing the performance criterion with the cumulative residual entropy of the randomized stopping time. The regularized problem takes the form of an (n+1)-dimensional degenerate singular stochastic control with finite-fuel, where the regularized free boundary becomes the graph of a function mapping the state variable of the original stopping problem into the probability of stopping. We address this singular control problem through the dynamic programming principle, which enables us to identify the unique optimal exploratory strategy. Finally, we propose both model-based and model-free reinforcement learning algorithms tailored for exploratory optimal stopping problems. We establish policy improvement guarantees for the proposed algorithms. Moreover, the model-free method is of actor-critic type and it is scalable in high-dimensions under neural network parameterization.

AI.title_translation: 探索性最优停止：一种奇异控制公式
AI.tldr: 本文将连续时间最优停止问题公式化为奇异随机控制问题，通过随机停止时间和熵正则化鼓励探索，并提出了基于模型和无模型的强化学习算法，具有策略改进保证。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在从强化学习的角度探索连续时间、状态空间最优停止问题，并通过引入探索机制来促进学习。
AI.method:
1. 使用随机停止时间（有界、非递减、càdlàg控制过程）表述停止问题。
2. 通过对性能标准施加随机停止时间的累积残余熵惩罚，引入了问题的正则化版本。
3. 正则化问题被转化为(n+1)维退化奇异随机控制问题。
4. 通过动态规划原理解决奇异控制问题，以识别唯一的最佳探索策略。
5. 提出了基于模型和无模型的强化学习算法，其中无模型方法是行动者-评论家类型，并可在高维下通过神经网络参数化。
AI.result:
1. 将正则化问题转化为(n+1)维退化奇异随机控制问题，其正则化自由边界映射状态变量到停止概率。
2. 识别出唯一的最佳探索策略。
3. 提出了基于模型和无模型的强化学习算法。
4. 为所提出的算法建立了策略改进保证。
5. 无模型方法在神经网络参数化下在高维中具有可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功地将探索性最优停止问题公式化为奇异控制问题，并提供了一种通过动态规划识别最优探索策略的方法。此外，提出的基于模型和无模型的强化学习算法，特别是高维可扩展的无模型方法，为解决此类问题提供了理论和实践的解决方案，并具有策略改进保证。
AI.translation: 本文从强化学习的角度探讨了连续时间、状态空间最优停止问题。我们首先使用随机停止时间来表述停止问题，其中决策者的控制表示为在给定时间内停止的概率——具体来说，是一个有界、非递减、右连续左极限存在（càdlàg）的控制过程。为了鼓励探索和促进学习，我们通过对性能标准施加随机停止时间的累积残余熵惩罚，引入了问题的正则化版本。正则化问题采取了(n+1)维退化奇异随机控制的形式，具有有限燃料，其中正则化自由边界成为将原始停止问题的状态变量映射到停止概率的函数的图。我们通过动态规划原理解决这个奇异控制问题，这使我们能够识别出唯一的最佳探索策略。最后，我们提出了针对探索性最优停止问题的基于模型和无模型的强化学习算法。我们为所提出的算法建立了策略改进保证。此外，无模型方法是行动者-评论家类型，并且在神经网络参数化下在高维中具有可扩展性。
AI.summary: 本文在强化学习框架下重新构建了连续时间最优停止问题。它引入了随机停止时间和熵正则化，将问题转化为一个奇异随机控制问题。通过应用动态规划原理，本文识别出了一种独特的最佳探索策略。此外，它还提出了针对这些问题的基于模型和可扩展的无模型（行动者-评论家类型，神经网络参数化）强化学习算法，并提供了策略改进保证。
AI.keywords: 最优停止, 强化学习, 奇异控制, 熵正则化, 行动者-评论家
AI.comments: 该论文通过将最优停止问题与强化学习相结合，并采用奇异控制公式和熵正则化，提出了一种创新方法。这种方法明确鼓励探索，这对于学习至关重要。开发具有理论保证（策略改进）的基于模型和可扩展的无模型算法，使得所提出的方法具有高度的实用性和适用性，尤其是在高维场景中。随机停止时间和累积残余熵的使用是将在最优停止中融入探索的新颖方式。

title: Some properties of the principal Dirichlet eigenfunction in Lipschitz domains, via probabilistic couplings
comments: 37 pages, 1 figure. This version contains several improvements compared to the version 1. We include a new coupling to deal with higher-order differences and more complete overview of the $L^2$ and $L^\infty$ convergence of the discrete eigenfunction to its continuous counterpart. We include several new discussions with the literature. Comments are welcome !
summary: We study a discrete and continuous version of the spectral Dirichlet problem in an open bounded connected set $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^d$, in dimension $d\geq 2$. More precisely, consider the simple random walk on $\mathbb{Z}^d$ killed upon exiting the (large) bounded domain $Ω_N = (NΩ)\cap \mathbb{Z}^d$. We let $P_N$ its transition matrix and we study the properties of its ($L^2$-normalized) principal eigenvector $φ_N$, also known as ground state. Under mild assumptions on $Ω$, we give regularity estimates on $φ_N$, namely on its $k$-th order differences (or \(k\)-th order derivatives), with a uniform control inside $Ω_N$. We provide a completely probabilistic proof of these estimates: our starting point is a Feynman-Kac representation of $φ_N$, combined with gambler's ruin estimates and a new ``multi-mirror'' coupling, which may be of independent interest. We also obtain the same type of estimates for the first eigenfunction $\varphi_1$ of the corresponding continuous spectral Dirichlet problem, in relation with a Brownian motion killed upon exiting $Ω$. Finally, we take the opportunity to review (and slightly extend) some of the literature on the $L^2$ and uniform convergence of $φ_N$ to $\varphi_1$ in Lipschitz bounded domains of $\mathbb{R}^d$, which can be derived thanks to our estimates.
